86b46fac.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

**Job Title: Solution Architect – Application**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 EY is a global leader in Advisory, Assurance, Tax, and Transaction Services. In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the End User Technology Experience team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.
   

  

 The Solution Architect is a highly skilled senior role with industry leading architecture and design expertise to support one or more programs. He/she has a deep end to end understanding of architecture standards and platform solution
   

  

 development expertise.
   

  

 The End User Technology Experience requires a seasoned Solution Architect to provide technical guidance on Application development, Microsoft Platform solutions, and lead customer service applications. Candidate must be a self\-starter with Agile framework experience and provide RISK/Technical architecture leadership.
   

  

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
**The Solution Architect:**
* Architect and Design platform solutions needed for a complex enterprise
* Manages the technical dependencies across the different products and services
* Provides guidance on complex production designs, applications or system problems.
* Solution design will include the creation of reusable, repeatable IP and artifacts
* Identify opportunities to innovate, extend and enhance O365/Azure services
* Own Root Cause Analysis and Problem Management for first of a kind solution implementation
* Lead Agile sprints in product owner capacity and mentor technical staff on newer design sprints
* Enforce adherence to architectural standards/principles, global product\-specific guidelines, usability experience and design standards, etc.
* Identify, communicate and mitigate Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions throughout the development lifecycle.
* Responsible for the solution planning, migration, architecture, development, and delivery; works with business stakeholders and technical teams to develop and implement solutions in agile environments, provides support for new SharePoint deployments and migrations from older platforms; builds Intranets, branding, enterprise applications and collaboration systems.
* Responsible to propose with a custom solutions \& collaboration with business application owners, project managers, designers, engineers, and infrastructure teams to build a quality experience for users.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* History of working credibly with senior stakeholders
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross\-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Demonstrate excellent technical \& architecture skills in the context of cloud\-based platform/product design, service management and product lifecycle management
* Demonstrate ability to rapidly learn new and emerging technologies and developing a vision of their suitability
* Serves as the lead solution architect for customer service solutions
* Experience with Microsoft Teams and Dynamics 365
* Experience with ServiceNow, Azure IaaS and PaaS services
* Experience with Business Intelligence analytic tools
* Designed, validated, and implemented PowerApps and Power BI solutions
* Platform Expertise using Microsoft Graph, Power Apps, Flow and market place apps
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, BOT Framework, RPA and virtual agents
* Knowledge of python, AI stacks, CNN’s, RNN’s, AI Fluency, NLP, Digital Twins, Metaverse, Data preprocessing.
* Knowledge of UI/UX, branding, and document management, Custom solutions development, search and metadata configuration, business analysis, business process automation, and workflows. Microsoft PowerApps and Microsoft Flow, SharePoint Technologies (Windows SharePoint Services, SharePoint Server, InfoPath Forms
* Services, Forms, PowerShell scripts, Migration tools (Sharegate, DocAve, Cloudiway), Excel Services, Search,
* Business Data Catalog and Web Services), PowerApps, Flow, Power BI, Security \& Compliance, Data Governance, Classic and Modern UI, PowerShell, PowerApps, Flow
* Knowledge of Intranets, public websites, applications, Proposal Management Systems, Project Management
* Information Systems, product or service sites, business development, process automation with forms and workflows.
* Knowledge of Classic and Modern UI, Power BI and SharePoint integration \& so as building knowledge of automated process and workflows (using various tools \& technologies).
* Knowledge of Agile Development, Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), System Development Life Cycle
* Methodology (SDLCM), Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF), Microsoft Solutions Framework (MSF)
* Build technical artifacts for Engineering and product owners
* Brings proven industry leading technical expertise of the product(s)
* Good understanding of the financial aspects of the product management
* 5\-10 years’ experience in an Architecture role


**Other Requirements:**
* The role may require minimum travel, participate in workshops, coach/lead engineering teams and available in US/UK business hours


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor or Master degree in Information Technology or Business Management


**Experience:**
* Approximately 17 years of experience in a comparable executive leadership role.


**Certification Requirements:**
* TOGAF, O365, Azure Paas, IaaS or Analytics Certification


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

9d7e0e7c.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
9d7e0e7c.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

1b456576.title: Azure Platform SME — Solutioning & Pre-Sales
1b456576.description:
Job Description
  
**Role Summary**

Avanade India’s Cloud \& Infrastructure practice is looking for an Azure Platform SME who can sit in front of a customer, understand their landscape, ask the right questions and shape the solution — then design and build it. This is a pre\-sales\-led role with real technical depth: the same person runs the discovery conversation, proposes the architecture, prepares the estimate and proposal, and stays hands\-on enough to design and provision the environment.


We are looking for someone whose strength is consultative rather than order\-taking. Much of the value in this role comes before any design is written — in asking the questions that surface the customer’s constraints, dependencies and real drivers, and in proposing an approach that fits their landscape rather than a standard template.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead customer discovery discussions and workshops — understand the current landscape across on\-premises and cloud estate, applications, infrastructure, network, identity, security, operations and existing commitments.
* Ask structured, probing questions to surface business drivers, constraints, dependencies, compliance requirements, timelines and success criteria — and identify what the customer has not said as much as what they have.
* Translate discovery findings into a proposed Azure solution — target architecture, options with clear trade\-offs (cost, risk, effort, timeline), phasing and a recommended approach.
* Present and defend the proposed solution to customer stakeholders, from technical teams through to IT and business leadership, and adapt the pitch to the audience in the room.
* Prepare proposals and pre\-sales collateral end to end — solution write\-ups, architecture diagrams, bill of materials, assumptions, dependencies, risks, scope boundaries and SOW inputs.
* Own effort and cost estimation — Azure consumption sizing and pricing, resource\-level estimates, licensing considerations, and services effort estimates with clear assumptions behind the numbers.
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and customer questionnaires, working with sales, delivery and practice leadership to build a coherent and competitive response.
* Design Azure platform architecture: subscription and environment strategy, landing zone, networking and connectivity, identity, security baselines, governance, monitoring, backup and DR.
* Provision, configure and validate Azure resources hands\-on — building POCs, pilots and initial environments to prove the solution and de\-risk delivery.
* Shape migration approaches for customer workloads — assessment, sizing, wave planning, migration method and cutover considerations.
* Hand over cleanly to delivery teams and remain available as design authority — design reviews, escalation support and architecture governance through the engagement.
* Build reusable pre\-sales assets: reference architectures, solution templates, estimation models, proposal boilerplate and discovery question sets that shorten future pursuits.
* Engage Microsoft and partner stakeholders on joint pursuits, funding programmes and co\-sell motions where applicable.
* Mentor junior architects and pre\-sales consultants, and raise the quality bar on solution and proposal work across the practice.

  
Qualification
  
**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 8–11 years of overall experience in cloud solution architecture, infrastructure or cloud pre\-sales, with a strong recent focus on Microsoft Azure.
* Solid Azure platform knowledge across the core stack: compute, storage, networking, identity, security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and the platform services commonly used by enterprise workloads.
* Proven customer\-facing solutioning experience — running discovery discussions and workshops, understanding a customer landscape quickly, and proposing an appropriate solution rather than a generic one.
* Strong questioning and listening skills, with the judgement to challenge assumptions constructively and to identify gaps, risks and dependencies early.
* Hands\-on experience designing and provisioning Azure resources — able to build and configure environments personally, not only produce diagrams.
* Demonstrated pre\-sales track record : proposals, solution write\-ups, bill of materials, RFP/RFI responses and client\-facing presentations.
* Strong estimation capability — Azure sizing and cost estimation, effort estimation for services, and the discipline to document assumptions, exclusions and risks clearly.
* Experience designing Azure landing zones and migration approaches for enterprise customers.
* Azure networking depth: hub\-and\-spoke topologies, ExpressRoute and VPN, NSGs/UDRs, firewalling and routing, Private Link and DNS design.
* Working knowledge of Azure identity and security: Entra ID and hybrid identity, RBAC, conditional access, Key Vault and Defender for Cloud.
* Ability to produce clear, well\-structured architecture and proposal documentation (HLD, solution overview, migration plan) at client\-ready quality.
* Scripting capability in PowerShell and/or CLI for provisioning, configuration and operational tasks.
* Confident communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to hold a room of senior customer stakeholders.
**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Infrastructure as Code experience — Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates — and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Good to have, not essential; willingness to build this depth is expected.
* Microsoft certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), Azure Network Engineer (AZ\-700\), or security certifications such as SC\-100 / SC\-200\.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Intune/ EMS and endpoint management as part of an integrated customer estate.
* Experience with Microsoft partner programmes — partner capability alignment, specialization readiness, Microsoft field engagement or distributor GTM.
* AWS or GCP exposure for multi\-cloud positioning and comparative solutioning.
* Familiarity with Azure AI and data services (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric) and how those workloads land on a governed platform.
* FinOps awareness — cost optimisation , right\-sizing and ongoing consumption management.
* Experience in regulated or compliance\-heavy environments (BFSI, healthcare, energy, public sector), including data residency requirements.
* Experience in a global delivery / SI or Microsoft partner environment working with distributed teams.
* Prior contribution to reusable accelerators, reference architectures or practice\-building initiatives.

67df725a.title: Oracle Cloud Infra Admin-Oracle DBA with OCI-Senior
67df725a.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY GDS –Senior Oracle DBA / OCI Administrator Position**
 Over the last decade, cloud adoption and database modernization have become critical enablers for building scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise platforms globally. To support this rapidly evolving and fast paced cloud transformation landscape, we leverage Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) along with industry best practices in database administration, automation, and cloud architecture to deliver reliable, high performance, and cost effective solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work on enterprise scale Oracle database and OCI initiatives, supporting mission critical applications across on premises and cloud environments. You will be involved in solving complex technical challenges, driving large scale database migrations, and contributing to the development of next generation cloud and database platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are offering you a demanding role where you will work on mission critical enterprise database platforms and cloud transformation initiatives. You will leverage your expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), database administration, and cloud migration to design, migrate, and manage highly available and secure database solutions. This position includes the opportunity to collaborate with cross functional teams and supporting large scale cloud adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Database administration, solution design, database migration, and manageability for mission critical enterprise applications across data center and cloud deployments.
* Hands on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including database provisioning, maintenance, and operational support.
* Perform core database activities such as patching, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and maintenance.
* Lead and support end to end Oracle application and database migrations from on premises environments to OCI.
* Execute end to end database migrations, including:
+ Virtual network design
+ Routing rules
+ Security configuration
+ Compute instance creation
+ Database deployment and configuration

* Provide production support and upgrades for Oracle databases (12c, 18c, 19c), including cross‑platform migrations.
* Perform Oracle database upgrades from 9i, 10g, and 11g to 12c, 18c, and 19c across multiple platforms.
* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure teams to identify and implement efficient, scalable, and secure cloud\-based solutions.
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, effectively collaborating with teams across geographies.
* Flexibility to work independently or as part of a global delivery team to meet project objectives and timelines.
* Support proof of concepts, architectural design sessions, and solution reviews using Oracle Cloud best practices.
* Contribute to automation and optimization initiatives, leveraging DevOps tools where applicable.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Proof of Concepts (PoCs).

* Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges.

 The Google Cloud team helps organizations seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You will design, govern, and oversee the implementation of highly resilient, production\-ready application architectures. You will partner with executive stakeholders to identify monumental opportunities for enterprise\-wide workflow transformation using autonomous agents.  Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. 1d7a9278.title: Senior Lead - Gen AI Solutions Consultant
1d7a9278.description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead as Forward Deployed Agentic Engineer that will drive the Agentic AI products across the Chief Operating Office, acting as the bridge between product development, operations, and AI engineering. The role focuses on embedding LLM\-powered, Agentic workflows directly into enterprise processes, enabling measurable business outcomes, operational transformation, and scalable AI adoption.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop or influence digital products, initiatives, plans, specifications, resources, and long\-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs across a functional area within the Digital environment
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in\-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise
* Deliver solutions that are long\-term, large\-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Coordinate highly complex activities and guidance to others
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have significant impact
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise
* Serve as an expert advisor to leadership

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* **1\) Forward Deployment of Agentic AI Products ·**
* Lead end\-to\-end deployment of agentic AI solutions into live banking operations
* Embed AI agents directly into operational workflows for automation and decision support.
* Work closely with business and operations teams to move from concept to production.
* Ensure enterprise\-grade deployment, scalability, and governance of AI solutions.
* **2\) Discovery, Process Intelligence \& Value Realization ·**
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with business and operations stakeholders. ·
* Analyze process artifacts (SOPs, runbooks, workflows, video recordings, process mining outputs, etc.) to identify AI and automation opportunities.
* Translate operational processes into agentic workflows and solution blueprints. ·
* Define KPIs and quantify business benefits (cost reduction, cycle time, risk mitigation, productivity gains). ·
* Build ROI models and value realization frameworks for AI initiatives.
* **3\) Agentic Solution Design, MCP Tools \& Workflow Orchestration ·**
* Design and implement agentic AI solutions using process artifacts as input for workflow automation. ·
* Develop multi\-step AI agents capable of reasoning, tool use, and task execution. ·
* Leverage MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools to integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources. ·
* Enable tool\-augmented LLM workflows including function calling, orchestration, and structured outputs. ·
* Build reusable agent patterns for banking operations use cases (e.g., case resolution, reconciliation, compliance checks).
* **4\). LLM \& GenAI Expertise (Hands\-on Execution) ·**
* Hands\-on experience with LLM platforms including: • Claude (Anthropic) • Gemini (Google) • GPT (OpenAI) ·
* Design prompt architectures, reasoning chains, and agent workflows. ·
* Implement RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) and contextual grounding strategies. ·
* Evaluate model performance, reliability, and enterprise readiness. ·
* Ensure responsible AI usage, governance, and compliance adherence.
* **5\) Capability Development: Agentic Skills Library \& Reusable Assets** ·
* Build and maintain an Agentic Skills Library of reusable capabilities, including: Task\-specific AI agents (e.g., summarization, reconciliation, classification, decision support). • Workflow components (e.g., data extraction, validation, routing, reasoning chains). • Prompt templates, tool\-use patterns, and orchestration blueprints. ·
* Enable systematic reuse of agentic capabilities across multiple banking use cases. ·
* Establish standards for versioning, governance, and lifecycle management of agent skills. ·
* Continuously expand the library based on production learnings and new use cases.

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. 1f44af0e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
1f44af0e.description:
**Netradyne** 
 harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern\-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward\-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
   

  

**Role : Sr. Technical Program Manager (Product Development)**
**Experience : 10 to 15 years**
**Summary:**
 As a Technical Program Manager / Sr. Technical Program Manager, you will own electronic product development programs end\-to\-end — from ideation and concept definition through prototyping, design, validation, commercialization / industrialization, and final delivery. You will orchestrate cross\-functional teams spanning hardware, software / firmware, mechanical, quality, operations, sourcing and product management, alongside external partners such as ODMs, contract manufacturers and component suppliers. You will be accountable for the program plan, schedule, budget, risks and overall execution, ensuring the right product is delivered at the right cost, quality and time. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating both rapid Agile software cycles and structured hardware stage\-gate development, remaining flexible and calm in the face of uncertainty.
   

  

**Responsibilities \-**
* Own the end\-to\-end program lifecycle of electronic products from ideation to delivery, integrating hardware, software / firmware, mechanical and industrial design workstreams into a single executable plan.
* Drive disciplined stage\-gate execution across concept, prototyping, EVT, DVT, PVT and mass production, ensuring entry / exit criteria are met at each phase.
* Create and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, dependency maps and risk registers; surface critical path and proactively remove impediments.
* Plan and manage prototyping and bring\-up cycles, coordinating board bring\-up, integration, debug and iteration loops between hardware and firmware teams.
* Drive design and manufacturability reviews (DFM / DFA / DFT), BOM maturity, design\-for\-cost and design\-for\-reliability discussions with engineering and suppliers.
* Lead commercialization / industrialization activities — NPI ramp, manufacturing line setup and transfer, tooling, first\-article and yield improvement at the contract manufacturer.
* Coordinate certification and regulatory compliance (EMC, safety, ingress and applicable automotive / regional standards) within the program timeline.
* Partner with sourcing and operations on component qualification, supplier readiness, lead times and supply continuity.
* Manage cost, schedule and scope; track program health, costs and roadmaps through clear, communicable dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.
* Run Agile / Scrum for software and firmware deliverables, Kanban for recurring activities, and milestone\-based tracking for hardware; flex the model to fit each workstream.
* Communicate status, risks and trade\-offs to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders; build consensus and enable visibility across the organization.
* Plan achievable goals working with vendor / partner PMs and internal cross\-functional teams; make timely corrections and alternative plans to keep final deliverables on time.


**Requirements And Skills \-**
* Proven experience program managing electronic / electro\-mechanical product development end\-to\-end, from ideation through to delivery.
* Hands\-on exposure across the full stack — hardware, embedded software / firmware and mechanical — with the ability to converse credibly with each function.
* Demonstrated experience taking products through prototyping and into commercialization / industrialization and mass production.
* Strong program planning, risk management and cross\-functional leadership skills, with experience managing external manufacturing and supplier partners.
* Comfortable operating in both Agile development and structured hardware stage\-gate (EVT / DVT / PVT) environments.


**Desired Qualifications:**
* B.E / B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Computer Science Engineering.
* MBA is a plus.
* TPM: 8\+ years of Technical Program Management experience in an electronic product development scenario; Sr. TPM: 12\+ years, including ownership of full product programs.
* Hands\-on experience across SDLC and hardware product development (EVT / DVT / PVT), with successful delivery of commercial high\-tech electronic products from ideation to market.
* Experience in commercializing / industrializing new hardware products and managing the transfer to contract manufacturing.
* Familiarity with integrating edge devices with cloud platforms is advantageous.
* Proficient in MS Project, JIRA, Confluence, Tableau, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and SQL.
* PMP / ITIL certification is a plus.
* Hands\-on Agile experience or Scrum certification is a plus.
* Motivation to be self\-driven and not afraid to get hands dirty.


 We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal\-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status.
   

  

 If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly.
   

  

 Netradyne is an equal\-opportunity employer.
   

  

**Applicants only \- Recruiting agencies do not contact.**
**Recruitment Fraud Alert!**
 There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Netradyne employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Netradyne does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set\-up and does not use recruitment or job\-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ‘@netradyne.com’ or ‘@us\-greenhouse\-mail.io’.
   

  

 Please review and apply to our available job openings at Netradyne.com/company/careers. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's job scams website.

 :** 
 Job Summary: As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will lead media programs, influencing the teams' roadmap priorities and technical direction. This role combines strong technical understanding, program leadership, and agile delivery excellence. You will own end\-to\-end execution of critical programs, influence roadmap direction, manage cross\-team dependencies and senior stakeholders, and mentor teams to raise execution maturity across the organization.
   

  

****About the Team:****
 Content Commerce is a new and high\-impact initiative at the intersection of content, advertising and commerce. The vision is to make content shoppable. Users should be able to discover products naturally while watching shows, movies, sports, or short\-form content \- and move from inspiration to purchase with minimal friction. This team will build the platform that powers commerce experiences across JioHotstar content surfaces. That includes product discovery, contextual recommendations, shoppable placements, brand integrations, storefront experiences, measurement, and partner integrations with commerce platforms.
   

  

****Key responsibilities****
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration
* Lead large, complex technical programs from planning through delivery independently
* Influence roadmap priorities by aligning stakeholders on objectives and outcomes
* Coordinate across engineering, product, and business teams to manage dependencies and ensure timely execution
* Facilitate cross\-pod collaboration and alignment to maintain delivery momentum
* Proactively plan for and mitigate risks, evaluating alternatives, quantifying trade\-offs, and structuring communication plans
* Apply Agile methodologies for iterative delivery, adaptive planning, and continuous improvement
* Coach teams on Agile best practices and foster high Scrum maturity
* Maintain sprint cadence and rigor through reviews, retrospectives, and OKR alignment
* Drive pod\-level accountability for JIRA hygiene, analytics reporting, and milestone tracking
* Ensure data\-driven decision\-making using clear metrics, dashboards, and visual progress reporting
* Regularly communicate program updates, decisions, and risks to leadership concisely and visually
* Continuously improve internal processes to enhance team efficiency and delivery velocity
* Act as a mentor for junior TPMs and team members to scale program management maturity


****Skills and attributes for success:****
* Deep technical understanding of scalable systems, with the ability to dive into architecture reviews, ask second\-order questions, and push for scalable, resilient solutions
* Highly structured thinker with the ability to break down ambiguous goals into executable plans, identify blind spots, and push for clarity in both direction and detail
* Strong grasp of risk/reward tradeoffs, and comfort operating in fast\-moving, high\-stakes environments with shifting priorities and evolving context
* Exceptional communicator, skilled in managing stakeholder expectations and aligning diverse teams on shared timelines, goals, and impact
* Strong program management experience managing cross functional initiatives end to end and driving influence without authority
* Strong experience leading complex cross\-functional programs involving AI/ML and GenAI systems at scale.
* Should have deep technical understanding of AI platforms, execution rigor, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive AI initiatives from strategy to production.
* Experience with LLMs, AI infrastructure, model lifecycle management, and scalable delivery processes is highly preferred.
* Expertise in Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe) and tools like JIRA, Confluence


****Preferred education and experience:****
* A Bachelor's/Master’s degree with a minimum of 8\-10 years of experience, including 3 to 4 years in a Program Management role within the consumer technology sector


**About JioStar**
 Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.*

**Company Description** 




 SAR\-X Marketing is a performance marketing partner focused on helping app\-first businesses acquire and grow high\-quality users through measurable, sustainable strategies. The company works with brands across sectors such as FinTech, Banking, Retail, Utilities, Ecommerce, Entertainment, Food Delivery, and Gaming to drive mobile user acquisition that delivers real performance outcomes. SAR\-X goes beyond user volume, prioritizing genuine users who deliver long\-term value through meaningful in\-app actions including installs, registrations, sign\-ups, subscriptions, purchases, and first\-time deposits.  The Delivery Manager role at SAR\-X Marketing is a full\-time position based in New Delhi, structured as a hybrid role with a mix of in\-office and work\-from\-home days. The Delivery Manager will oversee end\-to\-end campaign delivery across multiple clients, ensuring performance marketing initiatives are launched on time, optimized effectively, and aligned with client goals. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams and external partners, monitoring campaign performance, analyzing data, and implementing improvements to drive user acquisition, retention, and return on ad spend. The role involves managing project timelines, resolving delivery bottlenecks, communicating status updates to stakeholders, and supporting client consultations on best practices and strategy. The Delivery Manager will also contribute to process refinement, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration to ensure scalable, high\-quality campaign execution.

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills for interpreting performance data, identifying trends, and making data\-informed decisions.
* Candidates should possess Program Management capabilities to manage multiple campaigns, timelines, and deliverables in a structured, efficient manner.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with clients, internal teams, and external partners, and to present findings clearly.
* Candidates should possess Team Management experience to guide cross\-functional contributors, coordinate workstreams, and support a collaborative environment.
* Candidates should possess Consulting skills to understand client objectives, recommend performance strategies, and support long\-term growth planning.
* Relevant qualifications include experience in performance or digital marketing, familiarity with mobile app user acquisition, and comfort working with metrics such as CPI, CPA, CPR, ROAS, and CAC.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field; proficiency with analytics tools and spreadsheets; and prior experience in a client\-facing or delivery\-focused role.

c7c3fe5a.title: Principle Data Architect
c7c3fe5a.description:
**Vacancy No** VN1411
  

**Business Unit** Americas
  

**Job Location** India, Philippines
  

**Employment Type** Full Time
  

**Job Details and Responsibilities**
Lemongrass Consulting is seeking an experienced **Principal SAP Data Architect** who is experienced in solutioning, building high performing data teams and self\-driven thought leader. The architect will be responsible for Legacy BW analysis, Target Databricks and BDC data modeling, fitment assessments, and remediation planning, and must have deep expertise in BDC, BW metadata, Azure and GCP Lakehouse architecture, and reporting structures.
  

  

This role is highly analytical and spans both traditional BW landscapes and next\-generation SAP data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong functional knowledge of SAP BW/BW4HANA combined with an understanding of SAP Datasphere and SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) concepts — including Databricks, data products, semantic modeling, lineage, and cross\-system integration.
  

  

The architect will play a key role in evaluating BW objects for S/4 compatibility, mapping data flows to Datasphere/BDC architectures, and supporting reporting landscape rationalization across SAP and cloud ecosystems. This includes analyzing data lineage, object lifecycle dependencies, and opportunities to transition legacy BW workloads into modern, cloud\-based data models.
  

  

Key Responsibilities
* Lead comprehensive SAP BW landscape analysis and remediation activities related to S/4HANA program impacts, including alignment with future\-state BDC and Lakehouse architectures.
* Conduct detailed user activity and BW object usage analysis using ST03N, RSR\\, RSZ\\ logs, and metadata to inform modernization and migration decisions.
* Perform top\-down and bottom\-up BW object lineage analysis — from BEx Queries through InfoProviders to DataSources — at the field and transformation level.
* Identify, classify, and rationalize active, inactive, and redundant BW objects; contribute to disposition and modernization strategy across BW, Databricks, Datasphere, and BDC.
* Map BEx queries and BW reporting objects to downstream consumer systems (Power BI, SAC, Tableau) to establish end\-to\-end data lineage and reporting impact.
* Document OpenHub, external extractors, and integration flows; identify common InfoProviders and opportunities to transition workloads into Datasphere/BDC data products.
* Contribute to BW optimization, prioritization, and disposition recommendation reports, including pathways for migration into Datasphere and BDC semantic models.
* Deliver technical debt and data debt analysis to support BW cleanup, S/4 readiness, and future\-state cloud data platform alignment.
* Support reporting and analytics requirements related to BW, Datasphere, and BDC metadata consumption.
* Participate in project kick\-offs, scope alignment sessions, and stakeholder review workshops across business, IT, and data platform teams.
* Ensure all deliverables meet agreed\-upon acceptance criteria, quality standards, and milestone timelines.
* Ability to understand and develop enterprise grade global system landscape architecture diagrams in line with business needs
* Work in a global environment with cross\-country and cross\-region teams, demonstrating highly collaborative and exceptional English communication skills.
  

  

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
  

  

SAP BW \& Data Architecture:


* 15\+ years of hands\-on experience with SAP BW (BW 7\.x and/or BW/4HANA).
* Strong knowledge of BW object types: InfoCubes, DSOs, MultiProviders, CompositeProviders, InfoObjects, and OpenHub Destinations.
* Deep experience with BEx Query Designer, Analysis for Office (AFO), and BW metadata analysis.
* Proficiency with BW T\-codes: RSA1, RSA2, RSPC, RSISET, SE16, DB02, ST03N.
* Experience with BW lineage analysis and object dependency tracing (Top\-Down and Bottom\-Up).
* Strong understanding of ECC\-to\-BW data extraction patterns DataSource field mapping, S/4 Hana to BDC extraction and mapping.
* Experience working with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) dashboards — configuration and customization.
* Ability to read and interpret ABAP transformation code at a functional level (ABAP development not required).
* Knowledge of BW landscape rationalization, decommissioning principles, and usage\-based classification.
* Databricks, Lakehouse \& Cloud Platforms:
* Strong knowledge of Databricks and Lakehouse architecture (Azure and GCP).
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Medallion Architecture patterns.
* Experience with cloud data engineering pipelines including ETL/ELT design and orchestration.
* Familiarity with Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, GCP BigQuery, and related cloud services.
* Understanding of SAP Datasphere and SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) concepts: data products, semantic modeling, lineage, and cross\-system integration.
* Knowledge of Foundation Services and data governance frameworks within BDC/Datasphere.

Soft Skills \& Delivery:


* Strong documentation skills; ability to produce client\-ready analytical reports and recommendations.
* Exceptional communication skills in English; experience working in global, cross\-region teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to present complex data architecture findings to non\-technical audiences.
  

  

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience with BW/4HANA migration or formal assessment projects.
* Deep hands\-on knowledge of SAP Datasphere or BDC (Business Data Cloud).
* Familiarity with Power BI or Tableau from a BW data consumer perspective.
* Experience with SAP RISE or cloud\-hosted BW environments.
* Prior experience in multi\-region SAP BW engagements (MEU / AMEA / Global).
* Knowledge of cloud data platforms beyond Databricks: Snowflake, GCP BigQuery, etc.
* Prior consulting experience in a system integrator or Big 4 environment.

Certifications (Valued)


* SAP Certified – Data Architect – SAP Business Data Cloud
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate / Professional
* Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP\-203\)
* Google Professional Data Engineer
* SAP Certified Technology Associate – SAP HANA

Education


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent professional experience considered.

*This position may require domestic and international travel as needed to meet business and client requirements.*  

  

*Selected applicant will be subject to a background investigation, which will be conducted and the results of which will be used in compliance with applicable law.*
  

  

*Lemongrass Consulting is an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, religious creed, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, genetic information, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
  

  

**About Lemongrass**
**Lemongrass** is a global SAP\-focused Cloud services provider helping some of the world’s most recognized Enterprises modernize and transform their SAP environments. We combine deep technical expertise with automation, innovation, and AI to deliver meaningful business outcomes.
  

  

Our work spans SAP Cloud migrations, managed services, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Business Data Cloud (BDC), and AI\-enabled solutions. We help customers build clean core strategies, intelligent data foundations, and scalable Cloud operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and SAP Cloud ERP.
  

  

Founded in 2010, Lemongrass has grown into a trusted partner to SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and Google, earning top\-tier partner designations along the way including SAP Gold Partner, Premier AWS Partner, Microsoft Gold Partner, and Google Cloud Partner. Our teams operate across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, collaborating to solve complex challenges for global Enterprises.
  

  

At Lemongrass, you’ll work alongside Cloud architects, engineers, and innovators who are shaping the future of SAP in the Cloud—within a culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous growth.

**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As Specialist of HPC Cloud Engineering, you will maintain and support HPC solutions in the cloud using IaC, CICD, job schedulers (both cloud and on\-premise), researcher pipelines, and cloud\-native services. Automate low\-value tasks to allow scientists to focus on high\-value work, leveraging elastic cloud resources to accelerate workflows. Optimize HPC resource availability, its performance and cloud costs. Collaborate with senior HPC SMEs, Application Support Engineers, and research stakeholders to reduce cycle times, boost efficiencies, and enhance UX, increasing researcher capacity.
   

  

 Ultimately, you will play a key role in implementing scalable and efficient solutions on AWS to support compute\-intensive applications. We are looking for an individual with passion for HPC and motivated to provide worldclass HPC experience to enable research scientists to use the power of leading\-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Deploy, maintain and support high\-performance computing clusters, platforms and AWS managed services.
* Monitor and maintain the performance of HPC cluster resources in both on premises and AWS, ensuring high availability, reliability and user experience.
* Optimize compute and data workflows for performance and cost\-efficiency in cloud\-based HPC environments.
* Create scripts and tools for automating cluster deployment, monitoring, and management (e.g., using Terraform, Ansible, AWS CLI, etc.).
* Analyse and determine bottlenecks in HPC cloud environment, including network performance and parallel file systems.
* Diagnose and resolve issues in complex HPC environments, including job scheduling, software, and cloud infrastructure.
* Document processes, configurations, and best practices for HPC workloads in AWS and Linux environments.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and Hyderabad based Director, as well as collaborating with other teams.
* Participate in project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and project goals.


**What Should You Have**
* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3\-7 years of experience in HPC infrastructure engineering, working with network principles, and system administration for Linux/Unix servers.


**Primary Skills (must\-have)**
* Hands\-on proficiency in Linux operating systems, shell scripting, HPC architecture and job schedulers in a DevOps environment.
* Experience with job schedulers and orchestrators viz. GridEngine, PBS Pro, and Altair NavOps.
* Knowledge of network architectures and high\-speed interconnects.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and interpret complex data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey findings and recommendations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential risks.
* Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accurate assessments and reporting.
* Understanding of relevant regulations and compliance standards.
* Experience with disaster recovery, data backup solutions, and virtualization platforms
* Good problem\-solving skills
* Customer \& product\-centric mindset
* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed and hybrid environment


**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**
* Relevant certifications (ideally AWS)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals (virtual networks, VPNs, firewalls) and storage technologies
* Formal training in HPC.
* Experience with SLURM and AWS ParallelCluster.
* Computational Chemistry, Computational Biology or Imaging Processing domain knowledge.
* Experience with Atlassian stack.


 Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.

 We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. **Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Microsoft 365 Governance team is responsible for implementing, maturing, and maintaining the firm’s Microsoft 365 governance framework across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, M365 Groups, Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, and other integrated governance tools. The team manages the full lifecycle of governance — from establishing new processes and policies to enhancing and maturing existing controls — ensuring the Microsoft 365 environment remains secure, compliant, and scalable. The team also supports platform change management initiatives, drives structured governance programs, and provides Level 3 (L3\) support for complex governance and platform escalations.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 As a Microsoft Enterprise Solutions Engineer, you will:
   

  

* Governance Creation, Implementation \& Maturation
* Contribute to the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of governance processes and controls
* Build, implement, and iterate automated workflows and governance controls using AvePoint.
* Implement and evolve Microsoft Purview solutions (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, insider risk, data lifecycle).
* Create and maintain governance documentation, knowledge base articles, guides, training materials, and processes.
* Contribute to the governance roadmap by identifying gaps, proposing new controls, and driving improvements that mature the overall governance posture.
* 2 Governance Operations, BAU \& L3 Support
* Provide L3\-level support for complex governance solutions \& escalations.
* Troubleshoot advanced issues across SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Purview, AvePoint, and Power Platform.
* Perform assessments and implement improvements that mature overall workspace quality and reduce sprawl.
* Operate within Microsoft 365 admin centers (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, Entra, Purview) to carry out governance actions.
* Change Management \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Communicate governance updates, implementations, and maturity improvements.
* Support rollout and adoption of new governance enhancements (AvePoint workflows, Purview controls, admin center changes).
* Collaborate with global teams to ensure consistent governance implementation across regions.
* Act as an escalation point for governance exceptions, policy interpretations, and access\-related issues. Reporting, Analysis \& Insights
* Build, maintain and monitor dashboards tracking governance metrics, lifecycle status, maturity progress, risk areas, and sprawl reduction.
* Analyze Excel/Power BI/AvePoint/Purview data to generate insights that drive governance improvements.
* Provide concise, actionable recommendations and summaries for leadership decision\-making.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in Microsoft 365 governance and collaboration platforms.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, Entra ID, and related permissions and security concepts.
* Hands\-on experience in implementing and maturing Microsoft Purview policies, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention policies, and sensitivity labeling.
* Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and continuously enhance governance processes, frameworks, and documentation.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 migration initiatives.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for governance implementation, monitoring, and reporting.
* Proven experience providing Level 3 (L3\) operational support for complex platform and governance\-related issues.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and data\-driven analysis.
* Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

98074ec3.title: Customer Engagement Manager
98074ec3.description:
**What We Do**
 At GoGuardian, we're helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world's greatest challenges. Our award\-winning system of learning solutions is purpose\-built for K\-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.
   

  

**What It's Like to Work at GoGuardian**
 We are an outcomes\-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission\-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why "I love the people here" is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a Customer Engagement Manager to help identify and address customer engagement, adoption, and churn risks across GoGuardian's Curriculum and Instruction products.
   

  

 This is a data\-driven, customer\-facing role that combines customer investigation, analytics, product knowledge, and cross\-functional problem\-solving. You'll use customer and product data to identify strategic and at\-risk customers, deep dive into their behavior and engagement patterns to understand the underlying causes, and work with Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering to determine and drive appropriate actions.
   

  

 You'll also work directly with customers and customer\-facing teams to understand issues, answer questions, and support customers who require additional attention. This position sits within the Product Team and serves as a bridge between customers and the teams responsible for improving the product experience.
   

  

 This is a remote opportunity for candidates located in India and requires regular overlap with U.S. working hours.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Customer Engagement \& Risk Management (\~40%)**
* Partner with Customer Success to identify and support strategic and at\-risk customers.
* Maintain a data\-informed view of customer engagement, adoption, and churn risk.
* Provide support to identified at\-risk customers and help ensure their concerns are addressed.
* Participate in customer meetings and product discussions to understand customer goals and challenges.
* Help identify and drive actions that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention.


**Analytics \& Customer Investigation (\~20%)**
* Regularly examine dashboards and customer/product usage data to identify customers with declining engagement, adoption risks, or other signals of churn.
* Deep dive into individual customer behavior and usage patterns to understand why engagement or adoption is changing.
* Investigate customer history, product usage, and other relevant signals to identify root causes.
* Develop clear, actionable findings and recommendations based on customer and product data.
* Track the impact of actions taken and use data to determine whether customer engagement or risk is improving.
* Build and maintain a reliable, data\-informed list of customers requiring attention.


**Product Partnership \& Customer Advocacy (\~20%)**
* Bring customer findings, recurring issues, and product opportunities to Product Managers in a clear and actionable way.
* Partner with Product Management to investigate customer problems and validate potential solutions or workflows.
* Capture and synthesize customer feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring product challenges.
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Engineering when customer issues require deeper technical investigation or resolution.
* Validate new features and workflows with customers and share feedback to help improve the product experience.


**Cross\-Functional Customer \& Product Support (\~20%)**
* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address customer questions and issues.
* Help troubleshoot customer\-reported product and data issues and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Support customer data onboarding, integrations, and account maintenance where applicable.
* Communicate customer issues and findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Follow issues through to resolution and ensure relevant customer\-facing teams are kept informed.


**Who You Are**
* 3\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer\-facing SaaS role.
* Experience working directly with U.S.\-based customers and confidently leading customer conversations, presentations, and business reviews.
* Experience supporting or retaining strategic or at\-risk customers and understanding customer engagement or churn risk.
* Analytical and data\-driven, with experience using customer, product, or business data to identify risks, investigate customer behavior, and inform actions.
* Strong investigative and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to dig into customer issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate next steps.
* Familiarity with customer\-facing web applications, data integrations, APIs, and common web technologies, with the ability to troubleshoot issues and work effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to work effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering teams.
* Strong communication, relationship\-building, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and priorities.
* Comfortable learning new products, workflows, and technical concepts quickly.
* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of problems in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Ability and willingness to regularly work during required U.S. working hours.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in K\-12 education technology.
* Experience working with enterprise, strategic, or at\-risk customer accounts.
* Familiarity with student information systems (SIS), rostering systems, assessment platforms, or education data.
* Experience with SQL, APIs, data integrations, reporting tools, BI platforms, or CRM systems.
* Experience with Google Sheets or Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay, health insurance, accident insurance, life insurance, and a retirement savings plan.
* Paid annual leave, paid holidays, paid parental leave, paid leave for life events, and a paid year\-end holiday break.
* A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, wellness checks, and more…


*Plus the intangible:*
* A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
* Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.


 Please share this with your friends or co\-workers who may be interested in working at GoGuardian! We have multiple openings and are always looking for talented people.
   

  

 GoGuardian is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. GoGuardian does not discriminate against employees, applicants, interns or volunteers on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, sex, age, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, registered domestic partner status, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

e980639d.title: Success Architect
e980639d.description:
**Description**
**Salesforce Customer Success:**
 Salesforce’s worldwide Customer Success team is a global network of Salesforce employees and partners. Our sole mission is to ensure customer success. We work with our customers to build relationships, learn about their businesses, and drive value\-based results. Our motto for our customers is "Your Success is our Success"
   

  

* Job Description: Senior Success Archiect/Success Architect


**Role Description**
* Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long\-term business success.
* Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customer's first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational 'Guide' sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long\-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long\-term success.


**Key Responsibilities**
* As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will:
* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
* Innovate \& Solve Problems – Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs.
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI\-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive\-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi\-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI\-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C\-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI\-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership


**Basic Requirements**
* Solution Design \& Architecture
+ 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience
+ Strong working knowledge of Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
+ Experience participating in complex implementations and understanding integration principles.
+ Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
+ Familiarity with industry\- or vertical\-specific solutions (preferred).

* Communication \& Leadership
+ Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
+ Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
+ Proven ability to manage customer\-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly.
+ High proficiency in English.

* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving
+ Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
+ Provide data\-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
+ Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
+ Desired Technical Skills

* Sales Cloud Expertise
+ Strong functional and configuration knowledge of Sales Cloud features, including opportunity/pipeline management, forecasting, email integration and advanced capabilities such as Einstein Conversation Insights, Sales Engagement and Sales Performance Management.
+ Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.

* Data Management \& Integration
+ Proficient in understanding and troubleshooting data models, relationships (lookup/master\-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
+ Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third\-party connectors.

* Secure \& Scalable Architecture
+ Strong understanding of role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
+ Ability to review a customer's security model for common issues.
+ Skilled in identifying common anti\-patterns and escalating to senior architects for resolution.

* Salesforce Development
+ Ability to read, understand, and debug APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
+ Hands\-on development experience is a strong plus, but the primary focus is on configuration and troubleshooting.
+ Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.

* System Integration \& Extensibility
+ Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
+ Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.
+ Certifications

* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer\-facing role, with hands\-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI\-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI\-generated insights into executive\-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI
* Required: Salesforce Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant
* Desired: Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder
