f89c1bab.title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect / Engineer (Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform)
f89c1bab.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect / Engineer (Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform)
About Mastercard  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

About The Role  

Cloud Infrastructure Engineers at Mastercard design, build, and operate the foundational platforms that enable our product and service teams to deliver securely, reliably, and at scale. This role focuses on Azure\-based infrastructure, cloud\-native services, and automation that power transaction processing, analytics, developer productivity, and self\-service delivery across the enterprise.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical ownership and influence that extends beyond a single team. You will drive the design and evolution of complex platform capabilities, set technical direction for key areas of cloud infrastructure, and partner closely with engineering, security, and operations leaders to ensure platforms are scalable, resilient, and aligned with business goals. While still hands\-on, your impact is measured by the systems, standards, and teams you enable.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:  

* Provide technical leadership for complex cloud infrastructure and platform initiatives spanning multiple teams or services
* Own the architecture, design, and implementation of critical Azure infrastructure components and platform capabilities
* Define and evolve standards, patterns, and guardrails for secure, scalable, and operable cloud solutions
* Lead cross\-team technical discussions, driving alignment on design decisions and tradeoffs
* Enable and improve self\-service provisioning and developer platforms that reduce friction and increase team autonomy
* Anticipate and mitigate systemic risks related to reliability, security, scalability, and cost
* Guide and mentor Senior and Software Engineer II team members through design reviews, feedback, and technical coaching
* Partner closely with product, security, operations, and architecture stakeholders to translate business needs into platform solutions

  

All About You  

  

* Overall 8\-12 years of career experience in a similar field
* Extensive hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating Azure\-based cloud infrastructure at scale, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and platform services
* Deep expertise with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation, using tools such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent, with a strong emphasis on modularity, reuse, and policy enforcement
* Strong command of cloud security and networking concepts, including identity and access management, private networking, secure service boundaries, and defense\-in\-depth architectures
* Proven experience designing resilient, highly available, and fault\-tolerant platforms, with a strong understanding of failure modes and disaster recovery strategies
* Demonstrated ability to lead large or complex initiatives end\-to\-end, including authoring and reviewing technical designs, decomposing work, sequencing delivery, and managing safe production rollouts
* Treats operability and cost efficiency as core design principles, ensuring observability, auditing, and financial transparency are built into platform solutions
* Advanced troubleshooting skills, capable of diagnosing and resolving broad, cross\-system production issues with minimal guidance
* Strong experience with enterprise CI/CD and SDLC practices, including quality gates, change management, and automation at scale
* Clear, influential communicator able to document architectures, establish technical direction, and drive consensus across distributed teams
* Consistent track record of mentoring and elevating other engineers, raising technical quality and ownership across the team
* Pragmatic and collaborative leader who balances technical excellence with delivery needs and organizational realities
* Actively evaluates industry trends in cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering and applies them thoughtfully to Mastercard’s ecosystem

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

9161e867.description:
Job Description
  
  

R413867 Spclst , Solution Architecture
  
  

**Opportunity:**  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. • Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. • Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech CenteThe Lab Integration Platform is a critical enabler of digital transformation strategy, supporting secure, compliant, and efficient data exchange across laboratory systems.
  
  

About the Team
  
Our team deliver global CRM transformation with a goal to create a single, connected CRM experience across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.
  
Were building from the ground up — collaborating on global processes, integrating enterprise systems, and laying the foundation for continuous improvement, AI\-driven insights, and scalable growth.
  
Its an exciting time to join. Youll be part of a collaborative, cross\-functional team working at the intersection of business and technology, with real influence over what gets built and how it works.
  
  

The Role
  
  

As aSalesforce Technical Business Analystyou will act as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and our technical delivery teams in our Subscription Services Product Line. Youll work closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners and commercial business users to ensure that what we build is grounded in real business need, clearly documented, and delivered to a high standard.
  
This is a hands\-on role for someone who thrives on turning complex business problems into clear, actionable requirements — and who cares about getting the detail right. Youll be embedded in the delivery cycle from requirements through to release, with ownership of the quality and clarity of what goes into each sprint.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:****Requirements Documentation:**  

* Collaborate with commercial business teams and other business analysts todocument and validate requirements, ensuring they are clear, complete, and testable.
* Work with Solution Architects totranslate high\-level solution designs into actionable, sprint\-ready tickets for the development team.
* Supports the Solution Architect with maintenance of technicalprocess flows, data mappings, and supporting solution design documentation to clearly articulate the needs and resulting technical solution.
* Where necessary, writewell\-structured user stories with robust acceptance criteria using best\-practice formats (e.g.,As a… I need… so that… andGiven\-When\-Then).


**Delivery Quality:**  

* This role with act as a ‘quality gate’ ensuring that the requirements which reach our technical team meet our Definition of Ready will supportthe solution architect in reviewing user stories ahead of refinement build, ensuring stories meet a clear definition of ready before entering a sprint.
* Partner with QA to developtest scenarios and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring delivered functionality meets documented acceptance criteria.
* Own theSDLC, GxP and release management processes, ensuring all necessary documentation, approvals, and traceability are in place for each release.


Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Support the Technical Product Owner Solution Architects withday\-to\-day liaison between commercial business teams and the technical delivery team, ensuring alignment and managing expectations.
* Build strong relationships with Solution Architects, developers, and QA to ensure a shared understanding of what is being built and why.

8228901a.title: Program Manager - Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) & Business Continuity Planning (BCP)
8228901a.description:
**We need people from manufacturing background** 




**Role Purpose** 




 The Program Manager will establish the end\-to\-end ERM and BCP architecture for Tata Electronics and lead phased rollout across semiconductor manufacturing, OSAT, EMS, corporate functions, and support organizations. The role will create the governance model, standards, methods, templates, training approach, testing regime, and performance review cadence required to make business continuity a managed capability rather than a one\-time project.
 



 The role will also serve as the central integrator across Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, EHS, Facilities, IT, Information Security, HR, Finance, Legal, and site leadership to ensure continuity obligations are owned locally and governed centrally.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Build the enterprise ERM/BCP framework** 



* Design and deploy the enterprise ERM/BCP framework, policy structure, governance model, standards, procedures, templates, and review mechanisms for all Tata Electronics entities and sites.
* Define the minimum continuity architecture required at enterprise, business, function, department, and site level, including risk assessment, business impact analysis, recovery strategies, crisis management, plan documentation, testing, training, and annual refresh cycles.
* Establish a common methodology for risk identification, prioritization, treatment, and monitoring using fit\-for\-purpose approaches such as FMEA, risk registers, dependency mapping, scenario analysis, and control plans.



**2\. Drive execution through assigned owners across the organization** 



* Create and operationalize a federated delivery model with named BCP coordinators, function representatives, department continuity owners, and site taskforce leads across each business and manufacturing location.
* Drive implementation through these assignees by issuing charters, RACI structures, milestone plans, workshop calendars, templates, and closure trackers, while holding owners accountable for quality and timeliness of deliverables.
* Chair or coordinate recurring review forums with business and function assignees to monitor readiness, action closure, overdue items, testing progress, risk escalation, and management reporting.
* Ensure every critical process has an identified owner, alternate owner, documented recovery requirements, upstream and downstream dependency mapping, and current continuity actions.



**3\. Lead risk assessment and business impact analysis** 



* Direct organization\-wide risk assessments covering operational, supply chain, facility, utility, EHS, cyber, information security, logistics, quality, workforce, and external ecosystem risks relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
* Lead business impact analysis with function owners to identify critical products, processes, assets, infrastructure, information, skills, suppliers, and services; define impact tolerances; and determine RTO, RPO, MTPD, and minimum resource requirements where relevant.
* Consolidate departmental outputs into enterprise views for prioritization, management review, and investment decisions.



**4\. Develop and institutionalize recovery and crisis capabilities** 



* Build recovery strategies for priority scenarios such as utility outages, equipment failures, cleanroom incidents, chemical events, IT disruptions, cyber incidents, supplier failures, logistics interruptions, natural disasters, labor shortages, and infrastructure breakdowns.
* Define crisis management structures, escalation criteria, notification protocols, communication flows, command\-center practices, and decision rights for enterprise, business, and site incidents.
* Ensure continuity plans are practical, role\-based, version\-controlled, and linked to trigger conditions, response actions, recovery steps, communication paths, and restart criteria.



**5\. Build certification and audit readiness** 



* Translate continuity and risk requirements into management\-system\-ready processes and records that support ISO 9001 risk\-based thinking, IATF 16949 contingency planning, ISO 27001 information security during disruption, and ICT readiness during disruption.
* Partner with Quality, Information Security, and Compliance teams to map BCP controls to clause requirements, create evidence repositories, define ownership of mandatory records, and prepare internal teams for audits and customer assessments.
* Establish a documented evidence trail for reviews, exercises, risk assessments, contingency plans, communication logs, corrective actions, plan updates, and management review inputs.
* Support audit responses, nonconformity closure, and remediation planning related to continuity, contingency, and resilience requirements.



**6\. Build testing, exercising, and readiness assurance** 



* Create an annual continuity exercise program that includes tabletop exercises, functional drills, site simulations, cyber\-disruption scenarios, supplier disruption scenarios, and post\-event reviews.
* Define testing coverage, pass/fail criteria, observation methods, issue logging, CAPA tracking, and retest requirements to demonstrate plan effectiveness.
* Establish readiness dashboards and KPI/KRI mechanisms for plan completion, exercise closure, overdue actions, recovery capability, risk heat maps, supplier dependency coverage, and training completion.



**7\. Integrate supply chain, IT, and manufacturing continuity** 



* Work with Supply Chain and Procurement teams to assess critical supplier resilience, alternate source strategies, logistics contingencies, inventory buffers, and communication protocols for supply continuity.
* Coordinate with IT and Information Security to align enterprise BCP with disaster recovery, cyber response, backup, access recovery, application recovery, and information security continuity requirements.
* Partner with Facilities, EHS, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality to ensure continuity strategies reflect fab realities such as utilities, contamination control, process qualification, equipment readiness, tool recovery, and safe restart sequencing.



**8\. Lead capability building and change management** 



* Develop training and awareness programs for executives, site leaders, functional assignees, crisis teams, and process owners so that continuity responsibilities are clearly understood and practiced.
* Build the organization’s continuity culture by embedding BCP requirements into business reviews, operating procedures, onboarding, leadership routines, and annual planning cycles.
* Coach local owners on plan quality, scenario thinking, evidence preparation, and corrective\-action discipline.



**Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 14 or more years of experience in program management, operations, risk management, quality systems, supply chain resilience, or business continuity, with significant experience in semiconductor manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, automotive electronics, or similarly complex industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience building and rolling out enterprise or multi\-site BCP, contingency planning, ERM, crisis management, or resilience programs from the ground up.
* Proven success driving execution through matrixed stakeholders, site representatives, and function owners rather than relying only on direct reporting lines.
* Experience supporting management\-system compliance, customer audits, or certification readiness in regulated or high\-reliability manufacturing environments.



**Technical and Functional Expertise** 



* Strong command of business continuity lifecycle elements including governance, risk assessment, business impact analysis, recovery strategy development, crisis management, exercising, corrective action, and continual improvement.
* Strong working knowledge of risk\-based thinking under ISO 9001, contingency planning expectations under IATF 16949, and information security continuity requirements under ISO 27001\.
* Ability to connect continuity requirements to manufacturing, supply chain, quality, EHS, IT, cybersecurity, and supplier\-management processes.
* Experience with structured methods such as FMEA, CAPA, management review, internal audit, action tracking, and process mapping.



**Leadership Capabilities** 



* Strong program leadership with the ability to drive enterprise\-wide initiatives across multiple businesses, sites, and senior stakeholders.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, escalation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to translate high\-level resilience goals into practical deployment plans, role clarity, measurable milestones, and sustainable governance.
* High level of discipline in follow\-through, documentation quality, and operating cadence.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Risk Management, Quality, Information Security, or a related discipline.
* Relevant certifications preferred, such as CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, PMP, ASQ, or equivalent.



**Success Measures** 



* Enterprise ERM/BCP governance established and functioning with clear role ownership across businesses, departments, and sites.
* Department and site assignees trained, active, and meeting defined deliverables and review cadence.
* Critical process BIA, risk assessments, and continuity plans completed to agreed quality standards.
* Exercise program implemented with measurable improvement in readiness and corrective\-action closure.
* Documented audit readiness for continuity\-related expectations linked to ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 27001, and internal governance requirements.
* Increased visibility of enterprise risks, dependencies, recovery capabilities, and unresolved gaps for leadership decision\-making.



**Role Impact** 




 This role is central to building Tata Electronics’ resilience capability as the company scales across advanced manufacturing operations. Success in the role will create a disciplined, auditable, and execution\-driven continuity system that protects customers, employees, assets, data, supply assurance, and operational recovery during disruption

5f6d1406.title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
5f6d1406.description:
**Description**
 The WW FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain, Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain, Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in country Business Review forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build an evidence\-based product and program roadmap.
* Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES\-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
* Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress\-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
* Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in\-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country\-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources or related field
* 
* Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end\-to\-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross\-functional teams to drive improvement
* 
* Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
* 
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
* 
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
* 
* Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 
* Experience in inventory planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor\-facing operations at scale
* 
* Familiarity with generic inventory systems — including placement logic, restock recommendations, capacity management, or seller\-facing tools
* 
* Experience working in or closely with non\-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
* 
* Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

****About MISUMI Americas****
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

We’re creating a faster, smarter, AI\-enabled way to go from design to production, backed by global scale, deep supply chain expertise, and a culture that moves with startup speed. For builders, problem\-solvers, and people who want to make a real impact, this is a rare opportunity to help transform how the world makes things.

 To Lead a Vehicle Platform or Variant for Vehicle NVH Simulation.

fa9d5e40.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
fa9d5e40.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.



As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.



You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.


* Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
* Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
* Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.


Key job responsibilities


* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one\-to\-few and one\-to\-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer\-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support


A day in the life


* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures


About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.



The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up\-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry\-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. * Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.

* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.

* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.


All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

Major market\-leading companies rely on Couchbase for mission critical operational, analytical, mobile and AI workloads. Built to replace legacy infrastructure and fragmented data services, Couchbase empowers enterprises with a unified platform architected for performance, flexibility and global scale.
   

  

 With Couchbase, organizations bring their data to life, launching game‑changing customer experiences, exploring the limitless potential of AI, and seamlessly extending applications from the cloud to the edge and beyond. Couchbase’s AI‑ready technology and enterprise partnership model eliminate complexity and reduce total cost of ownership, enabling teams to stay agile, innovative and secure.
   

  

 Couchbase believes data should never slow you down, but act as the foundation for your next breakthrough. Discover why Couchbase is trusted to help the world’s biggest players scale, move fast and stay resilient, no matter what’s next on their roadmap. Visit couchbase.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Want to be part of our story? Apply today!
   

  

**Sr Solutions Engineer**
 We are looking for a Sr Solution Engineer in Mumbai to support the rapidly growing Couchbase user community and help drive customer success.
   

  

 Our Solution (Pre\-Sales) Engineers are the primary technical field experts, responsible for actively driving and managing the technical components of a sales engagement. This includes explaining Couchbase advantages and differentiators, and how our Couchbase solutions stack meets these customer challenges, all while getting customers excited about using this new approach for delivering consistent business value.
   

  

 This specific position focuses on assisting customers who interact with our technology via application code and the application development process. This development centric position requires experience in presales, software development experience as well as time developing business solutions. Experience with one or more Enterprise Programming Languages and Solution Development methodologies.
   

  

**Location: Mumbai**
**Responsibilities**
* Operate in a consultative process with customers and prospects to define their challenges and opportunities. Map these challenges to the Couchbase Ecosystem by presenting differentiating and sustainable business value.
* Educate and become a trusted advisor and challenge assumptions and current status while delivering value to the prospects and customers.
* Present art of the possible and think outside the box approaches and solutions.
* Support technical and business discovery activities including workshops, demonstrations, across multiple opportunities
* Work closely with the sales team on account strategy and identifying additional opportunities in existing and new accounts. Ensuring the success of customer PoC/Pilots through effective management of acceptance criteria and issue escalation/resolution.
* Develop and deliver exceptional and engaging company/product presentations and demonstrations. Work with all technical levels from managers, to architects and developers and explain the Couchbase Ecosystem and its applicability to business objectives and business value
* Be the technical product expert and advisor for customers and stay up\-to\-date on the data solutions competitive landscape
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to provide feedback from the field and represent the customer perspective
* Identify and write internal and external technical collateral, like typical deployment architectures or best practices and industry standards.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years in a Pre\-Sales/Customer\-Facing/Consulting Role
* 2\+ years of experience in software development or related industries
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases or other distributed high\-performance systems
* Excellent presentation skills with an ability to present technical solutions concisely to customers or potential customers all the way from development roles to the C\-Suite
* Passion for diving into technical issues and solving customer challenges
* Programming skills with any one of the following: Java, Python, Javascript, .NET. C, SQL
* Experienced in at least one of the major cloud services providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Experienced in designing solutions on at least one major database platform including data modeling, indexes and query optimization.


 Desirables
   

  

* Experience with virtualization and containerization technologies (i.e. Docker, Kubernetes, Openshift, Containers etc)

* Hands on experience with development at large scale


 At Couchbase, we believe innovation thrives when diverse perspectives are at the table. We actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds—including women, people of color, LGTBQIA\+ professionals, veterans, and individuals with disabilities. If you see a role that excites you, but don’t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

**Why Couchbase?**
**Benefits**
 Modern customer experiences need a flexible cloud database platform that can power applications spanning from cloud to edge and everything in between. Couchbase’s mission is to simplify how developers and architects develop, deploy and consume modern applications wherever they are. We have reimagined the database with our fast, flexible and affordable cloud database platform Capella, allowing organizations to quickly build applications that deliver premium experiences to their customers– all with best\-in\-class price performance. More than 30% of the Fortune 100 trust Couchbase to power their modern applications and build innovative new ones. See our recent awards to learn why Couchbase is a great place to work.We are honored to be a part of the Best Places to Work Award for the Bay Area and the UK. Couchbase offers a total rewards approach to benefits that recognizes the value you create here, so that you in turn may best serve yourself and your family. Some benefits include:
   

  

* Generous Time Off Program \- Flexibility to care for you and your family
* Wellness Benefits \- A variety of world class medical plans to choose from, along with dental, vision, life insurance, and employee assistance programs\*
* Financial Planning \- Retirement program\* and Business Travel Insurance

fdd33704.title: Solutions Architect (India)
fdd33704.description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architecture Team partners with our users to realize their full potential through the adoption of prescriptive solutions that drive their growth and success.
   

  

 We work with founders, C\-level executives, finance leaders, product design and engineering teams at large global brands and platforms who are building financial services solutions with Stripe. We work closely with Account Executives, Professional Services, Customer Success Managers, Partners, Technical Account Managers Product, and Engineering teams to develop and execute on the account strategy for Stripe in market.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 You will be building trusted relationships with brand new founders to the C\-suite, and solving mission\-critical business challenges for our users. You will be building new business models and help expand existing ones with users of all shapes and sizes in the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support key technical engagements for Stripe in India
* Drive thought leadership and be a trusted advisor for key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO, Head of Product Engineering, and Head of Payments.
* Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives, and then design and apply Stripe’s solutions to their challenges. Develop and articulate the end to end customer transformation journey and create future roadmaps and architectures with deep 3rd party integrations in play.
* Lead strategy engagements with users to align to business priorities, design solutions and secure the technical win by performing in\-depth customer discovery, evangelizing the proposed solutions through executive briefings, readouts, presentations and solution demos.
* Bring understanding of the regional market to our Product and Engineering organizations by acting as the “Voice of the User” to bring insights, trends and opportunities to the leadership, product and engineering teams.
* Participate in sales forecasting, Quarterly Business Reviews and account/territory planning to strategically and tactically align for success.
* Act as a crucial part of the sales team, providing technical insight and solutions to prospective and existing platform users. Guide and provide technical expertise on Stripe and its benefits.
* Showcase the capability of Stripe's platform in solving business problems, highlighting features, benefits, and potential customizations.
* Manage pre\-sales projects, coordinating proof of concept development, and feasibility checks. Ensure all solutions proposed are viable, beneficial to our potential clients, and also accommodating to their customers.


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in a similar customer\-facing engineering role such as solution consultant, solutions architect, or sales engineer, for a global software enterprise.
* Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
* Effective group\-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.
* Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and API architecture.
* Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confidence in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Gather an in\-depth understanding of all of Stripe’s products and their applicability across diverse business models to beneficially cater to individual clients' and their customers' needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* \* Experience as a customer facing, domain expert in the payments space, presenting, and architecting solutions for platform customers.
+ Prior experience driving technical sales and supporting them and their customer’s unique requirements
+ Can read, write, and understand code in one to many programming languages
+ Experience with integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.
+ Experience in systems design, building and deploying complex applications.
+ Passionate about learning and actively seeks out knowledge
+ Ability to work independently and confidently to develop a path forward with customers under ambiguous circumstances.
+ Strategic and creative thinker who can proactively identify challenges and maintain a positive approach when facing difficult obstacles.
+ Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with extended global teams to support our users.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

3d4b88a5.title: Pre-Sales Technical Specialist, ACI Growth
3d4b88a5.description:
Job Title
   

  

 Pre\-Sales Technical Specialist, ACI Growth
   

  

**Job Description**
 In this position, you will provide pre\-sales technical leadership for the Philips Capsule Medical Device Information (MDI), IntelliBridge Enterprise (IBE), IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA), eCareManager (eCM), and Clinical Insight Manager (CIM) product lines, supporting growth across India, APAC, and META.
   

  

**Minimum Required Education**
 Bachelor's/master’s degree in computer science or a health science, or equivalent.
   

  

**Minimum Required Experience**
 Minimum of 4 years of experience working within a commercial capacity in the Healthcare Technology, Healthcare Analytics, or Information Technology area.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Act as the primary technical expert for ACI products, with a focus on Capsule MDI, in assigned regions during presales engagements and supporting the sales team with any technical support.
* Own solution architecture design, sizing, assumptions and technical risk identification for opportunities.
* Actively participate in documentation during the pre\-sales process, such as Solution Design Documents (SDD), Solution Architectures, and Statements of Work.
* Take ownership and provide feedback on pre\-sales artifacts, including document repositories, demonstrations, proof\-of\-concept (POC) environments and bundles.
* Maintain knowledge of market trends, healthcare interoperability standards, competitive offerings and industry best practices.
* Support competitive analysis activities and provide technical differentiation against competitor solutions.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution walkthroughs, site assessments and demonstrations with customers and partners.
* Define end\-to\-end data flows from bedside devices via the Capsule MDIP to third\-party solutions, such as CIS and EMR systems.
* Provide pre\-sales expertise across:
+ Capsule MDI platform, including device integrations
+ IBE/Interoperability (HL7, ADT/ORU, downstream systems)
+ IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA)
+ eCare Manager (eCM)
+ Clinical Insights Manager (CIM)
+ While also supporting other products within the ACI portfolio

* Conduct detailed workflow assessments, device connectivity assessments and technical site surveys to validate solution feasibility and implementation assumptions.
* Ensure alignment with hospital IT organisations across security, networking, infrastructure and availability requirements.
* Participate in handover to delivery (HTD) to ensure clarity and solution intent, including assisting implementation and delivery when necessary.
* Contribute to deal governance, risk reviews, and internal approvals for any sales opportunities.
* Be the subject matter expert (SME) for Capsule MDI across META and India.
* Additional responsibilities for providing pre\-sales expertise for the IntelliBridge Enterprise and Clinical Insight Manager.
* Ability and willingness to travel across India, META and APAC markets as required to support customer engagements, workshops and demonstrations.


**You’re the right fit if**
* You have hands\-on experience supporting, designing, implementing, or selling healthcare software solutions such as Clinical Information Systems (CIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), Medical Device Integration platforms, interoperability solutions, or clinical analytics platforms.
* You have experience presenting, designing, influencing and advising customers on complex technical solutions throughout the sales lifecycle, from discovery and qualification through solution design, proposal development and technical validation.
* You have a strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud platforms, cybersecurity principles, healthcare interoperability and integration technologies, including HL7, FHIR, APIs, SQL, XML/JSON, ADT/ORM/ORU workflows.
* You are an effective communicator who can clearly articulate both technical concepts and business value to clinical, technical, and executive stakeholders.
* You are self\-motivated, adaptable and collaborative, with a willingness to learn, embrace new challenges, work across multiple cultures and geographies, and contribute to a high\-performing regional team.


**How We Work Together**
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.
   

  

 Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities.
   

  

 Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
   

  

 Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role.
   

  

**About Philips**
 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
   

  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.


 If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.
   

  

 \#connectedcare

04897350.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
04897350.description:
Our Purpose
   

  

 At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
   

  

**About Us**
 SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
   

  

 Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
   

  

**What Are We Looking For?**
 We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
   

  

 As Senior Solution Engineer, you will work with prospects and customers, aligning their goals and requirements with the SentinelOne offerings. SentinelOne is seeking a security pre\-sales engineer with expertise in security operations focused on prevention, EDR, Cloud native security, SIEM/SOAR, and Threat Hunting. We need a self\-starter who excels in a high\-paced environment and thrives on pitching revolutionary technology to executives and security practitioners.
   

  

 This individual will be instrumental in accelerating our sales initiatives in India. Candidates should ideally be based in Delhi NCR.
   

  

 What Will You Do?
   

  

 Primary responsibilities include:
   

  

* Act as a technical advisor for our sales teams and the technical point of contact during the sales cycle, participating in discovery calls, running customised demonstrations, and providing technical insight and, where required, Proof of value (POVs) to our prospects and customers when requested.
* Being a thought leader and advisor, you will give technical cybersecurity advice and guidance to our customers while building strong relationships with prospects.
* Achieve mastery of all SentinelOne technologies and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of industry, technical and competitive landscape to ensure the presentation and sale of SentinelOne solutions.
* Effective technical sales coverage of the account base
* Provide guidance on complex technical solutions utilising in\-depth knowledge of SentinelOne, products, industry and solutions
* Present \& evangelise SentinelOne technologies at industry, partner or customer events.


 What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
   

  

 Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

* At least five years experience in cyber security, preferably security operations, offensive/defense security or Cloud security
* At least 2 years of vendor presales solution engineering/architecture experience
* Demonstrable experience in objection handling and positioning against competitive technologies
* Demonstrable experience speaking to both small and large audiences
* Concise written and oral communication skills to effectively lead business and technical presentations, demonstrations, and conversations with both executives and technical audiences
* Must have demonstrable experience successfully selling to mid\-to\-large customers
* Technical experience in one or more of the following areas:
+ Endpoint Protection
+ Endpoint Detection and Response
+ Data Analytics, SIEM, SOAR and Security Automation
+ Cloud\-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) including Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Service Network Security (CSNS), and Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP)

* Must have basic knowledge of hacking and exploitation tools and methodologies, detection evasion techniques, notable malware, and anti\-malware solutions and techniques.
* Team\-focused approach and positive attitude are a must
* Experience working in computer forensics, security architect, penetration/red teamer, or incident responder is a plus.
* Experience with cloud solutions such as AWS, Azure, and GCP a plus.
* Travel up to 30% possible.


 Why SentinelOne?
   

  

 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
   

  

 We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
   

  

**Equity \& Rewards**
* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)


**Time Off \& Wellbeing**
* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender\-neutral parental leave


**Insurance \& Financial Security**
* Medical and insurance benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


**Work Perks \& Flexibility**
* Global home office allowance
* Internet allowance
* LinkedIn Learning license
* Social Connect program
* Food allowance (Bangalore office)
* Meal vouchers (Sodexo)


**Wellness \& Lifestyle**
* Health \& wellness benefit


 SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

d45de32d.title: Senior Staff Engineer - Solutions Architect
d45de32d.description:
ConceptVines is seeking an experienced Senior Staff Engineer \- Solutions Architect to lead the technical architecture of the intelligent systems developed for its partners. This role extends beyond ongoing systems maintenance; the successful candidate will determine how AI, ML, and related technologies are integrated into platforms from initial design, working closely with development teams, business stakeholders, and venture partners to translate strategic objectives into scalable, secure, production\-grade solutions.
 



 The Senior Solutions Architect will be responsible for converting early\-stage concepts into actionable technical roadmaps.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Architecture \& Solution Design** 




 •       Design and implement AI/ML\-driven solutions that are scalable, secure, and engineered to perform under real\-world conditions
 



 •       Define technical requirements and architectural blueprints in collaboration with developers, project managers, and business stakeholders
 



 •       Prepare detailed technical specifications that translate ambiguous requirements into executable plans
 



 •       Develop strategies for data storage, security, and performance optimization across the technology stack
 



  





**Technical Leadership \& Governance** 




 •       Lead technical discussions and architecture reviews to ensure development teams adhere to established architectural standards
 



 •       Establish frameworks for cross\-departmental contributions to prevent solutions from being developed in isolation
 



 •       Evaluate project constraints, including risk, time, resources, and scope, to mitigate potential challenges
 



 •       Define clear objectives for each initiative and oversee their successful execution
 



  





**Continuous Improvement** 




 •       Assess current technologies in use and identify concrete opportunities for modernization or optimization
 



 •       Document and monitor requirements associated with proposed system updates
 



 •       Monitor initiative progress in close coordination with project management teams
 



 •       Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date technical documentation as an ongoing responsibility
 



 Technology \& Trend Ownership
 



 •       Maintain awareness of developments in AI/ML and related fields, incorporating relevant advances into the organization's architecture
 



  





**Candidate Requirements** 




**Required Qualifications** 




 •       14–20 years of experience designing and developing applications using modern, production\-grade technologies
 



 •       Substantial hands\-on experience with AI/ML algorithms, data processing, and data storage architecture
 



 •       Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying solutions on cloud infrastructure
 



 •       Strong working knowledge of system security best practices
 



 •       Established experience in software engineering and architectural design
 



 •       Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, together with the communication skills required to convey technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders
 



 •       Ability to work effectively both independently and within cross\-functional teams
 



 •       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
 



 Preferred Qualifications
 



 •       Advanced business analysis experience, with the ability to connect architectural decisions to business outcomes
 



 •       Broad exposure to operating systems, computer hardware, and infrastructure environments
 



 •       Prior experience within a venture\-backed, product engineering, or innovation\-lab environment
 



  





**What Distinguishes This Role** 




 At many organizations, the Solutions Architect function is limited to integrating new technologies into existing legacy systems. At ConceptVines, the role involves architecting original solutions for BFSI, Manufacturing, and Healthcare partners who are actively pursuing disruptive innovation rather than maintaining the status quo. The successful candidate will engage directly with venture\-backed innovators, contribute to AI/ML, Web3, AR/VR, and Quantum Computing initiatives, and help establish architectural standards for a newly formed innovation hub in Chennai.
 



  





**Application Process** 




 Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume along with a brief summary of a significant technical challenge addressed within the past two years. A cover letter is not required.
 


* *ConceptVines is committed to building a diverse, innovative team and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.*

a04d71a2.title: Senior Solutions Architect
a04d71a2.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.


**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
