50aa688d.title: Field Architect
50aa688d.description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer\-facing technical leadership position focused on defining, validating, and guiding AIStor architectures for AI, analytics, cloud\-native applications, and large\-scale data infrastructure. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, translating business and application requirements into robust technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with the broader MinIO team to ensure customers are successful through technical discovery, architecture design, proof\-of\-value execution, production onboarding, performance validation, and long\-term expansion. Success in this role requires deep technical curiosity, hands\-on architecture skills, strong communication, and the ability to connect AIStor’s capabilities to the data\-intensive workloads that matter most to our customers.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Technical Leadership \& Architecture
   

  

* Technical Architecture and Discovery: Lead technical discovery with customers and partners to understand their business goals, application requirements, data architecture, infrastructure constraints, and success criteria. Define scalable AIStor architectures that map directly to those requirements.
* AI and Analytics Workload Design: Define and validate AIStor architectures for AI/ML training and inference, analytics platforms, data lakehouse environments, high\-performance data pipelines, large object workloads, and modern application data services.
* Object Storage and S3 Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in object storage, S3\-compatible architectures, distributed systems, metadata, replication, erasure coding, security, performance tuning, and large\-scale namespace design.


 Customer Engagement \& Advisory
   

  

* Customer Technical Advisor: Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, including infrastructure, platform, analytics, AI, security, application, and operations teams. Guide customers toward informed architecture decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, resilience, scale, and operational efficiency.
* Proof\-of\-Value Execution: Lead technical evaluations, system configurations, performance testing, interoperability validation, and proof\-of\-value engagements that demonstrate AIStor’s value in real customer environments.
* Customer Success Beyond the Win: Partner with Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering teams to help customers move from evaluation to production and from initial deployment to broader adoption across additional workloads, teams, and use cases.


 Ecosystem, Enablement \& Field Operations
   

  

* Cloud\-Native and Kubernetes Guidance: Provide technical leadership on Kubernetes, containers, automation, and cloud\-native deployment patterns, including hybrid cloud, private cloud, public cloud, and edge infrastructure models.
* Solution Integration and Ecosystem Collaboration: Work with technology partners, reseller partners, and customer teams to support complete solutions involving analytics engines, AI platforms, Kubernetes distributions, data protection tools, identity systems, observability platforms, and public cloud services.
* Technical Presentations and Enablement: Build and deliver compelling architecture presentations, whiteboard sessions, demonstrations, best practices, workshops, and technical enablement sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* RFP, RFI, and Technical Response Support: Contribute to or lead technical portions of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, security reviews, architecture questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.


 Product Intelligence \& Market Expertise
   

  

* Product and Engineering Feedback: Advocate for customer requirements internally by capturing field feedback, competitive insights, workload patterns, integration needs, and enhancement opportunities. Work with Product and Engineering teams to help inform roadmap priorities and improve customer outcomes.
* Competitive and Market Expertise: Stay current on object storage, data lakehouse, AI infrastructure, analytics, Kubernetes, cloud, and competitive storage trends. Help internal teams and customers understand where AIStor is differentiated.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong background in enterprise storage, object storage, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or high\-performance data\-intensive applications.
* Strong understanding of object storage concepts and S3\-compatible architectures; experience with HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, security models, replication, data protection, and scale\-out system design is highly valuable.
* 10\+ years of experience in a senior customer\-facing technical role such as Field Architect, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Technical Consultant.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux, networking, storage systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and modern data center infrastructure.
* Experience designing or supporting AI, machine learning, analytics, data lakehouse, or large\-scale data pipeline environments.
* Familiarity with ecosystem technologies such as Databricks, Starburst, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Kafka, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI and analytics frameworks is a strong plus.
* Experience with public cloud and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, or private cloud platforms.
* Ability to conduct technical discovery, design architectures, build demonstrations, guide proof\-of\-value execution, analyze performance, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
* Comfortable working with heterogeneous enterprise environments involving compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and application teams.
* Strong verbal, written, whiteboarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively across customers, partners, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering teams.
* Strong customer\-success orientation, intellectual curiosity, sense of ownership, and ability to prioritize effectively in a fast\-moving environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support customers, partners, field events, and internal team activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.


**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

7712c709.title: Sr. Program Manager
7712c709.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 Position Title
 



 Program Manager
 



 Department
 



 Engineering
 



 Reports To
 



 Engineering Manager
 



 Direct Reports
 


* Nil standing direct reports; a graduate engineer or program coordinator may be assigned.
* Matrix leadership of cross\-functional program teams drawn from Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial.



  





 Position Overview
 



 The Program Manager is accountable for the delivery of Microair Avionics' OEM customer programs and internal development projects, several running concurrently at different stages of maturity.
 



 Based at Microair's Indore facility and working across the company's Australian, US, Irish and Indian operations, the role converts customer commitments into achievable plans, keeps those plans honest as they meet reality, and removes whatever stands between the delivery team and the outcome.
 



 Authority is held over program scope, schedule baseline, budget and risk disposition within the approved contract, and the position is the delegated voice of Microair to the customer on program matters.
 



 Leadership is exercised through influence rather than line authority: the team creates the value, and the Program Manager's job is to enable it.
 



 Key Responsibilities1\. Program Ownership
 



 Hold end\-to\-end accountability for multiple concurrent OEM delivery programs and development projects, from contract award through certification to entry into service and closeout.
 



 2\. Scope Translation \& Planning
 



 Dissect the customer statement of work into a detailed, resourced and achievable plan — work breakdown, schedule, milestones and dependencies — expressed so the delivery team and the customer work from the same picture.
 



 3\. Team Enablement
 



 Operate on the basis that the team creates customer and company value, not the manager. Clear roadblocks, protect focus, and secure the resources and decisions the team is waiting on, including those held in another time zone.
 



 4\. Influence Without Authority
 



 Secure commitment, priority and follow\-through from peers and their teams across Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial — and across the Indian, Australian, Irish and US sites — without relying on positional authority.
 



 5\. Customer Engagement
 



 Act as the principal customer\-facing contact for assigned programs and represent Microair credibly at OEM design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and program gates, contributing to the technical discussion rather than deferring it.
 



 6\. Risk \& Opportunity Management
 



 Run living risk and opportunity registers on every program, on the basis that unmanaged risk is the most likely cause of schedule slip. Own mitigations to closure and pursue opportunities with equal discipline.
 



 7\. Schedule, Cost \& Revenue
 



 Own program schedule, cost and revenue performance. Maintain credible forecasts, manage milestone claims and revenue timing, and escalate early and with options.
 



 8\. Change \& Variation Control
 



 Identify scope change as it emerges, assess the schedule and cost impact, and agree variations with the customer before the work is quietly absorbed.
 



 9\. Value Realisation
 



 Define how the value created by each program is measured, and test that against what the customer expects and pays for, so any gap surfaces while there is still time to act.
 



 Skills \& ExperienceEducation
 


* Bachelor degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in engineering or a related technical discipline — essential.
* Formal program or project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) — desirable.
* A substantial delivery track record is accepted in lieu of formal qualifications.



 Experience
 


* Minimum 8 years in engineering or technical delivery, including 4 years managing programs in their own right — essential.
* Demonstrated ownership of several concurrent customer programs and development projects — essential.
* Met schedule, cost and revenue commitments on fixed\-price and milestone\-based contracts — essential.
* Managed distributed teams and customers across Indian, Australian, European and US time zones — essential.
* Fluent professional English; willing to travel internationally to customer and Microair sites — essential.
* Aerospace or avionics background — desirable; equivalent experience in another regulated safety\-critical domain (defence electronics, automotive functional safety, medical devices, rail) is accepted.
* Exposure to STC and TSO/ETSO certification schedules — desirable.



 System Knowledge
 


* Scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera or equivalent) and Microsoft 365 to intermediate Excel — essential.
* Yogi for requirements and Xray for verification traceability, sufficient to read program status from the tools rather than from status meetings — desirable.
* Dynamics 365 Business Central for cost, purchasing and material visibility — desirable.
* Aircraft systems and avionics architecture sufficient to hold a technical conversation with an OEM; working awareness of ARP4754B, ARP4761A, DO\-160, DO\-178C and DO\-254 — valued.



 Benefits:
 


* Paid sick time
* Paid time off



 Work Location: In person

This includes explaining Couchbase advantages and differentiators, and how our Couchbase solutions stack meets these customer challenges, all while getting customers excited about using this new approach for delivering consistent business value.

* Passion for diving into technical issues and solving customer challenges
* Programming skills with any one of the following: Java, Python, Javascript, .NET. C, SQL

* Experienced in designing solutions on at least one major database platform including data modeling, indexes and query optimization.


 Desirables
   

  

* Experience with virtualization and containerization technologies (i.e. Docker, Kubernetes, Openshift, Containers etc)
* Experience with database platform development is a plus.
* Hands on experience with development at large scale

We actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds—including women, people of color, LGTBQIA\+ professionals, veterans, and individuals with disabilities. We have reimagined the database with our fast, flexible and affordable cloud database platform Capella, allowing organizations to quickly build applications that deliver premium experiences to their customers– all with best\-in\-class price performance. More than 30% of the Fortune 100 trust Couchbase to power their modern applications and build innovative new ones. See our recent awards to learn why Couchbase is a great place to work.We are honored to be a part of the Best Places to Work Award for the Bay Area and the UK. Couchbase offers a total rewards approach to benefits that recognizes the value you create here, so that you in turn may best serve yourself and your family. Some benefits include:

* Wellness Benefits \- A variety of world class medical plans to choose from, along with dental, vision, life insurance, and employee assistance programs\*

Your primary focus will be to work closely with our sales and marketing teams to make our customers and partners successful with Red Hat enterprise technologies, for this you'll engage with partners and end customers at various levels, from decision\-makers to technical teams, ensuring they understand the value of Red Hat enterprise solutions.
   

  

 You'll be expected to use your expertise and passion to identify and create business solutions across Red Hat technology platforms at the enterprise level.  Skills:

 experience in the following \- Red Hat OpenShift, and Kubernetes.

 Kubernetes, Docker), cloud infrastructure, and competitive offerings.

 and explaining technical details to non\-technical audiences

194df550.title: Solutions Consultant
194df550.description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time** 
 ! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid\-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
   

  

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**Day In The Life**
**Solution Design \& Advisory**
* Lead discovery sessions to understand client operating models, policy requirements, technology landscape, and success metrics
* Design end\-to\-end travel solutions combining FCM platform, content, data, servicing, and integrations
* Translate complex requirements into clear solution architecture and business outcomes


**Pre\-Sales \& Value Articulation**
* Support sales cycles through solution storytelling, workshops, and executive presentations
* Articulate differentiators across technology, service, data, and regional capabilities
* Provide technical and solution responses for RFP/I/Q submissions in partnership with proposal teams


**Client \& Internal Enablement**
* Develop tailored solution narratives, playbooks, and enablement materials
* Deliver client workshops, adoption sessions, and internal training aligned with roadmap milestones and go\-to\-market priorities
* Act as subject matter expert for FCM technology and solution strategy


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product, Implementation, Deployment, and Support teams to ensure solution feasibility and continuity
* Provide feedback to Product on market needs, gaps, and innovation opportunities
* Contribute to demo environment strategy and reusable solution assets


**Adoption \& Continuous Improvement**
* Support key client solution reviews post\-implementation.
* Identify optimisation opportunities and emerging needs
* Drive best practices for scalable solution delivery across Asia markets


**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**
* 4\+ years in solution consulting, pre\-sales, implementation, or client technology roles (travel, SaaS, platform, or IT preferred)
* Strong ability to translate business challenges into technology and process solutions
* Executive\-level presentation, facilitation, and storytelling skills
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders (commercial, operational, technical)
* Data\-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes
* Excellent problem solving and structured thinking
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities
* Strong curiosity and ownership mindset
* Willingness to travel as required
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 4 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

f8d852b8.title: Technical Pre-Sales
f8d852b8.description:
**Company Description** 
 Aditya Infotech Ltd. (AIL), the technology arm of Aditya Group, is a leading global provider of technology\-driven security solutions with core expertise in electronic video surveillance products and systems. Since its establishment in 1994, AIL has grown into an industry leader, securing more than a million locations across diverse sectors including government, retail, education, finance, public spaces, and infrastructure projects. The company is known for its strong focus on innovation, quality, and end\-to\-end security offerings tailored to complex environments. AIL’s team of skilled professionals is recognized for setting high standards in customer relationships, technical support, and service delivery, offering opportunities to work on impactful, large\-scale deployments. Candidates joining AIL can expect a performance\-driven environment with exposure to advanced security technologies and solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Technical Pre\-Sales role based in Jabalpur. The Technical Pre\-Sales professional will work closely with the sales team to understand customer requirements, design suitable electronic video surveillance solutions, and support solution presentations and demonstrations. Daily responsibilities include preparing technical proposals and bills of materials, conducting site surveys, coordinating with internal teams for solution design and integration, and assisting customers with technical queries. The role involves providing technical support during proof\-of\-concept deployments, ensuring that solutions align with customer expectations and industry standards. The position also requires maintaining accurate documentation, supporting project handover to implementation teams, and contributing to training and knowledge\-sharing activities for partners and customers.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Technical Support and Integration skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues and ensure seamless deployment of surveillance solutions.
* Candidates should possess Presales and Sales skills, including requirement gathering, solution design, proposal creation, and technical presentations to prospective clients.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills, with capability to plan activities, coordinate stakeholders, track timelines, and support project delivery.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with sales teams, technical teams, and customers in a professional manner.
* Candidates should possess a solid understanding of electronic security or IT/networking technologies; experience with CCTV, access control, or related systems is an advantage.
* Candidates should possess a relevant educational background, such as a diploma or degree in engineering, electronics, IT, or a related technical field.
* Candidates should possess strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a customer\-focused approach.
* Candidates should possess the ability to work on\-site in Jabalpur, travel to customer locations as needed, and adapt to dynamic project requirements.

17f7e3bb.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (APAC)
17f7e3bb.description:
Qdrant is an
 **open\-source vector** 
 search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real\-time recommendations.
   

  

 Trusted by global leaders like
 **Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom** 
 , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising
 **$50M in Series B** 
 funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.
   

  

 As a remote\-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.
   

  

 As we expand our presence across Asia\-Pacific, we're looking for a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 to be the technical authority in deals that determine how enterprises build AI infrastructure for the next decade, and the trusted technical owner for our most strategic accounts in the region. Most SE roles are demo cycles. This one is different.
   

  

 You'll work directly with Staff Engineers and CTOs, architect real systems, and own the technical outcome of every engagement you touch, from a first prospect call through to expansion conversations with customers you already support. We care more about time\-zone overlap with our regional accounts than a specific city, so this role is open to candidates based anywhere aligned with major APAC hubs like India, Singapore, Japan, or Australia.
   

  

****What you will own:****
* Own the technical strategy in enterprise deals from first call to production deployment, partnering with Account Executives to qualify, architect, and close for our entire Asian\-Pacific client base
* Act as a Technical Account Manager for a small portfolio of existing enterprise customers in the region alongside active prospects, identifying new use cases, expansion opportunities, and upsell paths, and looping in Account Executives and internal resources to advocate for the customer.
* Design vector search architectures for high\-scale workloads, including multi\-tenant agentic systems, hybrid search pipelines, and low\-latency retrieval at billion\-vector scale.
* Build proof\-of\-concept systems that customers take to production (not throw away), demonstrating Qdrant's performance advantages over JVM\-based or proprietary alternatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on AI infrastructure decisions, helping customers navigate migration from legacy databases, avoid architectural lock\-in, and deploy across cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.
* Contribute to the field engineering knowledge base: reference architectures, technical guides, and reusable POC frameworks that scale the team's impact.


****Who you are****
* 5\+ years of pre\-sales or solutions engineering, ideally with a background in data infrastructure or systems architecture. Hands\-on infrastructure depth alone isn't enough, we need a proven track record running technical qualification and proof\-of\-concept processes within a live sales cycle.
* Experience designing or operating distributed systems, search infrastructure, or data pipelines at production scale.
* Ideally, hands\-on experience with RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) pipelines specifically, plus working knowledge of the broader modern AI stack (LLMs, embedding models, agentic frameworks).
* Ideally, working knowledge of a structured sales qualification framework such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, and the ability to apply it in real deal conversations, connecting technical decisions to business outcomes and deal strategy.
* Strong communicator across audiences: you can go deep on indexing trade\-offs with a Staff Engineer and explain infrastructure ROI to a CIO in the same afternoon.


****Nice to have****
* Experience with vector search, approximate nearest neighbor algorithms, or semantic retrieval systems.
* Background with Rust, C\+\+, or other systems languages.
* Familiarity with deployment patterns: Kubernetes, hybrid cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.


****Why join us****
* A remote\-first, international team working on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure.
* A competitive salary with additional perks.
* Flexible working hours and async\-friendly culture.
* High ownership and real impact.
* Open\-source, engineering\-driven culture.
* Choose your own laptop equipment.


 For US\-based full\-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.
   

  

 Qdrant is an equal\-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.
   

  

**Come build with us!**
 For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy

2fdeb21e.title: Presales Technical Consultant
2fdeb21e.description:
**Who Are We?** 
  
 




 Millipixels Interactive is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands to create everything from immersive digital products and marketing ecosystems to transformation\-driven technology solutions.
 





 But beyond the work, we're a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do.
 




  






 If you're someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact \- you'll probably enjoy being here.
 




  





**About the Role** 

  
 




 Every strong proposal has a moment where sales promise meets technical reality, and someone has to make sure those two things actually match. At Millipixels, that's you.
 




 You'll own the entire technical pre\-sales journey: running discovery workshops that uncover what clients actually need, architecting solutions that hold up under real\-world conditions, and standing in front of clients to present, demo, and defend what Millipixels can build. You're the bridge between business development and delivery \- making sure nothing gets sold that can't be built, and nothing gets built that wasn't sold right.
 





 This role sits at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial instinct. We're looking for someone who has actually written code and built systems earlier in their career \- because that hands\-on foundation is what lets you architect solutions that hold up under real scrutiny, not just ones that sound good on paper. You'll need to go deep enough into AI and tech solutioning to earn a room full of engineers' respect, while staying sharp enough on commercial viability to keep a deal moving forward.
 




  





**You’ll Be the Person Who** 



* **Leads Discovery That Actually Uncovers Something:** 

 Runs workshops that go beyond surface requirements to understand what clients really need and what they haven't said out loud yet.
* **Architects Solutions That Hold Up:** 

 Designs technical solutions that are robust enough to survive delivery, not just impressive enough to survive a pitch.
* **Owns the Client\-Facing Moment:** 

 Presents, demos, and fields tough technical questions in real time, turning complexity into clarity for the people across the table.
* **Bridges Sales and Delivery:** 

 Makes sure what gets promised in a proposal is exactly what delivery can and will build.
* **Stress\-Tests Every Proposal:** 

 Ensures each solution is commercially viable, technically sound, and operationally realistic before it ever reaches a client's inbox.
* **Speaks Fluent AI:** 

 Understands AI solutions deeply enough to shape them, question them, and explain them \- not just reference them.
* **Solves in Real Time:** 

 Handles technical clarifications and objections on the spot, without needing to "get back to you."
* **Keeps Solutions Aligned to Reality:** 

 Ensures every proposed solution actually reflects what Millipixels can deliver \- not just what sounds good on paper \- drawing on genuine hands\-on engineering experience.
* **Shapes the Proposal, Not Just Reviews It:** 

 Gets involved early in proposal solutioning, so technical thinking is baked in from the start, not bolted on at the end.



  





**You’ll Be a Great Fit If** 



* **You've built things before you started designing them:** 

 you've spent earlier years of your career hands\-on with a programming language \- Java, .NET, Node.js, full\-stack, or similar. It doesn't matter which; what matters is that you've actually written and shipped code, so when you architect a solution, you understand how it really works under the hood.
* **You're a seasoned technical architect:** 

 Typically 9–14 years of overall experience, with genuine depth in solution/technical architecture, not just adjacent exposure.
* **You've been part of actual project delivery: N** 

 ot just design and hand\-off \- you understand what it takes to build what gets promised.
* **Startup scale\-up experience is a strong plus: C** 

 andidates who've been part of a startup that has genuinely grown are valued more highly than those whose experience is limited only to large service\-based organisations \- though that background is welcome too.
* **Client\-facing exposure helps: P** 

 rior involvement in client interactions and/or presales activity is a plus, but not a strict requirement.
* **What really matters: C** 

 an you stand in front of a customer's technical team and confidently, accurately answer their questions in real time? Formal presales experience is optional \- this ability isn't.
* **Your communication skills are excellent:** 

  Fluent enough with engineering heads to discuss what gets built and how, yet just as at ease making deep tech solutions digestible to non\-technical stakeholders. This is non\-negotiable for the role.
* **You have strong working knowledge of AI solutions** 

 and can architect around them, not just talk about them.
* **You're equally comfortable** 

 in a whiteboard session with engineers and a boardroom pitch with executives.
* **You think commercially:** 

 You know a great solution still has to make business sense.
* **You hold a cloud architecture certification:** 

 AWS or Azure (Solutions Architect / Solutions Professional level \- Optional).



  





**Benefits of Working at Millipixels** 



* **Flexible work, your way:** 

 Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk.
* **Life admin handled:** 

 Regular expert\-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn’t eat into your weekends.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** 

  Company\-paid health insurance of ₹500,000, with options to extend to spouse.
* **Generous paid leave:** 

  Properly switch off and recharge. We’re in this for the long game, and so are you.
* **Room to grow:** 

  Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to grow your career as fast as you grow the pipeline.
* **Ground\-floor impact:** 

  Join early, help shape the GTM playbook, and put your mark on how we grow, including our AI platform, avirat.ai.
* **Ownership, not red tape:** 

  Small team, big trust. Bring the idea, run with it, and watch it ship.

 , Avaali’s flagship platform for process intelligence, automation discovery, and Agentic AI solutions.

d1929064.title: Sales Engineer (Presales)
d1929064.description:
**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Role in a Nutshell**
 No two days are the same. You'll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers' toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners — playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise and real business impact, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the win. Partner with partner sales teams to identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point's value proposition where it matters most — in front of the customer.
* Be the face of Check Point. Present at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums, bringing our story and our technology to life.
* Prove it out. Lead and co\-execute POCs and technical assessments alongside partner technical and presales teams, turning prospects into believers.
* Lead with value. Guide conversations that uncover real business problems and translate them into winning technical solutions — not just feature lists.
* Be the trusted advisor. Serve as a go\-to cybersecurity resource for partner technical communities, fielding tough technical questions and articulating solution benefits with confidence.
* Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on cybersecurity trends and the competitive landscape so every engagement is informed by what's happening now.
* Support the full cycle. Help partners respond to RFIs/RFPs, share best practices, and manage POCs so every customer gets an excellent experience from first conversation to close.
* Enable others. Train and enable partners and customers on the latest security technologies, multiplying your impact across every account you touch.
* Grow the account. Position Check Point's portfolio to maximize cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within partner accounts.
* Deliver excellence. Build solution designs and high\-impact proposals that reinforce Check Point's reputation as a security leader.
* Represent the brand. Show up at cybersecurity events and live demos as a credible, engaging voice for Check Point.


**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations, including 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles
* A genuinely customer\-centric mindset and a commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience
* A hands\-on attitude — you're willing to roll up your sleeves and work through technical blockers yourself
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving instincts
* Solid understanding of networking technologies, application architectures, and solution design
* Experience building end\-to\-end security solutions spanning network, endpoint, and cloud
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can flex between technical depth and executive clarity
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, CCSA, CCSE)
* An engineering degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline


**Why This Role**
 This is a role for someone who wants more than a technical title — you'll shape how partners and customers experience Check Point, own high\-visibility engagements end to end, and be recognized as the technical expert people turn to when the stakes are high. If you're energized by variety, ownership, and solving real security problems alongside great partners, we'd love to hear from you.

db9fadff.title: Engineer 2, Technical Product Sales Support - Solutions Engineering-3
db9fadff.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Responsible for providing specific product and/or technical knowledge, advice and support to Sales Representatives and customers. Works as a collaborative member of the sales team to market and sell the Company's product lines. Provides insight to customers on current network situations. Works with moderate guidance in own area of knowledge.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Core Responsibilities**
* Performs needs analyses for the Company and its customers and produces strategic, cost\-effective solutions.
* Provides timely, technical support and problem resolution for field service questions.
* Supports Sales team with product modifications and engineering expertise for custom projects.
* Assists representatives and customers in evaluating and selecting products.
* Creates, reviews and executes product test plans and cases, documents test progress and reports results.
* Recommends products to meet customer needs.
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) and overtime as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


**Employees At All Levels Are Expected To**
* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience \- think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff \- be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team \- make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System \- a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company \- by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.


**Disclaimer**
* This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.


 Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non\-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best\-in\-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality \- to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.
   

  

**Education**
 Bachelor's Degree
   

  

 While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.
   

  

**Relevant Work Experience**
 2\-5 Years

2902f3d4.description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking a Data Solution Architect to design and implement scalable, cloud\-native data solutions across both OLAP (analytical) and OLTP (operational) architectures, applying advanced data management and governance practices within a large\-scale banking environment. This role provides technical leadership on modern data platforms — spanning Data Lakes, Operational Data Stores, real\-time streaming, and Data Mesh — ensuring solutions are secure, performant, cost\-optimised, and aligned with enterprise data strategy. The successful candidate will combine deep data engineering expertise with architectural vision, working across business, data engineering, and analytics teams to deliver data solutions that support both operational excellence and advanced analytics use cases.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design Data Lake and Operational Data Store architectures using cloud\-native technologies to support both analytical (OLAP) and operational (OLTP) workloads, ensuring proper separation, scalability, and performance.


Define and enforce Data Mesh principles for decentralized data ownership and governance, establishing domain\-oriented data products, self\-serve data infrastructure patterns, and federated governance.


Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases, ensuring models are well\-documented, fit for purpose, and aligned with enterprise data standards.


Design batch and real\-time data ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and other streaming technologies, ensuring reliable, low\-latency data flow from source systems to Data Lakes, ODS, and downstream consumers.


Build and manage scalable ETL/ELT processes for data cleansing, validation, transformation, and enrichment across multiple source systems including core banking, payments, and transaction banking platforms.


Define patterns for data pipeline orchestration, error handling, retry logic, and monitoring to ensure production\-grade reliability and observability.


Utilize AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, Airflow, and SageMaker to deliver end\-to\-end cloud\-native data solutions aligned with security, cost optimization, and scalability principles.


Support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases by designing data pipelines and platform capabilities that provide governed, high\-quality data to data science and business intelligence teams.


Implement data quality frameworks incorporating validation, profiling, and anomaly detection to ensure data trustworthiness.


Establish and maintain metadata management and data lineage tracking to provide transparency into data origins, transformations, and usage.


Define data standards, policies, and best practices collaboratively with data owners, compliance, and business stakeholders to align with regulatory and governance frameworks.


Collaborate with data product owners, data engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, define data products, and deliver solutions driving measurable business value.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in data architecture and engineering within large\-scale enterprise settings, focusing on designing and implementing complex data platforms. The candidate should demonstrate practical knowledge of data lake, Operational Data Store (ODS), and Data Mesh architectures, employing these frameworks to develop robust production environments. Proficiency in crafting and optimizing data pipelines is essential, including batch and real\-time processes for ingestion, cleansing, validation, transformation, and modeling.


Hard skills include a deep understanding of real\-time streaming technologies, particularly Apache Kafka, covering topic design, partitioning, consumer group management, and integration with downstream systems. The candidate must be adept at leveraging AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Airflow, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, SageMaker (including SageMaker Unified Studio), and Amazon QuickSight to architect comprehensive cloud\-native data solutions. Strong capabilities in data modeling across conceptual, logical, and physical layers are required, with experience in dimensional and normalized schemas suited for both analytical and operational workloads.


Soft skills involve advanced problem\-solving and analytical abilities to identify and resolve complex data quality issues, pipeline failures, and performance challenges in distributed systems. Effective communication and stakeholder management are critical, enabling collaboration with technical teams, data product owners, business leaders, and governance stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful delivery. Experience within the banking domain, specifically transaction banking in areas such as trade finance, payments, cash management, and supply chain finance, is preferred.


Hard skills:


Expertise in data architecture frameworks and production implementations.


Proficient in real\-time data streaming with Apache Kafka.


Skilled in AWS data service platforms for end\-to\-end cloud\-native solutions.


Strong data modeling across various schema designs and workloads.


Soft skills:


Analytical problem\-solving for complex distributed data systems.


Effective communication and stakeholder engagement.


Domain knowledge in commercial banking transaction services.

596a0cac.description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking a Solution Architect with deep Supply Chain Finance domain expertise to define the target\-state architecture and high\-level design for the Supply Chain Finance domain, aligned to business outcomes and the bank's strategic direction. This role spans business, application, data, and technology architecture — owning the end\-to\-end solution design and transformation roadmap, including integration with Payments and Core Banking platforms. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, translating complex domain requirements into well\-structured architectural solutions and guiding them through stakeholder alignment, impact analysis, and implementation planning.


##### **Responsibilities**


Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects, domain architects, and technical SMEs to develop a comprehensive understanding of the current Supply Chain Finance architecture, including systems landscape, data flows, integration points, and technology stack


Document the existing architecture thoroughly, identifying pain points, technical debt, capability gaps, operational inefficiencies, and risks that hinder business agility or scalability


Capture and articulate business objectives, strategic drivers, and domain\-specific requirements to guide the target\-state architectural vision


Define the target\-state architectural strategy for Supply Chain Finance in alignment with overall business strategy, technology strategy, and enterprise architecture guidelines


Ensure the architectural strategy addresses Supply Chain Finance domain specifics—such as receivables finance, payables finance, reverse factoring, dynamic discounting, inventory finance, pre\-shipment finance, and distributor finance—and integration with Payments and Core Banking platforms


Align the strategy with modern architecture principles including cloud\-native design, API\-first, event\-driven patterns, and data\-centric approaches, while considering legacy system migration constraints


Define the target\-state solution architecture across business, application, data, and technology dimensions


Design end\-to\-end architectural views and process flows covering the entire Supply Chain Finance scope, including inbound and outbound integration with Payments, Core Banking, ERP systems, buyer/supplier onboarding portals, credit risk engines, and external trade networks


Produce high\-level design artefacts that clearly communicate the solution to both technical teams and business stakeholders for alignment and approval


Document and evaluate roadmap options for Supply Chain Finance transformation, assessing feasibility, risk, time\-to\-value, and organizational impact


Define the recommended end\-to\-end roadmap, detailing capability sequencing, migration phases, and key milestones


Produce a high\-level implementation roadmap outlining impacts on related domains, dependencies, risks, and assumptions, and secure stakeholder review and approval including business leadership, enterprise architecture, domain leads, and delivery teams


##### **Skills**


Must have


The candidate brings over 15 years of comprehensive IT experience, including at least 5 years dedicated to Solution Architecture and Enterprise Architecture within the banking or financial services sector. They excel in defining target\-state architectures encompassing business, application, data, and technology layers.


Hard skills include:


Expertise in Supply Chain Finance domains such as receivables, payables (reverse factoring), dynamic discounting, inventory, pre\-shipment, distributor finance, and multi\-party supply chain programs.


Strong knowledge of integrating Supply Chain Finance with Payments infrastructure, Core Banking systems, and corporate ERP platforms.


Proficiency in cloud\-native architecture, microservices design, RESTful and event\-driven API design, contract\-first approaches, and diverse database models including relational, NoSQL, and event sourcing.


Experience with monolith\-to\-microservices migration and legacy system modernization specific to banking environments.


Skilled in creating architectural artifacts, including solution architecture documents, high\-level designs, integration views, data flow diagrams, roadmaps, and options analyses.


Soft skills include:


Ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders across functions, domains, and regions, leveraging strong communication, facilitation, and negotiation abilities to achieve consensus and architectural approval.


Adaptability in ambiguous settings, capable of transforming incomplete business requirements into structured architectural options with clearly articulated trade\-offs.

bcdf47f4.title: Solutions Architect

We use the term "operating system" in the truest sense: just like iOS, Windows, or Linux, Shakudo's end\-to\-end OS provides ever\-evolving, fully automated, best\-in\-class open\-source components tailored to each business's unique needs.
 



  





 We are seeking a Solution Architect to join our Stack team and serve as the technical anchor for our customers — understanding their data and AI infrastructure challenges, architecting solutions on the Shakudo platform, and driving ongoing account growth. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role for someone who bridges deep technical expertise with strong relationship skills and can move between Kubernetes, Helm, and cloud infrastructure and strategic customer conversations.
 



  





 In this role, you will own the technical relationship with assigned accounts: architecting production\-ready solutions, integrating the Shakudo platform into customer environments, and expanding Shakudo's footprint by connecting customer needs to platform capabilities. This is not a pure pre\-sales or post\-sales role — it is an outcome\-driven engineering and advisory role where success is measured by customer adoption, solution quality, and account growth.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design and deliver end\-to\-end technical solutions on the Shakudo platform that address real\-world data and AI challenges for enterprise customers
* Integrate open\-source and proprietary components seamlessly with the Shakudo platform using Kubernetes, Helm Charts, and infrastructure\-as\-code
* Build elegant, production\-ready solutions — not just proof\-of\-concepts — that customers rely on in production
* Contribute to architectural decisions and establish design patterns for platform development with high autonomy
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for assigned accounts — understand their infrastructure, roadmap, and pain points deeply
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues customers face in their data and AI stack, from Kubernetes orchestration to pipeline performance
* Identify opportunities to expand Shakudo's footprint within existing accounts by connecting customer needs to platform capabilities
* Navigate customer organizations effectively — from individual contributors to engineering leaders and C\-suite decision\-makers
* Champion customer needs internally, influencing product direction and Stack team priorities
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate customer requirements into scalable, robust systems
* Collaborate with Customer Engineering to ensure smooth hand\-offs and consistent solution quality
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases, solution patterns, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the team



  





**Qualifications** 



* 4–8 years of experience in solution engineering, solution architecture, or a senior engineering role with significant client\-facing responsibility
* Strong Kubernetes and Helm Chart development and deployment experience
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code
* Backend and frontend experience (e.g., Python, React, TypeScript) — enough to be hands\-on when needed

e6fbdfe5.title: Prin Solution Architect [T500-29292]
e6fbdfe5.description:
**About us:** 




 We are a highly successful 190\-year\-old, Fortune 500 commercial property insurance company of 6,000\+ employees with a unique focus on science and risk engineering. Businesses worldwide trust our expertise to protect their assets, relying on our comprehensive risk assessments and robust, engineering\-based insurance solutions to safeguard against fire, natural disasters, and other perils. Serving over a quarter of the Fortune 500 and major corporations globally, we deliver data\-driven strategies that enhance resilience, ensure business continuity, and empower organizations to thrive.
 



  





 FM India is a strategic location for driving our global operational efficiency. Our presence in India allows us to leverage the country’s talented workforce and advance our capabilities to serve our clients better. We have diverse corporate functions that emphasize research, advanced technologies like AI and analytics, risk engineering, research, finance, marketing, HR, etc. working together to provide innovative solutions and nurture lasting relationships – from co\-workers to clients.
 



  





**Role Title: Principal Solution Architect** 




**Position Summary:** 




 The Principal Solution Architect is primarily responsible for establishing the technical architecture for solutions while working closely with delivery partners, including Product Owners, Chapter Leads, and Technical Leads, to enable successful delivery. This role ensures that solutions are well\-architected concerning security, quality, extensibility, maintainability, and performance, and they are implemented to support near and long\-term implementation productivity. They are accountable for ensuring solutions are integrated into the overall technical landscape guided by Enterprise Architecture standards and patterns. Solution Architects are expected to evaluate various options, identify tradeoffs, and ultimately take accountability to communicate clear recommendations for selecting and implementing effective technical solutions that meet business objectives. As a key delivery partner, this role has the responsibility to help guide the prioritized implementation roadmap and help determine how to execute solution implementation effectively over time. They play a key leadership role in supporting teams and stakeholders in planning, executing, and delivering technical solutions in alignment with the established target architecture. Solution Architects are expected to remain closely engaged during solution delivery, including incrementally reviewing technical design and implementation to ensure the utilization of best practices and adherence to architectural guidance. Solution architects may strategically contribute to implementation activities when there is an opportunity to establish an example and provide crucial implementation guidance. Solution Architects contribute to defining architecture patterns, building reference implementations of these patterns, and proof of technologies to accelerate solution delivery. This is an experienced solution designer who contributes a breadth of experience and selective expertise to amplify teams' ability to deliver high\-value complex technical solutions effectively.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 



* Technical Design: Leads solution design across one or more initiatives. Ensures designs adhere to enterprise standards and best practices. Identifies architecturally significant items required to realize a solution roadmap. Defines and communicates solution architecture recommendations in the context of alternative options with consideration of key tradeoffs. Proactively identifies potential risks, limitations, and alternative approaches through the design process to best position teams to meet business objectives.
* Technical Delivery: Works closely with delivery stakeholders and teams, providing technical leadership to support the successful implementation and delivery of designed solutions. Continuously works with teams to plan and influence the work breakdown and execution sequence to optimize team delivery. Actively engages in problem\-solving and iterative design to ensure solutions meet quality standards, performance benchmarks, and functional requirements in alignment with architectural guidance. Identifies and influences management and mitigation of risks and impediments, including cross\-team dependencies. Collaborates with teams on iterative analysis and design through implementation to ensure successful delivery. Selectively contributes to technical implementations to provide hands\-on guidance when it is crucial for delivery success. Responsible for supporting all aspects of technical delivery, including but not limited to design, implementation, end\-to\-end testing, and release to production.
* Enterprise Alignment: Collaborates with Enterprise Architects and lead teams to design, plan, and implement systems in alignment with established enterprise technology guidance. Responsible for helping to coordinate the remediation of existing systems to bring them in alignment with prioritized enterprise technology initiatives. Contributes to defining, implementing, and utilizing enterprise\-level reference architecture initiatives.
* Oversight and Control Frameworks: Evaluate the technical health of systems by monitoring quality, security, and performance in alignment with evolving standards and expectations. Support control frameworks for compliance with regulations and internal policies. Conducts audits and assessments to address gaps or vulnerabilities and design, plan, and help coordinate remediation activities.



  





**Skill and Experience:** 



* 6\-8 years of experience required to perform essential job functions.
* Additional Experience Qualifier (optional): 8\+ years of contribution to delivering technical solutions in the area of focus, 5\+ years designing, developing, and implementing technical solutions from concept through to delivery, 3\+ years’ experience providing technical leadership for solution teams with five or more team members.
* Strong understanding of the target technology stack through professional experience as a senior level individual contributor or architect.
* Proven ability to break architectural and implementation problems into logical smaller deliverables.
* Ability to define, maintain, and manage architecture models and artifacts.
* Strong ability to influence and persuade solution participants and stakeholders to support proposed architectural approaches.
* Proven ability to mentor team members to enhance their ability to effectively contribute to successful design and delivery.
* Proven ability to resolve conflicts within teams before they escalate (mediation skills).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to tailor message to audience. Can communicate complex technology concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Able to align team members on architectural direction, complex technical decisions and build consensus across the team.
* Ability to facilitate communications between key contributors, dependencies, and stakeholders, acting as a single point of contact for cross\-functional solution architecture.
* Strong knowledge and ability to communicate objectives and benefits of modern architectural standards, patterns, and practices to teams.



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Enterprise Solution Design: Expertise in designing enterprise\-level software solutions and applying software design frameworks.
* Programming \& Cloud Computing: Proficient in HTML, C\#, JavaScript, and experienced with cloud computing environments.
* DevSecOps \& Security: Strong background in DevSecOps practices and software security principles.
* Microservices \& Containerization: Skilled in building microservices and using container technologies.
* Data \& Integration: Experience in data management, performance optimization, and API/integration design.



  





**Education and Certifications:** 



* 4 Year /Bachelor degree required.



  





**Work location:** 
 Bengaluru.

The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.

* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine.  Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity.  Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
