d41222bc.title: Solution Architect
d41222bc.description:
**About Chubb** 




  





 Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S\&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.
 



  





**About Chubb India** 




  





 At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow
 



  





 With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start\-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution\-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.
 



 We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real\-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
 



  





**Position Details** 




  




* **Job Title: Solution Architect**
* **Function/Department: Technology**
* **Location: Hyderabad**
* **Employment Type: Full Time**
* **Reports To: Domain Architect / Chief Architect**



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Solution Architect is a senior technical leader within Chubb’s Global Architecture team. This individual translates complex business and insurance\-domain requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient technology solutions—taking an end\-to\-end view of business processes and spanning multiple domains, including security, infrastructure, data, integration, and application layers across Chubb’s worldwide operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities and Focus Areas** 




  





**Strategic Impact** 




  




* Partner with C\-suite and business leaders on technology roadmaps.
* Support the development of a strategy or vision that aligns with organizational objectives.
* Lead the Investment Planning process (Technology Strat Plan) by:
* Gathering business drivers and demand,
* Balancing priorities,
* Defining regional technology strategy and roadmap.



  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Lead end\-to\-end solution design for enterprise initiatives.
* Guide engineering squads through architecture reviews and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Own non\-functional requirements, including performance, security, and scalability.
* Drive reusable architecture, design patterns, standards, and policy.
* Participate in and present at design forums to defend solution designs.
* Frame initiatives from the inception phase and provide support for Cost\-Benefit Analysis (CBA).



  





**Cross\-Domain Collaboration** 



* Mentor junior architects and senior engineers.
* Work closely with key business stakeholders—including underwriting, claims, operations, actuarial, finance, and distribution—to understand business objectives, products, and processes.
* Translate business requirements and pain points into viable solution options, clearly highlighting impacts, risks, and trade\-offs.
* Participate in governance forums (such as architecture boards, design reviews, and project steering groups) to present and defend solution designs.



  





**What You Will Do** 



* **Architecture Design \& Governance**
* Define and own solution blueprints for large\-scale enterprise programs. Conduct architecture reviews, enforce architectural standards, and ensure that all designs comply with Chubb’s security and regulatory requirements—including GDPR, SOX, and local insurance mandates.



  




* **Cloud \& Infrastructure Strategy**
* Drive Chubb’s cloud transformation agenda across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments. Define cloud landing zone patterns, establish FinOps guardrails, and set infrastructure\-as\-code standards using technologies such as Terraform and Kubernetes.



  




* **Integration \& API Design**
* Architect event\-driven and API\-first integration patterns using Kafka, MuleSoft, and REST/GraphQL APIs. Ensure seamless, secure, and scalable connectivity between core insurance systems—such as Policy, Claims, and Billing—and modern digital channels.



  




* **Data \& Analytics Architecture**
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to design modern data architectures, including data lakes, data mesh implementations, and real\-time streaming platforms. These architectures should enable advanced analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) capabilities across the enterprise.



  




* **Security \& Resilience**
* Embed security by design throughout the architecture lifecycle. Implement zero\-trust networking principles, robust identity \& access management (IAM), strong encryption standards, and proven disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity architecture patterns.



  




* **Stakeholder Engagement**
* Communicate complex architectural concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Produce well\-structured Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and present strategic architectural proposals and reviews to governance boards and executive leadership.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
* Master’s degree preferred (MBA or MSc in Technology Management a plus)



  





**Experience** 



* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 4–5 years in a Solution or Enterprise Architect role
* Demonstrated experience delivering architecture for large, complex, multi\-geography programs
* Insurance or Financial Services domain experience strongly preferred



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence at VP / SVP / C\-level
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Ability to lead, influence, and mentor across distributed, global teams
* Communicates effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Takes the lead in explaining complex concepts to support decision\-making
* Leads or guides team members; demonstrates awareness of risk factors in their work



  





**Technical Skills** 



* **Cloud platforms** 
 : AWS (preferred), Azure – design \& migration patterns
* **Containerization \& orchestration** 
 : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
* **Integration** 
 : MuleSoft, Kafka, REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI
* **Data** 
 : Snowflake, Databricks, event streaming, data mesh
* **DevSecOps** 
 : CI/CD pipelines, Terraform / IaC, SAST/DAST tooling



  





**Domain Skills** 



* **Lines of business** 
 : P\&C, Personal Lines, Specialty and A\&H
* **Domain coverage** 
 : Distribution, quote \& bind, policy, billing, claims, reinsurance, catastrophe management and finance
* **Solution types** 
 : insurance packaged platforms, custom build, digital portals, finance/shared services applications, integration, data \& analytics, workflow/automation



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  




* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment.



  





**Why Chubb?** 




  





 Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
 



 Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start\-up\-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
 



  




* **Industry leader:** 
 Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* **A Great Place to work:** 
 Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023\-2024, 2024\-2025 and 2025\-2026
* **Laser focus on excellence** 
 : At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* **Start\-Up Culture** 
 : Embracing the spirit of a start\-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* **Growth and success** 
 : As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment



  





**Application Process** 




  





 Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.
 


* **Step 1** 
 : Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal / Linkedin
* **Step 2** 
 : Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* **Step 3** 
 : Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* **Step 4** 
 : Final interaction with Chubb leadership.



  





**Join Us** 




  





 With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a
 **global stage** 
 or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value
 **integrity, innovation, and inclusion** 
 , and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to
 **be part of Chubb India’s journey** 
 .

8bd72828.title: Solution Architect - ITS, IT/ITES Vertical
8bd72828.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 AWS Solutions Architects are trusted advisors to our customers, helping them solve some of their largest business challenges by designing and advising on some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient solutions in the world.
   

  

 Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
   

  

 Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
   

  

 In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the Emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
   

  

 You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
   

  

 Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our Emergin customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
   

  

* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 3\+ years of relevant field experience


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 6b46671e.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience working with AI, building Agentic systems and AI based solutions.


**About the job** 
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L3\) at NTT DATA, your primary role will be to provide exceptional service to our clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents. 6b8e63e5.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
6b8e63e5.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs

### **Job Description**


**Program Manager \- Odisha**  

**Location:** Bhubaneswar, Odisha  

**Role Purpose:**  

The Program Manager will support the State Lead in the effective implementation and scale\-up of Quest Alliance’s education program in Odisha. The role will work closely with the state and district teams to translate the state strategy into actionable plans, ensure quality implementation across districts, and strengthen engagement with government and implementation partners.  

The role will support program planning, capacity building, monitoring and review processes, government coordination, documentation and team development. The Program Manager will also contribute to strengthening the integration of future skills, including digital, computational and life and career skills, within the government school ecosystem.  

The role will work closely with state and district government stakeholders, CSOs and other partners to ensure timely implementation, resolve operational challenges and contribute to building sustainable government ownership of the program. **Role Description**  

**1\. Strategic Support and Program Planning**  

Support the State Lead in translating the Odisha state strategy into annual and quarterly implementation plans across districts.  

Contribute to the development of program strategies, work plans, concept notes, presentations and proposals based on emerging needs and opportunities in Odisha.  

Support alignment of program plans with state education priorities, government frameworks and relevant policy directions, including NEP and the State Curriculum Framework.  

Identify opportunities for innovation, convergence and scale within the education ecosystem.  

Contribute to strengthening CSO and partner engagement strategies in consultation with the State Lead.  

**2\. Program Implementation and Operational Planning**  

Coordinate and support timely implementation of program plans across districts, ensuring agreed deliverables and milestones are met.  

Work closely with Coordinators and district teams to develop field plans and ensure effective execution.  

Undertake regular field visits to understand implementation realities, provide on\-ground support and strengthen the quality of program delivery.  

Support and, where required, facilitate trainings, workshops, review meetings and planning processes with teachers, government officials and field teams.  

Support the team in identifying implementation challenges and developing practical solutions and innovations.  

Ensure that program approaches and resources are contextualised to the needs of districts and government schools in Odisha.  

Work with relevant state teams to strengthen the integration of digital, computational, life and career skills and other program themes within the school ecosystem.  

**3\. Program Monitoring, Data and Reviews**  

Ensure that program implementation, field visits, achievements and challenges are appropriately documented in monitoring systems.  

Support the team to regularly analyse program data and use evidence to inform planning and implementation decisions.  

Facilitate monthly and quarterly reviews with district teams and support the State Lead in state\-level reviews.  

Track progress against program milestones, identify gaps and follow up on agreed actions.  

Support the preparation of program dashboards, updates and analysis for internal and external stakeholders.  

Contribute to identifying trends, learnings and evidence from implementation that can inform program strategy and government engagement.  

**4\. Government and Partner Engagement**  

Support the State Lead in maintaining effective relationships with state and district government stakeholders.  

Manage regular coordination with identified government POCs to facilitate approvals, reviews, reporting and implementation requirements.  

Coordinate with relevant government departments like School \& Mass Education Department, Pancha Sikhya Setu Sangathan, OSEPA, Directorate of Higher Secondary Education, Skill Development \& Technical Education Department and district officials to support program implementation and capacity\-building initiatives.  

Support preparation and participation in government reviews, workshops, consultations and relevant forums.  

Ensure that government stakeholders are regularly updated on program progress, achievements and emerging issues.  

Identify opportunities for convergence with government initiatives and other organisations working in the education ecosystem.  

Support identification of relevant CSOs and potential partners at the district level and explore opportunities for collaboration.  

**5\. Reporting, Documentation and Budget Support**  

Ensure timely submission of program reports, case studies, success stories and other documentation as per organisational requirements.  

Support preparation of reports and program updates for government, donors and internal stakeholders.  

Capture and document implementation learnings, innovations and evidence from the field.  

Support state\-level budget planning, expenditure tracking and periodic review of budget utilisation.  

Ensure that program expenditure is aligned with approved plans and organisational processes.  

Support the State Lead and relevant teams in providing timely financial and program information.  

**6\. Team Support and Development**  

Provide regular guidance and support to Coordinators and district teams in planning, implementation and problem\-solving.  

Support team members in setting clear objectives, tracking progress and identifying professional development needs.  

Mentor and coach team members to strengthen their program management and facilitation capabilities.  

Support capacity\-building initiatives for the field team based on emerging needs.  

Facilitate effective communication and coordination between the state and district teams.  

Promote a culture of reflection, learning, experimentation and accountability within the team.  

Support adherence to organisational policies, processes and standards.  

**Required Skills and Experience**  

7–8 years of relevant experience in implementing and managing education programs, preferably within government secondary and higher\-secondary school systems.  

Experience of managing multi\-district programs and working with field teams.  

Understanding of blended learning, digital literacy, computational thinking/coding, STEM and/or life and career skills for school students.  

Experience of facilitating training, workshops and review processes with teachers, government officials and other education stakeholders.  

Experience working with state and district government systems and education departments.  

Strong understanding of the Indian education ecosystem, with knowledge of NEP and the Odisha education context preferred.  

Ability to use program data and evidence to inform planning, reviews and decision\-making.  

Strong interpersonal, facilitation, written and verbal communication skills in English and Odia.  

Strong documentation, presentation and IT skills.  

Ability to independently manage multiple workstreams while working collaboratively with state and district teams.  

Willingness to travel extensively across Odisha.  

Ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders and navigate complex implementation environments.  

**Salary:** The pay band for the position starts at Rs. 75,000/\- per month (cost to company). The salary offered will be commensurate with the experience and expertise of the candidate.  

**About Quest Alliance:**  

Quest Alliance prepares young learners in India with the skills, mindsets, and support systems they need to thrive in life, learning, and work.  

A social impact organization with close to two decades of experience, Quest Alliance works at the intersection of technology and future skills to make learning more equitable and relevant, especially for socially and economically vulnerable learners.  

The organization influences systems to empower young learners in government high schools and trade and vocational institutes to holistically navigate their education to career transitions.  

Quest Alliance works across 12 Indian states and is partnered with nine state governments, over 80 CSOs, national ministries, and funders. It has impacted 1\.8 million young lives to date.

We are committed to ensuring that every applicant and employee is treated with fairness and respect, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital status, social status, caste, religious belief, age, or any other factor that is irrelevant to performance. Your individuality is valued and respected within our organization.

**Description**
 How does Amazon deliver millions of packages faster than customers expect, across the globe, every single day?
   

  

 If that question excites you, keep reading. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the strategy and execution of programs across Last Mile Delivery. This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer\-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world\-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Last Mile is one of the most customer\-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
   

  

 As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end\-to\-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross\-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery speed. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the single\-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross\-functional teams, making trade\-offs to optimize time\-to\-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high\-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done


 The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra\-large projects, and a well\-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross\-functional dependencies, and make trade\-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.

 PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.

367d9885.description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees \- every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal \- is a set of world\-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.
   

  

 We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to \- what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture \- evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade\-off decisions, unblocking cross\-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi\-org programs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility \- international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross\-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade\-offs.
   

  

 Cross\-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi\-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.
   

  

 Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi\-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.
   

  

 Operational Cadence \& Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.
   

  

 Capacity \& Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade\-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Efficiency \& Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi\-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.
   

  

 Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no\-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re\-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade\-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru \- engineers and program managers across all levels who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We operate as a worldwide team with genuine empathy across time zones. Inclusivity is how we work \- we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.

**Description**
 Join Amazon Financials Foundation Services and lead transformative projects that power hundreds of billions of dollars in transactions across multiple currencies and countries. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you'll collaborate with product, engineering, accounting, and finance teams to build scalable financial systems that fuel Amazon's global growth while shaping the future of financial accounting at Amazon scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead cross\-functional program execution by coordinating with product, engineering, accounting, and finance stakeholders to deliver financial systems that meet technical requirements and business objectives
* Drive metrics\-based decision making by collecting, analyzing, and communicating data that informs project direction and helps teams prioritize work
* Facilitate stakeholder alignment by conducting regular communication with leadership at director and VP levels, ensuring transparency around project status, risks, and key performance indicators
* Balance competing priorities by managing the tension between long\-term product vision and immediate business needs, advocating for an incremental approach that delivers value consistently
* Articulate technical strategy by translating complex technology choices and architectural decisions for diverse audiences, building shared understanding across technical and non\-technical stakeholders


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, you'll navigate the complexity of large\-scale financial systems integration. Your day might include facilitating alignment meetings with engineering and product teams on system architecture decisions, reviewing metrics and data to inform project direction, or presenting technical trade\-offs to senior leadership. You'll work across dozens of stakeholders to ensure teams are delivering high\-quality solutions while balancing immediate business needs with long\-term product vision. You'll find yourself translating between technical and business contexts, helping diverse groups understand the implications of technology choices, and keeping teams synchronized around shared goals and key performance indicators.
   

  

**About The Team**

4802329f.description:
**Opportunity Overview**
 We’re seeking a strategic and execution\-focused Technical Program Manager to drive large, cross\-functional initiatives from concept through launch. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-team programs—such as platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, and major product launches—while defining clear milestones, success metrics, and sequencing plans. You’ll partner deeply with Engineering to proactively manage dependencies, mitigate risk, and ensure technical and business alignment. This role also strengthens our execution systems by improving program transparency, standardizing launch rigor, and translating technical complexity into clear executive\-level insights.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-team initiatives (e.g., platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, major product launches)
* Define milestones, critical paths, and measurable success criteria
* Break ambiguous initiatives into executable phases with clear sequencing
* Identify and manage cross\-team technical dependencies
* Proactively surface risks and tradeoffs with mitigation plans
* Run structured risk reviews and escalation processes when needed
* Participate in technical design discussions to understand architecture and constraints
* Ensure design reviews, capacity planning, and rollout strategies happen early
* Collaborate with EMs and engineers leaders to align on realistic timelines
* Establish program tracking mechanisms that create transparency without bureaucracy
* Standardize launch readiness, milestone reviews, and postmortem follow\-ups
* Identify systemic delivery bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement
* Provide concise executive updates with clear status, risks, and asks
* Maintain decision logs and documentation for key initiatives
* Translate technical complexity into business impact


**What You’ll Need**
**Must\-haves**
* 6\+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or related roles in high\-growth technology companies
* 6\+ years of experience hands on experience as a software engineer
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum/SAFe or other delivery frameworks (with pragmatic application)
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-team, multi\-quarter technical initiatives
* Strong technical fluency (experience working closely with backend, infrastructure, data, or platform engineering teams)
* Ability to understand system architecture, dependencies, and engineering tradeoffs
* Proven track record of driving programs to completion in ambiguous environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior engineering leaders
* Excellent english written and verbal communication skills
* Experience implementing program management frameworks, milestone tracking, and risk management systems


**Nice\-to\-haves**
* Experience in platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, large\-scale migrations, GenAI Integrations, inference infrastructure, data pipelines, model deployment platforms
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Experience in scaling startups
* Experience improving delivery predictability metrics (e.g., on\-time delivery, scope control, forecast accuracy)
* Experience supporting compliance, security, or reliability initiatives
* MBA or advanced technical degree


**ISMS Roles And Responsibilities**
* Good knowledge of Information practices.
* Assist the manager in all the information security activities implementation and maintenance process.
* Ensuring the team and imparted with Competence related to Information security
* Responsible for implementation of security policies and procedures and report any issues to the Information Security Manager.


**Ability To Commute/relocate**
* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)


**Interview Process\*:**
* Connect with Talent Acquisition
* Meet with the Hiring Manager
* Behavioral Interview(s)
* Case Study
* Interview with Senior Leadership
* Subject to change


**About Cohere Health**
 Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI\-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer\-provider decision\-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.
   

  

 With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI\-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end\-to\-end payment integrity services across pre\- and post\-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI\-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.
   

  

 Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry\-wide recognition. We’ve been recognized on TIME’s World Top HealthTech Companies 2025 list, the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022\-2025\), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 \& 2024\.
   

  

**We can’t wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!**

 Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all. To us, it’s personal.

**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high\-stakes, cross\-functional engineering initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy, system architecture, and operational execution. You will drive the technical delivery strategy for complex software integrations, scale distributed systems, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture leaders to turn ambitious roadmaps into reliable software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery Strategy: Architect end\-to\-end program delivery plans for multi\-team initiatives, translating high\-level product requirements into detailed engineering milestones.
* Architecture \& Dependency Management: Identify, track, and resolve complex cross\-functional dependencies across API contracts, core platform services, and external integrations.
* Technical Problem Solving: Drive alignment on system trade\-offs (e.g., latency, scalability, technical debt) and participate in architectural reviews to keep execution aligned with long\-term platform health.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical, security, and operational risks weeks before they impact launch schedules, building actionable contingency plans.
* Operational Excellence: Establish a lightweight, high\-impact execution cadence (e.g., agile delivery processes, integration testing syncs, execution metrics, post\-mortems) across distributed engineering teams.
* Executive Communication: Synthesize technical status, risks, and execution health into clear, data\-driven updates for senior leadership.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 7\+ years of experience as a TPM, Engineering Manager, or Systems Architect managing complex software development cycles.
* Technical Depth: Deep understanding of distributed systems, service\-oriented/microservices architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Ability to hold technical discussions with Principal Engineers and Architects.
* Execution Track Record: Proven history of delivering large\-scale, multi\-team software initiatives from inception to rollout on time and at scale.
* Leadership \& Influence: Outstanding stakeholder management skills; ability to align disparate engineering, product, and business teams without direct authority.
* Data\-Driven: Proficiency with program management frameworks (Jira, Confluence) and using metrics to measure delivery velocity and system reliability.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience in ad tech, data engineering, complex integrations (e.g., third\-party verification, SDK integrations), or high\-throughput real\-time systems.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

663832fb.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
663832fb.description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
   

  

 Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?
   

  

 If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telangana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on\-time and at\-cost.
   

  

 You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
   

  

 Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 5\+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on\-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
   

  

 The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region\-wide knowledge and monitoring of in\-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
   

  

 A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences:
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

**Work/Life Balance**
 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Inclusive Team Culture**
 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

**Mentorship And Career Growth**
 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)


**Preferred Qualifications**

3b70317d.title: Sales Engineer (Presales)
3b70317d.description:
Why Join Us?
   

  

**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Your Role in a Nutshell**
 No two days are the same. You'll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers' toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners — playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise and real business impact, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the win. Partner with partner sales teams to identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point's value proposition where it matters most — in front of the customer.
* Be the face of Check Point. Present at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums, bringing our story and our technology to life.
* Prove it out. Lead and co\-execute POCs and technical assessments alongside partner technical and presales teams, turning prospects into believers.
* Lead with value. Guide conversations that uncover real business problems and translate them into winning technical solutions — not just feature lists.
* Be the trusted advisor. Serve as a go\-to cybersecurity resource for partner technical communities, fielding tough technical questions and articulating solution benefits with confidence.
* Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on cybersecurity trends and the competitive landscape so every engagement is informed by what's happening now.
* Support the full cycle. Help partners respond to RFIs/RFPs, share best practices, and manage POCs so every customer gets an excellent experience from first conversation to close.
* Enable others. Train and enable partners and customers on the latest security technologies, multiplying your impact across every account you touch.
* Grow the account. Position Check Point's portfolio to maximize cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within partner accounts.
* Deliver excellence. Build solution designs and high\-impact proposals that reinforce Check Point's reputation as a security leader.
* Represent the brand. Show up at cybersecurity events and live demos as a credible, engaging voice for Check Point.


**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations, including 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles
* A genuinely customer\-centric mindset and a commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience
* A hands\-on attitude — you're willing to roll up your sleeves and work through technical blockers yourself
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving instincts
* Solid understanding of networking technologies, application architectures, and solution design
* Experience building end\-to\-end security solutions spanning network, endpoint, and cloud
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can flex between technical depth and executive clarity
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, CCSA, CCSE)
* An engineering degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline


**Why This Role**
 This is a role for someone who wants more than a technical title — you'll shape how partners and customers experience Check Point, own high\-visibility engagements end to end, and be recognized as the technical expert people turn to when the stakes are high. If you're energized by variety, ownership, and solving real security problems alongside great partners, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineer**  

  

**Experience Required:** Min 3 Years  

**Full\-Time Job**  

  

**Role Summary**  

We are seeking a **Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineer** to support and administer enterprise cloud platforms hosted on **Microsoft Azure**. This is primarily a **cloud administration and operations role**, focused on operating, maintaining, monitoring, and supporting an existing cloud platform rather than designing or building new platform components. The role includes Terraform\-based infrastructure support, GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) administration, CI/CD operations, cloud networking, identity management, monitoring, and release execution.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Administer Citadel Platform and AI Application Landing Zones, including Azure subscriptions, resource groups, networking, identity, RBAC, policies, Key Vault/secrets, monitoring and cost controls.
* Own Terraform\-based Infrastructure as Code: maintain modules, providers, variables, state/backends, workspaces, plan/apply workflows, drift detection and remediation.
* Operate CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES), including workflows and self\-hosted runners; support Azure DevOps integration where applicable.
* Ensure infrastructure and configuration changes are version\-controlled and deployed through approved CI/CD processes rather than manual portal changes.
* Monitor platform health, availability, capacity, security alerts and integration failures; support incident triage, RCA inputs and recurring problem tracking.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India.  FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
