59d8bc15.title: Salesforce Architect – Service 2.0
59d8bc15.description:
#### **Job Description**


Job Description
  

Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

About Service 2\.0
  

Service 2\.0 is Blue Star's three\-year transformation of the Unitary Products service business, moving from reactive complaint handling to proactive ownership of the customer experience.
  

The programme is redesigning the complete customer journey — from installation and warranty onboarding through breakdown, repair, closure and renewal — on a modern service technology stack comprising Salesforce as the system of record, Salesforce Field Service (FSL) for the technician workforce, a bi\-directional integration backbone with SAP and partner systems, and a WhatsApp\-first customer communication layer.
  

The transformation includes GenAI\-powered service bots and self\-service, intelligent ticket allocation, workforce capacity optimisation, mobile\-first field workflows, digital proof\-of\-work, AI\-assisted audit, predictive analytics and role\-based performance dashboards.
  

The programme operates across a pan\-India service ecosystem of partners and technicians and is measured through business outcomes including warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, turnaround time and customer satisfaction.
  

Role: Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect to own the technology architecture and solution design for the Service 2\.0 transformation.
  

The person will be responsible for translating business and service transformation objectives into a scalable Salesforce architecture covering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, integrations, digital channels, automation, analytics and AI/GenAI capabilities.
  

The role will work closely with business leaders, service operations, IT teams, Salesforce/product teams, integration teams, partners and implementation vendors to establish a robust architecture that can scale across Blue Star's pan\-India service network.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

1\. Salesforce Architecture \& Solution Design
  

* Own the end\-to\-end Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Define the target architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud/digital channels and supporting Salesforce capabilities.
* Translate business requirements and service\-process designs into scalable, secure and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Define application, data, integration and security architecture.
* Establish architecture principles, design standards and reusable patterns.
* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend their adoption where they create measurable business value.
* Ensure the architecture remains scalable for future service transformation initiatives.

2\. Field Service \& Technician Transformation
  

* Architect Salesforce Field Service solutions supporting the complete technician lifecycle.
* Design solutions for work\-order management, intelligent scheduling, dispatch, technician allocation, capacity planning, mobility and digital proof\-of\-work.
* Enable optimisation of technician productivity, travel, skill matching, SLA adherence and first\-time\-fix.
* Design mobile\-first experiences suitable for a large and diverse pan\-India technician ecosystem.
* Ensure solutions work effectively across service partners and different operating models.

3\. Customer Service \& Digital Experience
  

* Architect end\-to\-end customer journeys across complaint registration, service request, appointment, technician visit, repair, closure and renewal.
* Design WhatsApp\-first and digital self\-service journeys integrated with Salesforce.
* Define architecture for GenAI\-powered service bots and assisted customer\-service journeys.
* Enable consistent customer interactions across digital and assisted service channels.
* Ensure customer, asset, warranty and service history are available as a unified view.

4\. Integration Architecture
  

* Own the Salesforce integration architecture with SAP, partner systems, WhatsApp and other enterprise applications.
* Define API, event\-driven and bi\-directional integration patterns.
* Ensure reliable synchronisation of customer, product, asset, warranty, service and transaction data.
* Establish standards for integration security, monitoring, error handling, retry mechanisms and performance.
* Work with integration architects and technology teams to build a scalable integration backbone.

5\. AI, GenAI \& Intelligent Service
  

* Define the architecture for AI/GenAI use cases within the service ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to use AI for customer self\-service, case classification and summarisation, technician assistance, smart ticket allocation, capacity and demand forecasting, audit and anomaly detection, and predictive service analytics.
* Ensure AI solutions are integrated appropriately into Salesforce workflows and user experiences.
* Establish governance around data, security, accuracy and responsible AI adoption.

6\. Data, Analytics \& Performance Management
  

* Define the Salesforce data architecture supporting service analytics and reporting.
* Ensure data quality, consistency and availability across the service ecosystem.
* Enable role\-based dashboards for service leaders, managers, partners and field teams.
* Work with data and analytics teams to enable predictive service insights.
* Establish architecture that supports measurement of warranty cost, first\-time\-fix, turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

7\. Governance \& Technical Leadership
  

* Act as the technical authority for Salesforce architecture within Service 2\.0\.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical specifications and major changes.
* Establish Salesforce development, configuration, integration and release\-management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform optimisation.
* Ensure appropriate Salesforce licensing and platform utilisation.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Mentor Salesforce developers, administrators and implementation partners.

8\. Partner \& Programme Management
  

* Work closely with Salesforce, system integrators and technology partners.
* Provide technical direction to implementation partners and ensure adherence to the target architecture.
* Challenge solution designs where required and ensure commercial and technical decisions are aligned.
* Support programme planning, estimation, prioritisation and technology\-roadmap decisions.
* Ensure successful transition from implementation to sustainable operations and support.

Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

The Salesforce Architect will be expected to deliver:
  

* Robust target\-state Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Scalable Salesforce Service Cloud and Field Service architecture across the pan\-India service network.
* Seamless integration between Salesforce, SAP, partners and digital channels.
* Mobile\-first and technician\-centric service workflows.
* Intelligent allocation, scheduling and capacity\-management capabilities.
* WhatsApp\-first customer engagement and self\-service journeys.
* AI/GenAI\-enabled service capabilities with measurable business value.
* Reliable service data and performance dashboards.
* Strong platform governance, security, scalability and maintainability.
* Reduction in technical debt and unnecessary customisation.
* Architecture aligned to measurable improvements in warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, service turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

Candidate Profile
  

Education
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications are strongly preferred.

Experience
  

* 10–15\+ years of overall technology experience, with significant experience in Salesforce architecture and enterprise application transformation.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience across Salesforce Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Service.
* Experience designing large\-scale Salesforce implementations involving complex integrations and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience in field service, after\-sales service, customer service or service transformation is highly desirable.
* Experience working with large distributed field/service networks is an advantage.
* Experience in enterprise\-scale digital transformation programmes involving multiple technology platforms.

Salesforce Expertise
  

Strong understanding of:
  

* Salesforce Service Cloud
* Salesforce Field Service
* Service Console
* Case Management
* Work Orders and Service Appointments
* Scheduling and optimisation
* Omni\-Channel
* Salesforce APIs and integration patterns
* Platform Events / event\-driven architecture
* Apex and Lightning architecture
* Data modelling and security architecture
* Salesforce Flow and automation
* Experience Cloud / digital experience
* Salesforce reporting and analytics
* Salesforce AI/GenAI capabilities

Integration \& Technology Skills
  

* Strong understanding of enterprise integration architecture.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience or understanding of SAP integration and enterprise master\-data concepts.
* Knowledge of cloud architecture, API security and identity/access management.
* Understanding of data platforms, analytics and AI/ML architectures.
* Ability to assess build\-vs\-buy and standard\-vs\-customisation decisions.

Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies
  

The candidate should demonstrate:
  

* Strong enterprise architecture thinking with the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
* Excellent understanding of customer\-service and field\-service processes.
* Ability to simplify complex technology landscapes.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence business and technology leaders without relying solely on hierarchical authority.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Commercial orientation and ability to evaluate technology investments based on ROI.
* Ability to work effectively with internal teams, vendors and implementation partners.
* Strong ownership and accountability for architecture decisions and outcomes.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously evaluate emerging Salesforce, AI and digital technologies.

Preferred Certifications
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) – highly desirable
* Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Field Service Consultant
* Salesforce Platform Developer certifications
* Relevant integration/cloud architecture certifications

029d29a0.title: Managed Services Consultant
029d29a0.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.


By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.


Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**  

Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining platform solutions across digital and voice channels. Focus on execution, operational stability, customer support, and ongoing platform adoption.  

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Support configuration and maintenance of Sprinklr CCaaS solutions across chat, messaging, email, social, and voice channels.
* Execute platform updates aligned to defined solution blueprints, best practices, and core configuration architecture.
* Assist in configuring and maintaining routing logic, queues, IVR flows, case workflows, SLA rules, and escalations.
* Support bot workflows, automation rules, and bot\-to\-agent handoff configurations to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify basic platform gaps, configuration issues, and optimization opportunities, and recommend improvements aligned to customer requirements.
* Help maintain platform adoption by supporting users in understanding and using configured features effectively.
* Provide day\-to\-day support for post go\-live enhancements, troubleshooting, and configuration changes.
* Assist in monitoring customer operations metrics such as SLA adherence, queue performance, response times, and agent productivity.
* Support basic API, CRM, and third\-party integration activities, including validation and workflow coordination.
* Help onboard and train new agents, admins, and users on workflows, platform usage, and best practices.
* Work closely with Lead consultants and customer stakeholders to ensure configurations remain aligned to business needs and solution design.
* Support Customer Success and Sales teams by sharing platform adoption updates and operational insights where relevant.
* Document configurations, update process guides, and contribute to reusable knowledge and best practices.

  

  

**What Makes You Qualified?**  

  

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in CCaaS, managed services, technical support, or platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco, or other contact center technologies.
* Experience with queues, routing, workflows, dashboards, SLA setup, or case management.
* Foundational understanding of IVR, telephony concepts, chatbot workflows, and platform automation.
* Basic knowledge of API, CRM integration concepts, and cross\-system workflow dependencies.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and configuration support skills.

  

  

**Good to Have Skills**

* Exposure to digital and social engagement channels.
* Understanding of customer support operations and service KPIs.
* Experience supporting user training and onboarding.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.

  

  

**Who You Are**

* Detail\-oriented and hands\-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer\-facing, fast\-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.

  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Accurate and reliable platform configurations.
* Stable day\-to\-day CCaaS operations and timely issue resolution.
* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

 **We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.


To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.


To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO \- Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.


Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.


If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

4eddbf64.title: Senior Cloud Engineer, Cloud Platform
4eddbf64.description:
About Kinaxis:
**About Kinaxis**


Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!  

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.  

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
About the team:
**Location**


Chennai, India


**About the team**


The Senior Cloud Engineer, as a fully proficient seasoned professional, contributes to the software development lifecycle process for the cloud platform. This includes design, implementation, testing, and troubleshooting features of advanced complexity that span multiple teams. The incumbent will support solutions delivered in production environments as required.


The successful candidate actively mentors junior engineers, serves as a technical advisor to managers and team leads, and acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in one or more domains. The role requires close collaboration with internal engineering and product teams to develop, maintain, and enhance cloud platform solutions.


About the role:
**What you will do**

* Lead, collaborate, and coordinate across multiple teams as a technical primary on assigned features to clarify problems and proactively develop long\-term solutions. Ensure requirements are met, and implementation, execution, and testing are delivered with excellence.
* Design, build, and operate secure, scalable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and automation frameworks.
* Contribute to and support the production SaaS ecosystem, ensuring solutions are designed and implemented with operability, security, performance, scalability, and availability in mind.
* Follow the software development lifecycle to translate business and technical requirements into infrastructure as code.
* Build and enhance CI/CD platforms, deployment pipelines, and self\-service capabilities to improve developer productivity, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Implement code of advanced complexity that spans multiple areas of functionality with performance and testability in mind. Apply software engineering principles to operational challenges with a focus on automation, security, self\-healing, and monitoring solutions.
* Troubleshoot issues within the cloud platform, identify defects, provide explanations for platform behavior across multiple components, and recommend solutions and workarounds for engineering teams. Resolve and test moderate to advanced defects.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and metrics to track platform health, cloud usage, and costs. Drive process improvement initiatives focused on reliability and cost optimization.
* Operate in a security and regulated environment by applying best practices for IAM, role\-based access controls, network security, vulnerability management, environment isolation, and compliance requirements.

**Technologies we use**

* GCP, Azure, AWS, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub
* Actions Docker Packer GKE AKS Kubernetes Helm HashiCorp
* Vault Python Go Shell/Bash JFrog Artifactory Datadog Prometheus ELK Windows
* Server Argo CD Capsule Workload Identity Federation Auth0 Entra
* ID Okta Patchman Rundeck Aptly JIRA ServiceNow

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent related discipline.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or a related field.
* Strong experience designing, building, and operating cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience working with public cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, with GCP preferred.
* Proficiency with Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, and automation tooling.
* Experience developing automation solutions and tooling using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, networking, security, and cloud governance best practices.
* Experience troubleshooting complex platform and infrastructure issues in production environments.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and security teams.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical knowledge sharing within a team environment.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and Scrum practices.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server administration, automation, and lifecycle management is considered an asset.
* Kinaxis product knowledge is considered an asset.

**Nice to Have**

* GCP Landing Zone or Azure enterprise\-scale architecture experience
* NetApp CVS / cloud storage volume configuration
* Capsule multi\-tenancy for Kubernetes namespace management
* Image security scanning — Trivy, SBOM, cosign signing
* RapidResponse or supply chain platform exposure
* Windows Server enterprise environment experience
* Aptly Debian package repository management
* Shared services administration — WSUS, EFT, Syncovery, Postfix

**Required Skills** **Cloud Infrastructure:**

* 7\+ years hands\-on experience with public cloud platforms GCP, Azure, or AWS — console and API (GCP preferred)
* Strong Terraform — modules, layered architecture, state management, remote backends
* Ansible — roles, playbooks, Windows (WinRM) and Linux targets
* GKE / AKS — cluster operations, node pools, Workload Identity Federation, namespace management
* Experience automating cloud solutions — applications, infrastructure, storage, platforms, and data

**Networking \& Security:**

* GCP VPC networking — hub\-and\-spoke, shared VPC, NCC, NAT, DNS, VPN
* Azure networking — VNet peering, private endpoints, NSGs
* IAM design — service accounts, role bindings, least\-privilege patterns
* Identity providers — Auth0, Entra ID, Okta
* HashiCorp Vault — secrets management, dynamic credentials
* Strong knowledge of system design to manage operational and reliability trade\-offs

**CI/CD \& Image Automation:**

* GitHub Actions — reusable workflows, self\-hosted ARC runners on GKE, release automation
* Docker, Kubernetes, Helm — container orchestration and application delivery
* Packer — image builds, provisioners, multi\-region publishing
* Argo CD / GitOps — application delivery and environment onboarding
* Artifact management — JFrog Artifactory or equivalent registries
* Windows Server automation — prerequisites, patching, hardening via Ansible

**Identity \& Platform Tooling:**

* Workload Identity Federation — service account provisioning, GCP and Azure IAM bindings
* GKE namespace management — Capsule multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation
* YAML\-based environment configuration — deployment manifests, globals, environment\-specific overrides
* Development in Go, Python, and Shell/Bash — CLI tooling and platform automation
* Practical understanding of Agile methodologies and Scrum

**Leadership \& Collaboration:**

* Experience leading or mentoring a team of platform or infrastructure engineers
* Ability to define technical direction, break down epics into stories, and drive delivery across a squad
* Comfortable working across teams — security, product, customer success — to align on platform requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication — ADRs, runbooks, and technical documentation for multiple audiences
* Advanced analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills
* Agile and adaptable — excels at managing and prioritising workloads in an environment of ongoing urgency and change

**Operations:**

* Linux patching automation — Patchman, Rundeck, Aptly package repository management
* Monitoring and alerting — Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Log Analytics, GCP Cloud Monitoring
* Incident response — runbooks, escalation, post\-mortems


\#Intermediate \#LI\-RJ1 \#Fulltime

**Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

*People matter* at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com.


Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.*

a9b35525.title: Learning Program Manager
a9b35525.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**


Crowe seeks a dynamic **Learning Manager** who will be crucial in developing and delivering innovative, high\-impact learning solutions. This position requires a blend of project management, quality control, critical thinking, and vendor oversight to ensure the successful execution of learning programs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Project Management and Quality Control:**

* Collaborate with the India Talent Leader, India BU Directors, firmwide Learning team and other stakeholders to manage multiple high\-priority learning projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and successful implementation.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Serve as a project manager liaising with multiple stakeholders to support the development and delivery of learning solutions end\-to\-end.
* Conduct thorough quality reviews to ensure learning materials meet high standards.
* Implement quality control processes to enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of learning solutions.
* Ensure meticulous attention to detail in course development and delivery.

**Learning Content Curation and Design**

* Develop innovative and engaging learning programs (e.g., in\-person, virtual, e\-learning, microlearning) aligned to the business strategy
* Curate content (e.g., courses, microlearning, videos, podcasts) from existing learning assets and vendor content
* Oversee and manage large in\-person and/or virtual training events

**Stakeholder Engagement and Communication:**

* Liaise with key stakeholders, internal business partners, and design teams to translate internal partners' needs while managing tight timelines.
* Maintain effective and appropriate written and verbal US business communication skills in a business environment.

**Technology and Innovation:**

* Utilize technology such as AI tools like ChatGPT and CoPilot to acquire knowledge and skills for various content development and delivery engagements.
* Incorporate online and technology\-enhanced course components to improve learning across different delivery modes.

**Facilitation and Vendor Management:**

* Support the facilitation of in\-office learning events in Crowe India offices, including logistics, course designs, communication, and course follow up.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with Crowe’s existing and new external vendors to ensure the delivery of high\-quality learning solutions.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Instructional Design, Education, Instructional Systems Design, Adult Education, Project Management, or a related field.
* 12\-15 years of experience with at least 5\-6 years of experience developing learning solutions based on industry\-recognized adult learning theory and learning design.
* Experience with LMS systems (preferred)
* Experience with AI tools specifically ChatGPT and CoPilot (preferred)
* Working knowledge of designing and developing in Articulate 360 and other digital solutions.
* Strong planning, project management, communication, and coordination abilities specifically working in Microsoft Teams and Planner
* Ability to work collaboratively across cross\-functional teams to guide the development of extraordinary learning experiences.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams
* Critical thinking skills to analyze course goals and instructional strategies, ensuring they align with evidence\-based practices.


This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative learning solutions while ensuring the highest standards of quality and efficiency. If you are a proactive and detail\-oriented professional with a passion for learning and development, we encourage you to apply.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

d6421746.title: Implementation Program Manager
d6421746.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
   

  

 By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
   

  

 With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
   

  

 Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order.  As an Implementation Program Manager you will be the face of Stord as we grow our
   

  

 business and partnerships together with our customers. You will be responsible for driving the
   

  

 onboarding experience of new customers to Stord's supply chain solutions, as well as enabling
   

  

 the brand growth of existing customers as they launch new channels, services, and products to
   

  

 their end\-customers.

* Services engagements; and gracefully and seamlessly adjust to rapidly changing


 priorities in that portfolio

 post\-deployment feedback, and translating customer enhancement requests to
   

  

 requirements and SOPs

 resource limitations, tight timelines, evolving scope changes, milestone risks and project
   

  

 budget constraints) with discretion and thoughtfulness towards both customer and Stord
   

  

 goals
   

  

* Track progress and performance in customer onboarding process (meeting


 timelines/scope commitments, delivering revenue), including identifying and
   

  

 implementing new KPIs and metrics to measure and improve our existing processes
   

  

* Spearhead the design and execution of innovative technology solutions and


 implementation of new systems/processes for existing customers across our supply
   

  

 chain network, such as the deployment of new internal tools for employee use, or
   

  

 migrating customers from legacy systems to Stord software
   

  

* Provide feedback to refine, develop and evolve Stord’s service offering, solution design

* Act as a culture warrior for Stord values, as well as an advocate for continuous


 improvement, by identifying opportunities and efficiencies in Supply Chain and across
   

  

 the organization
   

  

**What You'll Need**

 precision and succinctness
   

  

* Willingness to be a versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure, bold in

* The endless drive and resilience to remove barriers and enable teams to complete their


 objectives, and the charisma to lead and bring together members from functional,
   

  

 technical and operational to achieve program goals
   

  

* Experience in a cross\-functional, customer\-oriented change role such as a consultant,


 manager, or customer implementation manager in a supply chain services, SaaS, and/or
   

  

 consulting environment
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to deliver results in a complex, fast\-paced environment while


 balancing multiple priorities, mitigating risks, and effectively managing limited resources

 with customer obsession and successful business outcomes as core drivers
   

  

* Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% for customer\-critical milestones such as


 kickoffs and go\-lives; building strong customer relationships and leveraging effective

**Strongly Encouraged**

 and/or fulfillment solutions

**Description**

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 6\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level

 RSM US India (USI) supports RSM US LLP’s Risk Consulting, Transaction Advisory, Technical Accounting, Financial Consulting, Technology and Management Consulting, Tax, and Assurance practices by providing access to highly skilled professionals for scalable and repeatable business processes across an extended business day. USI is a member of RSM International, the sixth largest global network of independent accounting, tax, and consulting firms.
   

  

**Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement – Functional Manager**
 RSM’s Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Dynamics 365 CE) practice is a team of highly specialized, multi\-disciplinary professionals delivering innovative Microsoft business application solutions for global clients.
   

  

 RSM is seeking a
 **Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) Functional Manager** 
 who blends deep, hands\-on configuration and customization experience with the leadership skills to run multiple concurrent engagements. The ideal candidate brings end\-to\-end mastery of the Dynamics 365 CE suite and the Microsoft Power Platform, sound solution architecture judgment, strong client presence, and a passion for growing the next generation of consultants. **Key Responsibilities**
* Hands\-on configuration, customization, and implementation experience of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement applications and the Power Platform to meet complex client business needs
* Translate complex business problems into clear functional specifications, solution designs, and architecture recommendations across CE, integrations, and the broader Microsoft cloud
* Own functional and architectural integrity across all phases of the project lifecycle — discovery, design, build, test, deployment, and post\-go\-live support
* Lead and oversee multiple concurrent Dynamics 365 CE engagements, owning delivery quality, risk, and outcomes across a portfolio of projects
* Serve as a trusted advisor to US\-based engagement leaders and client stakeholders, managing priorities, timelines, escalations, and deliverables across time zones
* Facilitate design reviews, demos, and solution walkthroughs with confidence and clarity
* Review and quality\-assure work products — including configuration, customization, testing, and documentation
* Direct data migration, integrations, security model design, and ALM strategy (solutions, pipelines, managed environments) across engagements
* Coach, mentor, and develop junior talent across the team; provide performance feedback, career guidance, and hands\-on knowledge transfer
* Support post\-go\-live activities including hypercare, enhancements, governance, and continuous improvement

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong executive presence

e92f3632.title: Manager, Solution Configuration (India)
e92f3632.description:
SavvyMoney is a US based leading financial technology company. We provide integrated credit score and personal finance solutions to 1,600 \+ bank and credit union partners nationally. The SavvyMoney solutions integrate with more than 43 digital banking platforms.

 **SavvyMoney was recently recognized by the San Francisco Business Times and the Silicon Valley Journal as one of the "Top 25 Places to Work in the San Francisco Bay Area" and is an Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Company.**

  

\*\*This position will be working 100% Remotely from your home office in India as part of a distributed team in the USA, Canada, Europe and several locations in India. The working hours for this position still overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.


As a SavvyMoney **Manager, Solution Configuration**, you will be responsible for \-

**Position Requirements \-**
----------------------------

 **People Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop a large configuration team that completes high\-volume, technically complex work for multiple partner implementations at the same time
* Build and maintain a capacity model that shows how much work the team can complete in a given period
* Use the capacity model to forecast when the team is over\-allocated, and raise it before due dates are missed
* Assign and balance work across the team based on skill level, task complexity, and partner priority
* Onboard new team members using a documented training plan with clear steps to independent work
* Set clear performance expectations, hold regular one on one meetings, and report team gaps and development needs to leadership

**Schedule and Delivery Management**

* Own configuration timelines and due dates for all active implementations, and keep them accurate when scope or sequence changes
* Identify delays, dependencies, and risks early, take action to reduce them, and escalate with a recommended solution
* Track and report metrics such as cycle time, throughput, rework, and on\-time completion, and use them to improve results
* Work with Implementation Managers, Engineering, and Product to sequence work and remove blockers before they affect partner go\-live dates

**Process Excellence**

* Define, document, and improve the configuration process, including intake, prioritization, peer review, validation, and handoff
* Confirm the team follows the documented process, and identify where process needs to be improved
* Standardize repeatable work using templates, checklists, and automation to reduce errors and manual effort
* Facilitate retrospectives, and turn the findings into documented process changes
* Build reports that are clear, accurate, and easy for leadership to read and act on
* Build trust with stakeholders across Implementations, Engineering, and Product by giving accurate status and completing what you commit to
* Act as the expert user of Jira and Confluence for the configuration team. This includes workflows, custom fields, automation rules, JQL, filters, and dashboards
* Define and enforce Jira ticketing standards so every configuration request can be tracked from intake through validation
* Build and maintain Confluence as the team's single source of truth, including process guides, configuration runbooks, standards, decision logs, and onboarding material

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BS/BA in a technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems, or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years in technical project management, delivery management, or technical operations, including 3\+ years managing a team of 10 or more people
* Expert\-level Jira and Confluence administration, including workflows, automation, JQL, dashboards, and space setup
* Experience leading a distributed team across multiple time zones
* Strong written and verbal English communication, including the ability to write a clear status report for senior leadership
* Willingness to work hours that overlap U.S. Eastern Time, and to complete hands\-on work alongside the team when needed

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Online Banking platforms, Loan Origination Systems, or consumer lending and deposit products
* Experience working with credit unions, banks, or fintech partners on implementation or onboarding

**Base Salary**
---------------


The annual fixed salary for this position is between 15L and 26L Annually based upon experience \+ Variable.

**Additionally we provide**

* Equity Compensation Package
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) \- take time off as needed to rest and recharge.
* Medical, Dental, Vision – 100% premium paid for employee
* Disability/Life Insurance
* Opportunity for learning and career growth with a top Bay Area technology company
* Reimbursement for remote work setup
* Monthly stipend for phone and internet
* Team building events, culture activities, all hands events
* Paid time off to volunteer and serve the community
* Half day Fridays
* 401k matching contribution
* Beautiful California East Bay offices in Dublin, CA

SavvyMoney relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical solutions serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all programs and activities. **Description**
 At AEE Expansions, we build the systems and strategies that bring Amazon to customers around the world. From launching in entirely new countries to enabling lightweight market\-entry models, our mission is to expand Amazon’s global footprint at massive scale — fast, reliably, and with customer obsession at the center.
   

  

 We’ve already launched Amazon in 10\+ countries, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 As a TPM at AEE, you will lead large\-scale international expansion programs that require deep coordination across hundreds of Amazon teams spanning technology, operations, finance, legal, compliance, supply chain, and customer experience. 3f0d2d0a.description:
**Description**
 No other single team in Amazon provide exposure to end to end life cycle of e\-commerce: Welcome to World Wide Returns, and Re\-commerce (WWR\&R). We redefines e\-commerce and start where the typical e\-commerce supply chain stops. We innovate to support net\-zero carbon, Amazon climate pledge and works backwards from there. In most cases, our work starts even before customer purchases: in providing information about return policies on detail page/search \& during check\-out. and developing products to support end to end post purchase support needs. We support all post purchase customer needs starting from product usage troubleshooting support to return experience, transportation, reverse\-fulfillment, reverse supply chain and reselling. We provide returns as a service to for WW Amazon business across all channels (Retail, FBA, Merchant Fulfillment) and subsidiaries (Zappos, Woot), Customer Service applications and Amazon physical stores.
   

  

 Amazon Returns policies \& experience are foundational to Amazon’s e\-Commerce and one of the primary reasons why customers love shopping on Amazon. Returns policy communication on the detail page is among the top detail\-page features that increases Customer confidence and the Customer Trust Perception Index (CTPI) for purchase decision. This team has revolutionized the returns for customers through simplest possible experience with no need to print label \& do packaging and quickest refund time. Providing Great Returns Experience is complex due to negative customer sentiments while returning the product. Our team has been very successful in ensuring the lowest return rates and best in class return experience for Amazon as against other E\-commerce competitors.
   

  

 Below are some of the videos explaining the journey and CX of our team :
   

  

* Main Video (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415554\) (6m 40s): Overview of R\&R Business
* Introduction to Seller options (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415558\) (1m 44s): Overview of Seller Return \& Recovery options
* Introduction to LFBF (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/416088\) (1m 46s): Introduction to Label\-Free/Box\-Free returns


 The team is expanding its charter and is going to hire 50\+ employees in 2022 across all tech roles to define returns \& recovery options as a service for its merchant, FBA, bulk and Amazon business customers and to solve hard technical problems related to optimization of reverse supply chain channel. As a member of this team, your mission will be to evolve returns \& re\-commerce systems as highly modular \& customizable multi\-tenet platform to enable growth of e\-commerce business \& volumes and not only reduce cost of reverse supply chain but to even make it profitable business. You will be using wide range of AWS services, Java, object\-oriented design patterns, and latest storage, workflow, orchestration and UI technologies to build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving re\-commerce business requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for software engineers with 3\+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
   

  

 Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns, \& ReCommerce team!

* 6\+ years of experience delivering complex enterprise applications, digital transformation, or technology modernization projects.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience considered.
* Understanding of enterprise application architecture, cloud technologies, system integrations, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and data platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM or comparable CRM platforms supporting sales, customer service, or customer engagement functions.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Power Automate, Dataverse, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power BI, SharePoint, Jira, Confluence, Teams, or similar enterprise technology ecosystems.
* Experience delivering projects involving APIs, middleware, data migration, master data management, reporting platforms, workflow automation, and enterprise integrations.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, release management, testing strategies, QA coordination, environment management, and production support transitions.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, Copilot solutions, agentic systems, machine learning\-enabled workflows, and intelligent automation platforms.


**Project \& Leadership Experience**
* Proven ability to lead large\-scale, cross\-functional technology projects involving engineering, architecture, product, security, and business teams.
* Experience managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, resource planning, risk mitigation, and executive governance processes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to make data\-driven decisions in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into executive\-ready business messaging.
* Ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels and drive alignment across competing priorities.
* Demonstrated success delivering results within fast\-paced, global, matrixed organizations.

Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

 At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.
   

  

 We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.
   

  

 Are you curious about being part of our growth stor y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.
   

  

 Iron Mountain is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Solutions Architect, Private Cloud \& Datacenter Security to join our Global Technology Solutions team.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for leading the technical discovery, architectural design, and security integration of comprehensive private cloud and hyperconverged infrastructure solutions for prospective clients.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to modernization, driving technical excellence, and acting as trusted advisors to help organizations navigate complex digital transformations safely and efficiently.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a track record of translating complex technical information for both technical and non\-technical audiences.

* Highly valued industry certifications such as Nutanix Certified Professional/Master (NCP/NCM), VMware Certified Advanced Professional/Design Expert (VCAP/VCDX), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or Cisco Certified Network Associate/Professional (CCNA/CCNP).

0cb089c4.title: Solutions Architect, AWS India Public Sector
0cb089c4.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of Amazon Web Services India Private Limited. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTech startups including India\-based Unicorns, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
   

  

 We are known for our customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.
   

  

 If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge. Along the way, you’ll share with and learn from talented team members all focused on helping customers explore the benefits of moving from on\-premise infrastructure to the cloud.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
   

  

 You will do well in this role if you demonstrate excellent customer\-facing communication skills representing technical solutions at senior leadership levels. You thrive on diving deep into complex technology environments and express these as industry standard architecture diagrams and well\-articulated solution narratives. You will be right at home if you stay updated on latest technology trends and have a sense of urgency and hunger for learning more about customer business and relevant technology solutions across industries. Solutions architects love to travel, spending time with diverse customers, small and large, self\-manage high intensity context switching between competing priorities, and demonstrate a sense of urgency to deliver results.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Delivering to primary responsibilities of a solutions architect you will 1\) establish technical credibility in sales cycles for Amazon platforms, technologies, and the company, by collaborating with the sales team to win new business; 2\) capture and convey best practices and provide prescriptive guidance around application and systems design on the Amazon platforms and technologies, via direct customer and partner interaction, development of technical content, events, evangelism, training, and operational event support; and 3\) help drive the evolution of the Amazon platforms and technologies by providing direct input and feedback from the field to the engineering teams developing these offerings. Finally, tenured team members are tasked with recruiting, hiring, and developing top SA talent; managing and applying that resource in a prudent and efficient way; and driving cross\-organizational initiatives related to the areas identified above.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You’re surrounded by innovation. You’re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, it's always "Day 1".
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

85f7deb7.title: Enterprise Solution Engineer
85f7deb7.description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 This role owns technical success for Sprinto's most complex enterprise deals, partnering with senior CISOs and executive stakeholders across regulated industries. It combines deep information security expertise, enterprise solution design, and stakeholder management to drive complex sales cycles, influence product direction, enable seamless implementation handoffs, and establish best practices for enterprise solution engineering.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
* Own the technical strategy and solutioning for Sprinto's most complex enterprise opportunities across BFSI, telecom, manufacturing, critical infrastructure, and other regulated industries
* Build trusted relationships with senior CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, GRC leaders, and executive stakeholders by confidently discussing security architecture, control design, compliance frameworks, and risk management
* Lead technical discovery, solution workshops, and tailored product demonstrations for complex, multi\-entity enterprise environments
* Design and execute proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), sandbox evaluations, solution architectures, and business cases with clearly defined success criteria
* Partner closely with Account Executives to navigate long, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles involving security, IT, procurement, legal, compliance, and business teams
* Drive technical wins by addressing enterprise security reviews, technical objections, and regulatory requirements across multiple frameworks
* Ensure seamless handoffs to implementation and Customer Success teams, enabling successful customer onboarding and long\-term adoption
* Act as the voice of enterprise customers by influencing Sprinto's product roadmap with insights from regulated industries and large\-scale deployments
* Build and continuously improve enterprise solution engineering assets, including playbooks, competitive positioning, framework\-specific messaging, and demo environments
* Mentor Solution Engineers and help establish best practices for engaging senior technical buyers across enterprise accounts


**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
