085c1979.title: Solution Engineer - ITSM
085c1979.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
 



  
 



 ITSM serves as a trusted technical advisor and partner to the sales organization, helping prospective and existing customers evaluate and adopt SolarWinds IT Service Management solutions, including SolarWinds Service Desk (SWSD) and Web Help Desk (WHD). This role combines technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills to demonstrate how SolarWinds solutions address customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.
 



 The Solution Engineer partners closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product Management, and other cross\-functional teams to drive revenue growth, support customer success, and provide market feedback. Success in this role requires a consultative approach, the ability to understand customer business objectives, and the technical skills to architect and demonstrate effective solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner with Sales teams throughout the customer lifecycle to support new business, expansion, and renewal opportunities.
* Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer business objectives, operational challenges, technical requirements, and success criteria.
* Deliver compelling product demonstrations of SolarWinds Service Desk and Web Help Desk tailored to customer use cases and business outcomes.
* Design and support proof\-of\-concept (POC) and trial engagements, enabling customers to validate solution value through guided evaluation.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on IT Service Management best practices, workflows, automation, service delivery, and operational maturity.
* Develop technical strategies and solution recommendations that align with customer business goals.
* Respond to technical questions, RFPs, RFIs, security questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support teams to advocate for customer requirements and improve product offerings.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, market developments, competitive positioning, and emerging technologies within ITSM and Enterprise Service Management.
* Support enablement initiatives, internal training, partner activities, and field marketing programs as needed.
* Provide feedback to internal stakeholders on customer requirements, market opportunities, and competitive dynamics.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, IT Operations, IT Service Management, or a related technical customer\-facing role.
* Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM), service desk operations, or enterprise software solutions.
* Strong presentation and demonstration skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
* Excellent discovery, problem\-solving, and consultative selling skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and business outcomes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel as required.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with ITSM platforms such as SolarWinds Service Desk, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, ManageEngine, BMC, Ivanti/Cherwell, or similar solutions.
* Knowledge of ITIL frameworks and service management best practices.
* ITIL certification preferred.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, APIs, integrations, and workflow automation.
* Experience supporting enterprise software sales cycles and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Familiarity with identity management, asset management, enterprise workflows, and service delivery operations.



**Key Competencies** 



* Customer Focus
* Technical Discovery
* Consultative Selling
* Technical Storytelling
* Demonstration Excellence
* Business Acumen
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration
* Communication
* Adaptability
* Strategic Thinking
* Relationship Building



**Success Measures** 




 Success in this role will be measured through contribution to sales outcomes, customer satisfaction, technical excellence, cross\-functional collaboration, and the ability to drive successful customer evaluations and business value realization.

0006dfce.title: Sales & Solution Engineer
0006dfce.description:
**About Sycurio:**
 Sycurio is a global leader in secure, frictionless payment solutions that empower enterprises to enhance customer experience and simplify compliance. Its patented cloud\-based technologies protect sensitive data across all customer interactions and channels, ensuring compliance with industry standards like PCI DSS while reducing fraud risk and strengthening trust. Founded in 2009 as Semafone, Sycurio supports organizations in over 50 countries across five continents, partnering with leading brands worldwide. Backed by major investor Livingbridge, Sycurio continues to pioneer solutions that make payments secure and seamless
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Sycurio is seeking a Sales \& Solution Engineer based in Bengaluru to serve as the technical lead for opportunities developed with global BPOs, GSIs, MSPs and consulting partners. The role will support partners serving enterprise customers across the United States, United Kingdom and EMEA, helping them position, design and validate secure payment solutions across contact\-center and digital environments.
   

  

 This person will work as a trusted technical advisor to partner sales and solution teams, translating customer requirements into scalable designs and commercially viable solutions. The role combines hands\-on pre\-sales execution, partner enablement and technical ecosystem development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical opportunity ownership: Own technical discovery, qualification, solution design and validation for assigned partner\-led opportunities
* Partner co\-selling: Support partner account teams, client partners and solution consultants in customer meetings, workshops, demos and technical evaluations
* Architecture and design: Create high\-level designs and scalable, template\-based architectures spanning CCaaS, telephony, IVR, CRM, cloud and payment ecosystems
* Technical risk management: Identify integration dependencies, security considerations and delivery risks early, and coordinate resolution with internal and partner teams
* Partner enablement: Train and enable partner sales engineers, architects and delivery teams through structured sessions, playbooks, reference architectures and reusable demonstration assets
* Value communication: Translate APIs, security, payments and compliance capabilities into clear business value for technical, operational and executive audiences
* RFx support: Provide structured, accurate and timely technical input for RFIs, RFPs, tenders, proposals and partner solution documents
* Product feedback: Capture recurring partner and customer requirements, competitive insights and integration needs, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering
* Demo and asset improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of demonstration environments, technical collateral and standardized solution assets
* Global collaboration: Work across Sycurio’s Partnerships, Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery and Marketing organizations and accommodate periodic US and UK business hours
* Be able to work on site at our office in Bangalore Monday \- Friday


**Experience Required**
* Five or more years of pre\-sales, sales engineering, solution consulting or partner solutions experience in enterprise SaaS or technology environments
* Strong expertise in at least one of the following domains: contact centers and CCaaS; telephony and IVR; CRM integrations; digital payments; or PCI\-compliant systems
* Experience supporting partner\-led sales motions with BPOs, GSIs, MSPs, consulting firms, OEMs or technology alliances
* Experience working with global service providers such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Concentrix, Presidio or comparable organizations is strongly preferred
* Experience working with AI/BOT technology including Google, AWS and others (Agentic, Multi\-Modal, Etc.)
* Working knowledge of API\-based architectures, cloud environments and system integrations; AWS experience is preferred
* Ability to produce clear high\-level designs, document requirements and explain data flows, dependencies and integration patterns
* Demonstrated success delivering customer presentations, technical workshops and product demonstrations to mixed technical and executive audiences
* Experience responding to RFIs, RFPs and enterprise tender requirements
* Excellent written and verbal English communication with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts
* Exposure to PCI DSS, payment security, omnichannel payments, fraud reduction or sensitive\-data protection is highly desirable


**Technical Strengths**
* REST APIs, webhooks and cloud\-based integration patterns
* Contact\-center platforms, telephony, IVR and external conferencing or call\-transfer architectures
* CRM, CCaaS and payment\-service\-provider ecosystems
* Security, compliance and sensitive\-data\-handling concepts
* Structured solution documentation, reusable architectures and commercially viable design decisions
* Chatbot design experience and understanding of programming languages, cloud functions and webhooks, API and system integration and dialog design


**What Success Looks Like**
* Partner\-led opportunities progress faster because technical requirements and risks are addressed early
* Partners can independently identify, position and initially qualify appropriate Sycurio use cases
* Solution designs are accurate, standardized, scalable and aligned with Sycurio product capabilities
* Customer demonstrations and workshops clearly connect technical capability to business outcomes
* Partner feedback is captured and converted into actionable input for Product and Engineering


**Why Join Sycurio**
* Help build a high\-priority global partner motion from a growing Bengaluru hub
* Work across major enterprise ecosystems spanning customer experience, cloud, payments and compliance
* Join a well\-funded international business that combines entrepreneurial pace with the discipline of an established organization
* Collaborate with global sales, partnerships, product, engineering, marketing and delivery leaders
* Receive competitive compensation, performance incentives and benefits aligned with the India market


 Sycurio is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination and reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing résumés or assessing responses. These tools support our recruitment team and do not replace human judgment; final hiring decisions are made by people. Candidates may contact Sycurio for further information about how their data is processed.
   

  

  

* All final interview candidates will be subject to Background check as a pre\-condition of a potential offer of employment. Any information found will be considered when making the final hiring decision. Please be aware that the background check process will not go ahead without your written consent

In this role, you will lead the design and operation of large\-scale distributed systems, drive modernization initiatives, influence architecture decisions, and establish engineering best practices across multiple teams. You will partner with development, quality engineering, product management, and operations teams to build highly available, secure, resilient, and scalable cloud\-native platforms.

* Mentor and coach engineers across multiple teams, fostering engineering excellence and best practices.

**Overview**
* Blue Yonder is a leading AI\-driven Digital Supply Chain and Cognitive Planning Solutions company, enabling global enterprises to transform end\-to\-end supply chain operations through intelligent, autonomous, scalable, and cloud\-native planning platforms.
* Leveraging advanced AI, Machine Learning, Optimization, and Agentic AI, Blue Yonder empowers smarter, faster, and more resilient decision\-making across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Fulfillment, Logistics, and Manufacturing.
* We are seeking highly skilled Solution Architects / Sr. Solution Architects with deep expertise in Supply Chain Planning implementations, strong consulting and solutioning capabilities, and proven customer engagement experience.


**Scope**
* Lead end\-to\-end implementations of Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning solutions (ESP, DSP, IO, OP, S\&OP/IBP, Production Planning, Supply Planning). Architect scalable, high\-performance planning solutions aligned with customer business objectives and industry best practices.
* Drive solution lifecycle from requirements gathering, design, configuration, integration, SIT/UAT, Go\-live, and Hypercare. Provide thought leadership on supply chain transformation initiatives and AI\-enabled planning journeys.
* Mentor consultants and guide implementation teams across functional and solution architecture areas.
* Support integration with ERP, APS, MES, WMS, TMS, Data Lakes, and Cloud platforms.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and validate complex supply planning models (multi\-echelon, constrained planning, deployment, inventory optimization, sourcing prioritization, capacity planning, scenario modeling).
* Handle challenges involving solver behavior, planning trade\-offs, data quality, performance optimization, and scalability.
* Develop solution design documents, functional specifications, data mapping, and testing strategies.
* Communicate business cases to Product Management and Development for future product enhancements.
* Support customer success initiatives, driving adoption of advanced planning capabilities.
* Act as a trusted advisor, enabling faster deployments and improved customer adoption through AI\-enabled methodologies.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain Planning implementations and consulting.
* Proven hands\-on implementation experience in BY ESP, Demand Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Order Promising, and Advanced Supply Chain Planning solutions.
* Strong implementation experience in similar planning platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, OMP, SAP APO / IBP, and Oracle Supply Chain Planning will be considered an added advantage.
* Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex global supply chain transformations across CPG, Hi\-Tech, Process Manufacturing, Automotive, and Industrial Manufacturing industries.
* Strong supply chain domain expertise is mandatory and non\-negotiable.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to independently drive solutioning discussions and architect scalable solutions for complex customer requirements.


**Good To Have**
* Experience in SQL Python
* Experience with ORACLE and SNOWFLAKE databases
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain data models
* Experience with cloud\-native planning architectures
* API and Integration architecture understanding
* BY Platform / Data Cloud / BYDM exposure


**AI / Digital Skills**
* Understanding of AI/ML\-driven planning capabilities in Supply Chain.
* Exposure to ML\-based forecasting and intelligent planning solutions.
* Knowledge or experience in Agentic AI, AI\-driven automation, or GenAI\-based implementation accelerators will be a strong advantage.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

96c00255.title: Senior Solution Architect, Generative AI - CSP
96c00255.description:
NVIDIA’s Solution Architect team is looking for a AI\-focused Solution Architect with expertise in Large Language Model, generative AI, agentic AI. We work with the most exciting computing hardware and software, driving the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence. We need individuals who can enable customer productivity and develop lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of end\-user solutions. We are looking for someone always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain constructive collaboration in a fast paced, rapidly evolving field, someone able to coordinate efforts between corporate marketing, industry business development and engineering. You will be working with the latest AI architecture coupled with the most advanced neural network models, changing the way people interact with technology.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Architect end\-to\-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.
* Engage directly with customers/partners to understand their requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG\-based solutions.


**What We Need To See**
* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* Expertise in training and fine\-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as Megatron\-LM, Megatron\-Bridge, AutoModel and PyTorch.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on\-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

c577b1ae.description:
**Key Responsibilities**
 Presales \& Client Engagement
   

  

* Partner with sales and industry teams to design client\-ready demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical solution blueprints.
* Present complex architectures in a clear, business\-outcome\-driven manner to both executive and technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and deal shaping.
* Act as a trusted advisor in client conversations, highlighting differentiators of Data \& AI Solutions.


 Solution Architecture \& Demo Environments
   

  

* Architect distributed, scalable, and resilient data and AI platforms for presales demonstrations.
* Design abstraction layers for multi\-model AI orchestration, including fallback logic, dynamic model switching, and cost control.
* Lead implementation of event\-driven architectures using messaging frameworks (Kafka, Pulsar, SQS, etc.) and state machines.
* Build reusable, industry\-specific demo environments leveraging hyperscaler services and data platforms.


 Observability, Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Define and enforce observability standards for demo and enterprise environments (logging, tracing, telemetry, real\-time alerting).
* Implement zero\-trust security models (RBAC/ABAC, IAM, OAuth2, encryption, API gateways).
* Ensure all demo and client environments meet compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2\.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Governance teams to align demos with business/regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with IMUs (verticals) to build domain\-specific demo templates (e.g., Insurance claims, Healthcare payment integrity, Banking KYC/fraud, Retail personalization).
* Provide hands\-on support to engineering teams during delivery, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.


 Innovation \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Stay ahead of hyperscaler advancements, AI/ML frameworks, and orchestration patterns.
* Drive technical due diligence, PoCs, and vendor/platform evaluations.
* Create technical artifacts (architecture diagrams, design patterns, runbooks).
* Mentor presales engineers and junior architects in solution design and client presentation skills.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications preferred: \- Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Kubernetes / CNCF ecosystem.
* Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, SAFe).


**Skills \& Experience**
 Must\-Have Skills \& Experience
   

  

* 15\+ years in software architecture, presales engineering, or enterprise data/AI platform design.
* Hands\-on expertise in at least two hyperscaler platforms: \- Azure (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure ML, Power BI).
* AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3, SageMaker, Lake Formation).
* GCP (BigQuery, Dataplex, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub).
* Proven experience architecting distributed systems, microservices, and scalable AI/ML platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata, Lineage, and DataOps.
* Expertise in event\-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
* Hands\-on with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Advanced programming with Python (async), TypeScript/JavaScript, or Go.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), serverless design patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD automation, GitOps, Terraform, Helm.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and client engagement skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS platforms and usage\-based billing.
* Familiarity with data mesh, knowledge graphs, and semantic interoperability.
* Knowledge of frontend architecture patterns (micro\-frontends, data visualizations).
* Experience building presales demo or sandbox environments.


 Exposure to agentic AI concepts and LLM\-based orchestration.

31f94850.title: Sr. Enterprise Solution Architect - Supply Planning, Manufacturing
31f94850.description:
**Scope**
* Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning \& Optimization solutions, driving business process transformation for global customers.
* Own solution architecture, integration strategy, effort estimation, and functional design while collaborating with cross\-functional teams across Pre\-Sales, Product Management, Consulting, and Customer IT.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders, providing industry best practices, solution recommendations, and leadership throughout the project lifecycle from discovery to post\-go\-live support.


**What You'll Do**
* Estimate workload for implementation activities within scope; assess integration complexity, architecture cost, and labor requirements.
* Lead business process analysis and design during the sales cycle and throughout development; create functional and technical specifications.
* Prepare and deliver presentations to user, management, and executive audiences.
* Assist Project Managers with planning and create detailed tasks for project plans, including sales‑cycle and post‑go‑live enhancements.
* Demonstrate and facilitate integration discussions of product functionality and architecture (e.g., end‑to‑end data and process flows).
* Identify and communicate incremental revenue and enhancement opportunities.
* Communicate business cases and product trend insights to management to influence future functionality and solution offerings.
* Develop or lead teams in producing functional specs for modifications, interfaces, reports, and screens that meet customer objectives and best‑practice design.
* Ensure knowledge transfer with Cloud Services, Consulting Services, and Support stakeholders.
* Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodologies; tailor Blue Yonder solutions to customer uniqueness and industry verticals.
* Serve as the functional liaison in key meetings between Project Managers, customer contacts, users, and executive sponsors.
* Work with consulting, Product Management, and Pre‑Sales to recommend which Blue Yonder applications solve specific business challenges.
* Help define functional and technical specs to ensure efficient implementation and integration between technical and functional requirements.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 13\+ years of professional experience in enterprise software delivery; at least 6–8 years in solution architecture or senior consulting roles.
* Proven track record leading end‑to‑end implementations for large, complex customers (requirements, design, integration, configuration, UAT, cutover).
* Hands‑on experience estimating implementation effort, scoping integrations, and defining architecture cost and labor.
* Strong domain experience in retail supply chain, planning, allocation, merchandising, or closely related verticals.
* Demonstrated ability to run business process workshops and translate outcomes into functional and technical specifications.
* Experience facilitating integration and data/process flow discussions across application stacks.
* Experience advising executive and management stakeholders and delivering executive‑level presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management across Pre‑Sales, Product Management, Cloud Services, Consulting, Operations, and Customer IT.
* Experience mentoring teams and conducting knowledge transfer to internal stakeholders.


**Additional Skills**
* Prior experience with Blue Yonder product suite or equivalent retail planning/allocation platforms.
* Experience with multi‑tenant SaaS delivery, cloud migrations, and enterprise SaaS operations.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with integration technologies and patterns (REST APIs, Kafka, Mulesoft, SFTP, AS2\) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Elasticsearch).
* Prior involvement in pre‑sales scoping and the ability to identify incremental revenue opportunities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a closely related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications (examples):
+ Cloud: Azure/AWS Solution Architect or equivalent
+ Enterprise architecture: TOGAF (or equivalent)
+ Delivery/project: PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum certifications (CSM, PMI‑ACP)
+ Blue Yonder product certifications (if available)

7f4ced97.title: Senior Guidewire Solution Architect
7f4ced97.description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
 At Wipro we are hiring a Senior Guidewire Solution Architect to lead architecture and delivery across large\-scale London Market transformation programmes. This role requires deep experience across the Guidewire Insurance Suite, including PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, as well as proven implementation experience across both Policy and Claims. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining solution architecture, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and supporting the successful delivery of complex transformation initiatives.
   

  

 As a technical leader and trusted advisor, the individual will work closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams and senior programme leadership to provide architectural direction and governance throughout the programme lifecycle. They will bring a strong understanding of Guidewire best practices, drive technical decision\-making, and help navigate complex enterprise environments to achieve successful business and technology outcomes.
 


 ͏
 
**What Your Day Will Look Like** 



* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture across Guidewire platforms, ensuring scalable, secure and business\-aligned solutions throughout the programme lifecycle.
* Lead design and integration activities across both Policy and Claims, driving consistency and best practice across implementations.
* Define, establish and govern architecture standards, integration patterns and technical frameworks to support enterprise\-wide transformation objectives.
* Act as the technical lead across delivery teams and third\-party vendors, providing guidance, oversight and architectural governance throughout delivery.
* Engage senior business and technology stakeholders as a trusted advisor, translating complex technical concepts into business value and strategic outcomes.
* Support solution shaping, RFP responses and pre\-sales activities by providing architectural expertise, solution vision and implementation strategy.



**This Role Is for You If** 



* Extensive experience of Guidewire spanning across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter and across complex insurance transformation programmes within an established consultancy firm.
* Demonstrate end\-to\-end Guidewire implementation expertise, from solution design through to delivery and deployment.
* Possess hands\-on implementation experience across both Policy and Claims environments.
* Apply strong London Market and Lloyd’s domain knowledge to support business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Leverage deep solution architecture and integration expertise, including API\-led and event\-driven architectures.
* Have experience with Guidewire Cloud and modernisation programmes, which is highly desirable.
* Exhibit strong stakeholder management and delivery leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior business and technology audiences.



**What You’ll Receive From Us**
 No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.
   

  

 We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.
 


 ͏ ͏ ͏
 
  
 



 Mandatory Skills: Consulting Presales .
 



  
 



 Experience: \>10 YEARS .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

f76c2d66.title: Solutions Architect
f76c2d66.description:
MongoDB is seeking a Partner Solutions Architect to focus on our Large Deals exclusively on strategic, high\-value pursuits with Global System Integrators (GSIs). This role will lead the technical strategy and execution of complex GSI\-led bids, helping MongoDB and its GSI partners develop differentiated solutions and secure large, strategic opportunities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will operate across MongoDB, GSI partners, customers, sales teams, delivery organizations, and executive stakeholders to develop compelling joint solutions, strengthen technical win strategies, and drive successful outcomes for large transformation programs.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates who are based in Bengaluru/Gurugram/Delhi/Hyderabad/Chennai for our hybrid working model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical architecture and solution strategy for large, complex, and strategic bids
* Partner with sales, bid leadership, account teams, product specialists, services, legal, finance, and executive sponsors to deliver coordinated pursuits
* Develop joint value propositions, solution architectures, technical proposals, statements of work, and bid responses
* Engage partner architects and delivery teams to validate feasibility, implementation approach, scope, risks, and dependencies
* Facilitate technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations, proof\-of\-value activities, and executive presentations
* Translate customer business outcomes into scalable MongoDB\-based architectures and partner delivery models
* Shape partner\-led modernization, migration, cloud, application development, data, analytics, and AI solutions
* Identify technical risks, competitive threats, delivery constraints, and commercial considerations early in the bid lifecycle
* Create reusable bid assets, reference architectures, technical content, and best practices for future pursuits
* Ensure proposed solutions align with MongoDB product capabilities, partner expertise, security requirements, and customer success criteria
* Support deal qualification, opportunity prioritization, account planning, and pipeline\-generation activities
* Coordinate technical responses across multiple partners and ensure consistency in messaging, assumptions, and commitments
* Mentor field Solutions Architects and partner technical teams on large\-bid strategy and execution
* Capture field feedback and communicate product, capability, and partner requirements to internal teams


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience in a customer\-facing Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architect, Presales Architect, Consulting Architect, or equivalent role
* Experience supporting complex enterprise bids, tenders, RFPs, or strategic pursuits
* Proven ability to design and communicate distributed, scalable, secure, and highly available architectures
* Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), including GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, modern application architectures, microservices, APIs, data platforms, and DevOps
* Experience developing technical proposals, solution designs, presentations, and executive\-level bid content
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, work under tight deadlines, and drive outcomes in ambiguous situations
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to explain complex technical and business concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences
* Willingness to travel as required for customer and partner engagements
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with MongoDB, Atlas, relational database modernization, or NoSQL technologies
* MongoDB certification or certification with a major cloud provider
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience in large\-scale transformation, legacy modernization, data modernization, AI/ML, or application development programs
* Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message
* Experience working with public\-sector or regulated\-industry procurement processes
* Experience developing joint go\-to\-market propositions and partner delivery models
* Experience leading technical workstreams in multi\-year, multi\-million\-dollar pursuits


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

 In this role, you will manage a team for one of Solution Areas and bring thought leadership in customer engagement. You will also manage Nokia's Internal Stake holder engagements with solution capabilities from multiple sources and technologies, build understanding and preference for Nokia products and solutions by influencing regional team decisions and strategic directions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Develop detailed customer solution design \& architecture and perform technical risk evaluation for overall technical solution.
* Own technical part of bid preparation: solution design/architecture, effort estimates, scope of work, bill of material, etc. and holding key role in contract negotiations to protect SI value.

* Present offered solution design/architecture to customer and verify/adapt it during realization phase
* Liaise with SI Engagement Architect and other members of the regional team as well as with Product Managers, Project manager and 3rd party product manager to align customer requirements with available generic solutions, Nokia products and 3rd party products

* Experience in call flow related troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Mobile Network (2G, 3G \& 4G).
* Advanced level on Operating System such as Linux or Solaris.

 Learn more about life at Nokia .

409de6ed.title: Junior Consultant - Cloud
409de6ed.description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Purpose**
 As a Junior Consultant, you will be responsible for supporting cloud infrastructure, application modernization, DevOps automation, and cloud migration initiatives across customer environments. You will work closely with cloud architects, consultants, and engineering teams to design, deploy, monitor, and optimize cloud\-based solutions on AWS and Azure platforms.
   

  

 The role requires hands\-on experience with cloud technologies, CI/CD practices, containerization, automation, and enterprise application support. You will contribute to implementation projects, cloud onboarding activities, migration engagements, and operational support while ensuring adherence to security, performance, and reliability standards.
   

  

 You will participate in cloud transformation initiatives involving public, private, and hybrid cloud environments, helping customers modernize workloads and improve operational efficiency through automation and cloud\-native technologies.
   

  

**About You**
**Missions and main activities**
* Support implementation and administration of cloud environments on AWS and Azure.
* Assist in deployment, configuration, and management of cloud infrastructure services.
* Participate in cloud migration and modernization projects.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and cloud\-native services.
* Support containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Assist in monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of cloud workloads.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, or other scripting languages.
* Implement and maintain cloud security controls, identity management, and access governance.
* Support deployment and configuration of cloud monitoring and observability solutions.
* Assist with incident resolution, root cause analysis, and operational support activities.
* Collaborate with architects and project teams in delivering cloud transformation engagements.
* Support customer onboarding and cloud adoption initiatives.
* Contribute to technical documentation, deployment procedures, and knowledge sharing.


**Technical Skills:**
**Cloud Platforms**
* AWS Services (EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, Load Balancer, SQS)
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* Cloud Migration and Cloud Operations


**DevOps \& Automation**
* Azure DevOps
* CI/CD Pipeline Implementation
* Git Version Control
* Infrastructure Automation
* Python Scripting


**Operating Systems**
* Windows Server Administration (Basic)
* Linux Administration (Basic to Intermediate)


**Databases**
* SQL Server
* NoSQL Databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB)


**Education and Certifications:**
* BE/BTECH from a reputed institute.
* Cloud\-related certifications (Amazon, Azure, Google) are good to have but not mandatory .
* 2 – 3 years of experience in software engineering, cloud technologies, DevOps, or infrastructure support.
* Experience working with AWS and Azure environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation.
* Experience supporting cloud migration or modernization initiatives.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and cloud security concepts.


**Soft skills:**
* Very good verbal and written communication skill using English language
* Being able to work under pressure
* Being able to be available 24x7 for production support.
* Customer Oriented and strong sensitivity to Customer satisfaction
* Transversal/customer crisis
* Good interpersonal, team\-build and leadership skills.
* Proactive, self\-motivated and determined attitude


 You bring rigor, passion for challenges, and determination. You seek the opportunity to expand your expertise, achieve your goals, and thrive.

* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient.  We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced SAP Datasphere \& SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Consultant to join our team in Pune. This role is ideal for a professional with extensive experience in SAP analytics technologies, enterprise data architectures, and S/4HANA Finance business processes. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise across SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAC, CDS Views, and SAP HANA with a deep understanding of finance domains including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Profitability Analysis, and management reporting. The role offers the opportunity to design and deliver scalable, business\-focused analytics solutions within a complex telecom environment.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Define and implement modern enterprise data architectures, including layered modelling, data virtualisation, harmonisation, and semantic modelling.Design and deliver analytics solutions aligned with S/4HANA Finance processes, including:
   

  

* General Ledger and Universal Journal
* Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
* Asset Accounting
* Cost Centre Accounting and Profit Centre Accounting
* Profitability Analysis (Margin Analysis / COPA)


 Architect and optimise complex data flows integrating S/4HANA, non\-SAP systems, APIs, and additional enterprise data sources.Translate finance reporting requirements into scalable SAP Datasphere models, including replication scenarios, business entities, analytical models, and semantic layers.Develop and enhance SAP Analytics Cloud stories, dashboards, analytic applications, planning models, and operational reporting solutions.Deliver SAP Datasphere and S/4HANA integrations using CDS Views, OData services, and enterprise data services.Lead or contribute to end\-to\-end SAP analytics implementation programmes across multiple project lifecycles.Facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirements gathering sessions, solution design reviews, and business alignment discussions.Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and senior leaders to deliver analytics solutions aligned with organisational priorities.Provide technical guidance to team members through deliverable reviews and best\-practice recommendations.Lead production readiness activities, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance optimisation, and solution stabilisation.Drive innovation by leveraging SAP Datasphere capabilities such as Data Fabric, Replication Flows, Data Marketplace, and Space Architecture.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.8 to 12 years of experience within SAP Analytics environments.Proven delivery experience across at least 3 to 5 full lifecycle SAP analytics implementations.Strong hands\-on expertise in SAP BW/4HANA, including ADSO modelling, AMDP development, SAP HANA SQL, and performance optimisation.Demonstrated experience with SAP Datasphere, including Spaces, Data Builder, Business Builder, Analytical Models, and Replication Flows.Extensive experience developing SAP Analytics Cloud stories, dashboards, operational reporting, and planning solutions.Strong understanding of S/4HANA Embedded Analytics, ABAP CDS Views, and OData services.Experience with SAP HANA Calculation Views, procedures, and complex integration scenarios across SAP and non\-SAP platforms.Knowledge of cloud\-based enterprise platforms, with SAP BTP experience preferred.Strong understanding of S/4HANA Finance and Core Finance business processes.Experience working within telecom environments and supporting finance reporting and integration requirements.Excellent stakeholder management, communication, workshop facilitation, solution design, and delivery skills.Relevant SAP certifications are preferred but not mandatory.
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to work on enterprise\-scale SAP analytics transformation initiatives.Exposure to advanced SAP technologies including SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, and S/4HANA Embedded Analytics.Collaboration with global stakeholders across finance, technology, and business functions.Opportunity to influence modern data platform strategies and analytics roadmaps.Experience delivering innovative reporting, planning, and analytics capabilities within a leading telecommunications organisation.Professional growth through participation in complex transformation programmes and architecture\-led initiatives.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced SAP Datasphere architecture, modelling, and data fabric capabilities.Enterprise analytics solution design across SAP and non\-SAP ecosystems.Modern finance analytics and reporting frameworks using S/4HANA Finance data models.Large\-scale data integration, virtualisation, and semantic modelling techniques.Advanced SAP Analytics Cloud dashboarding, planning, and analytical application development.Performance optimisation approaches across BW/4HANA, Datasphere, and SAC environments.Stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and solution consulting skills within global programmes.
   

  

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. 	+ OR equivalent experience.

 The Service Delivery Management team at Bloomreach is the engine behind every successful customer implementation. We don't just manage projects — we orchestrate complex, multi\-workstream implementations that bring Bloomreach's AI\-powered platform to life for the world's leading brands.

* Agentic tooling — ClickUp automations, Slack\-integrated utilization tracking, and automated retrospective analysis are standard operating procedure

You'll manage multiple concurrent projects, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and serve as the primary delivery contact for customers — ensuring every project lands on time, on budget, and with measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 This is not a traditional PM role. You'll be expected to leverage AI tools and automation to operate at a higher level — spending less time on status updates and more time on strategic delivery, risk mitigation, and commercial growth.

* Use Von and other AI tools for meeting prep, status reporting, customer research, and project analysis
* Build and maintain automated workflows (ClickUp, Slack, Zapier) to streamline repetitive delivery tasks
* Contribute to the team's automation roadmap — propose and implement new ways to use AI in service delivery
* Use data and dashboards to drive project decisions, track delivery health, and identify patterns across your portfolio


**Collaboration**
* Work closely with Business Consultants (BCs), Solutions Consultants (SCs), AMs, and CSMs to ensure seamless handoffs and aligned delivery
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams on technical blockers, feature requests, and platform capabilities
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives like LAIS rollouts, DataHub migrations, and One Platform upgrades


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have**
* 5–7 years of experience in project/program management within SaaS, martech, or digital services
* Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent implementation projects (10\+ simultaneously)
* Strong understanding of web technologies — APIs, SDKs, webhooks, data pipelines, frontend/backend architecture
* Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar) and comfort building automations within them
* Commercial awareness — experience with SOW review, services scoping, and revenue tracking
* Excellent communication skills — ability to run customer\-facing meetings, write clear status reports, and manage stakeholder expectations across timezones (EMEA/APAC overlap required)
* Comfort with AI tools — active user of AI assistants, automation platforms, or similar technology in a professional context


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience with CDP/martech platforms (Bloomreach, Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC, Emarsys, or similar)
* Familiarity with Jinja templating, SQL, or scripting languages
* Experience working in a globally distributed team with EMEA/AMER stakeholders
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certification
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ or services quoting processes


**What Success Looks Like**
**Timeframe**
**Milestone**
**30 days**
 Onboarded on Bloomreach platform, tools (Von, ClickUp, Slack workflows), and processes. Shadowed 2–3 active projects.
   

  

**60 days**
 Independently managing 4–6 projects. First automated status report generated. The first customer meeting led solo.
   

  

**90 days**
 Full portfolio of 8–12 projects. First services upsell opportunities identified. Contributing to the team automation roadmap.
   

  

**6 months**
 Recognized as a reliable delivery partner by AMs and CSMs. Delivering projects on time with \>90% customer satisfaction. At least one new automation or process improvement shipped.
   

  

**Why Bloomreach**
* AI\-first company — You'll work with cutting\-edge AI (Loomi) and be expected to use AI in your own work, not just deliver it to customers
* Global impact — Your projects will power personalized experiences for millions of consumers across the world's leading brands
* Growth trajectory — The India SDM function is new, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how it operates from the ground up
* Collaborative culture — You'll work with smart, passionate people across engineering, product, sales, and customer success


 More things you'll like about Bloomreach:
   

  

**Culture:**
* A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
* We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
* We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
* We work virtual\-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
* We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.\*
* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
* We reward \& celebrate work anniversaries \-\- Bloomversaries!\*


*(\*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)*
**Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!**
*If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it \- we will be very grateful!*

bb557641.title: Service Delivery Program Manager
bb557641.description:
**Who We Are**
 Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award\-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting\-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people\-first culture.
   

  

 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end\-to\-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile \& Digital Marketing \| Enterprise AI \| Customer Care AI \& Technology \| Enterprise Technology Modernization
   

  

**Location \& Flexibility**
 Noida, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Program Manager / Senior Manager to lead end\-to\-end cloud migration and modernization initiatives across multi\-cloud environments — including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure. In this highly visible role, you will drive large\-scale transformation programs that accelerate the organization's cloud adoption, modernize legacy workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with executive stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, and vendors to define program strategy, govern delivery, manage risk, and champion cloud\-native best practices across the enterprise. This role requires a blend of technical acumen, program governance expertise, and leadership presence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Governance**
* Develop and own the end\-to\-end program roadmap for cloud migration and modernization, spanning GCP, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Establish and manage program governance frameworks including steering committees, status reporting, RACI structures, and decision\-making processes.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of architects, engineers, DevOps practitioners, and business analysts across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Track and report on program health — scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality — to senior leadership and C\-suite stakeholders.
* Drive milestone delivery, manage dependencies, and resolve escalations to keep programs on track.


**Cloud Migration Execution**
* Define and execute migration strategies including Rehost (lift \& shift), Replatform, Refactor,Repurchase, Retire, and Retain (6Rs/7Rs).
* Oversee infrastructure assessments, application portfolio rationalization, and cloud readiness evaluations.
* Coordinate migration waves, manage cutover planning, and ensure zero\-downtime or minimal\-disruption transitions for critical workloads.
* Manage relationships with hyperscale partners (Google, AWS, Microsoft) and third\-party migration tooling vendors.
* Ensure proper implementation of cloud landing zones, networking, IAM, security controls, and compliance requirements.


**Modernization \& Transformation**
* Champion cloud\-native modernization initiatives including containerization(Kubernetes/GKE/EKS/AKS), microservices adoption, and serverless architectures.
* Drive application re\-platforming to managed cloud services (e.g., Cloud SQL, RDS, Azure SQL, Big Query, Redshift, Synapse).
* Lead DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline modernization to enable continuous delivery and cloud\-native development practices.
* Partner with data and AI/ML teams to enable cloud\-native analytics and AI workloads on GCP(Vertex AI), AWS (SageMaker), and Azure (Azure AI).


**Financial \& Risk Management**
* Own program budgets ranging from $5M to $50M\+, with responsibility for FinOps, cost optimization, and cloud spend visibility.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, operational, and business risks throughout the program lifecycle.
* Drive business case development, ROI modeling, and benefits tracking for cloud transformation investments.


**Stakeholder Management \& Change Management**
* Act as the primary program interface for senior technology and business leaders, building trust and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
* Develop and execute organizational change management plans to drive cloud adoption and new ways of working.
* Build cloud capability and literacy across engineering and product teams through training, communities of practice, and enablement programs.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of program/project management experience with 5\+ years directly in cloud migration or transformation programs
* Demonstrated delivery of large\-scale migrations ($10M\+ budgets) on at least two of: GCP, AWS, Azure
* Experience managing multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud environments with 500\+ workloads or applications
* Track record of managing cross\-functional teams of 20\+ people across engineering, architecture, and business functions
* Experience with enterprise change management and organizational transformation
* Deep familiarity with cloud architecture patterns: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless,containers
* Understanding of networking (VPC,VPN, DirectConnect/Interconnect/ExpressRoute), IAM, and security in cloud
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes,CI/CD, Terraform/IaC, and DevOps toolchains
* Familiarity with migration tooling: AWS MGN, Google Migrate, Azure Migrate, Velostrata, CloudEndure, etc.
* Understanding of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization levers


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*
 We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.
   

  

 For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.
   

  

 Compensation Range: ₹45L \- ₹60L

68279e7d.title: Engagement Manager- HCM Implementation (US Shift)
68279e7d.description:
**Job Description**
**Engagement Manager (US Region)\- HYD based**
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
   

  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment


**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**
 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:
* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.


**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

cae4a985.title: Strategic Engagement Manager
cae4a985.description:
**Are you a talented sales professional?**
**Would you like to join a company that helps advance science, technology and health?**
**About Our Team**
 Our Academic \& Government team helps our communities accelerate knowledge for a better world by helping to establish, discover and advance knowledge. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of knowledge, allowing users to unlock insights from content and by measuring the quality and impact of research \- turning insights into outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a sales role to drive growth and strengthen customer value across our portfolio of data, analytics and SAAS solutions.
   

  

 This role brings together deep data and domain expertise with strong commercial acumen to engage senior stakeholders, shape strategic discussions, and lead complex, high\-value opportunities. The SEM will play a key role in driving new business growth, supporting renewal success, and enabling long\-term business growth across large, strategically important accounts.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Independently originate, develop, advance and close strategic, large\-value, complex opportunities within priority accounts, taking ownership of the full sales cycle. Partner and align with Account Managers as appropriate to maximize account success, while remaining accountable for driving opportunity creation and deal closure.
* Expand stakeholder networks by building multi\-level engagement and securing broad organizational support.
* Lead engagements where analytics, AI, and data\-driven insights are central to customer decision\-making.
* Support high\-value and complex renewals by engaging senior stakeholders and reinforcing solution value.
* Articulate measurable impact through tailored value expansion and deliver high\-impact workshops to generate demand and strengthen customer engagement.
* Demonstrate deep expertise across research analytics, AI applications, and SaaS platforms, positioning solutions based on customer needs.
* Strengthen Elsevier’s metrics authority and commercial preference through strategic engagement, alignment with priorities, conference participation, thought leadership, workshops, and executive sessions.


**Requirements**
* Commercially driven with 5\+ years of expertise in analytics, SAAS or AI with the ability to translate technical capabilities into institutional and business value.
* Demonstrated ability to apply data\-driven insights in customer\-facing engagements and strategic discussions.
* Proven experience developing, driving complex, high value, multi\-stakeholder opportunities in enterprise or institutional environments, from start to end.
* Strong collaboration skills with a proven ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed, cross\-functional environment.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver compelling, insight\-led narratives to senior audiences.
* Experience engaging with stakeholders in academia, government, or large enterprises is highly valued.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment, across global teams and time zones, with flexibility to support engagements beyond standard working hours when required.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the region to support strategic initiatives and engagements, with AI expertise
* Background in government IT sales and / or data science is highly valuable. PHD preferred but not mandatory.
* Fluency in English. Additional second Asian language fluency in Mandarin or Japanese is highly valued.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
   

  

**Working for You**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
   

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**
