3a3cb1b6.description:
**EXTERIOR \& LIGHTING BUSINESS GROUP**
**Position title : Program Manager**
**Work instructions, procedures and information**
* Knowledge / Qualifications
* University Engineering or Business Degree
* Previous Experience (If relevant)
* 8\-12 years’ experience in Automotive industry – commercial, industrial or engineering background
* Key technical competencies
* Automotive global requirements.
* IATF16949 \& Customer specific requirements.
* Key behavioral competencies (be customer–centric, cultivate innovation, act with audacity, drive results, collaborate, drive engagement, value differences, be resilient, develop yourself)
* Team playing, leadership, communication skills and rigor. Ability to federate teams, define and actively lead a cross departmental plan to achieve results.


**Missions**
* Main Missions
* Manage and delivers the project (PO and Customer) objectives and deliverables.
* Responsible for the project profitability
* Manage the complete development budget and cash\-flow for the entire project.
* Delivers a non\-event launch of the project into production
* KPI and/or main deliverables
* Represents PO at the customer and represents the customer in PO
* Promote EHS and quality requirements internally and externally
* Project objectives (EHS, Development Result, Hours, NPV, Gross / Material Margins, cash at SOP, OPTIMAP project plan achievement, Launch Readiness, customer approval timing and OPTIMAP IS tools completion)


**Activities**
**Project Definition**
* Ensures the OPTIMAP Project plan and total development budget is in accordance with the agreed Customer Statement Of Work and validated project scope
* Leads the core team member’s OPTIMAP work packages and their agreed development budgets, in agreement with the project objectives and the project scope
* Establishes and manages the master project timing plan and consolidates negotiated planning of each core team member ensuring it conforms to the customer and OPTIMAP timing plans
* Responsible for the profitability of the project and sets the core team members targets to work towards in line with the project objectives. (Development hours, PRU, investments, cash\-flow, Costs of Non Quality)
* Follows and applies the direction of the division cascaded by the Program director
* At the end of the project : assesses the status against the original project objectives and feeds back lessons learned.


**Actions management / Reporting / Risks**
* In line with the OPTIMAP Project Plan, consolidates the global project status and ensures that the core teams are accountable for their status for the deliverables completion in the division Information Systems
* Manages and identifies deviations from the planned Project Plan and validates the actions proposed by the core team members to realign
* Responsible for organising project meetings, project reviews and end of phase reviews with all core team members to review project status and project action plan follow\-up
* Prepares and presents the gateway reports to the OPTIMAP committee and, in anticipation of the gate event, issues the gate validation report
* Consolidates the threats and opportunities of each department, prioritises and manages the action plan to respond to the risks throughout the project phases
* Responsible for the financial control / reporting of the project budget using the standard division tools to consolidate and reporting cash\-flow and profitability to program reviews
* Split of the project development budget by department and delegation to the core team members for their financial control / reporting (excluding payment/expenditure authorization)
* Manages the scope change (internal / external) process and ensures the project budget is updated (hours, investment and production costs)
* Manages project development expenditure versus the planned budget, identifies any deviation (hours, investments and production costs), and takes appropriate actions to realign
* Manages the project cash\-flow, including tooling and other costs. Only project team member who can authorize payment to suppliers respecting POs procedures and terms
* Responsible for ensuring the contribution and actions of all project team members to achieve a non\-event launch
* Challenges that the optimum technical and manufacturing solutions / choices are made by the project team to meet the design to cost project objectives
* Provides periodic reporting to the program director, plant director, department managers and sales director highlighting the key project progress and risks through the program review process.
* Follows the project reporting of each core team member to manage the escalation process of issues and risks and the achievement of their project actions.


**Team / people**
* Ensures the coordination of the project team, communication management, project meeting organization, conflict resolution and building an effective team
* Ensures the project team applies the methodology of development \- OPTIMAP through adequate division Information Systems
* In line with the project development budget identifies the resource needs, skills and locations to meet the project objectives
* Contributes to the annual assessment process of the core team members
* Responsible to ensure the project team apply company standards and best practices as defined by each department to maximise the productivity of the development budget
* Ensures the health and safety of the project team and the respect of the environment
* Applies and respects the procedures of the engineering and plant sites and the responsibility for control or destruction of project parts and waste


**Customer**
* Is Plastic Omnium’s accountable representative of the project for the customer
* With the support of the PQL ensures the actions of the customer APQP process and final customer validation files (PPAP, PSW...) are cascaded and managed through the project team
* Responsible for the coordination / management of all the project team members’ communications to the customer and ensure the core team members take their responsibility in front of the customer
* Is responsible for ensuring that all the customer deliverables (customer approval, APQP, build deliveries etc.) are managed and delivered by the project team and reports the progress to the customer in line with the agreed Statement Of Work.
* Identifies to the Commercial Project Manager and the customer, customer scope changes to the agreed Customer Statement of Work in accordance to the budget of development (hours, travel costs, costs / hour) and the OPTIMAP project plan.
* Supports the Commercial Project Manager in the negotiation of customer scope changes.


**Department**
* Participates in the establishment and the delivery of the department progress plans
* Participates in the continuous improvement of the departments, organization and methodologies, with actions of lessons learned, best practices and productivity.
* Cascading / be a mentor for another junior program manager

1ec68993.title: Program Manager – Assessment & Certification Development
1ec68993.description:
**Job Title: Program Manager – Assessment \& Certification Development** 




**Location: Remote** 




  





 EC\-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 170 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world\-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide.
 



  





**www.eccouncil.org** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Program Manager – Assessment \& Certification Development to lead the end\-to\-end development and continuous improvement of professional certification assessments.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of assessment strategy, certification development, subject\-matter expertise, psychometrics, and program governance. The successful candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders, subject\-matter experts, psychometricians, and certification governance committees to ensure that our assessments accurately measure the knowledge, skills, and competencies required for professionals in the field.
 



 The role requires strong program management capability, assessment expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within a highly governed certification environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end assessment and certification development lifecycle, from JTA and competency analysis through exam blueprinting, item development, validation, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Lead Job Task Analysis (JTA) and ensure assessments are aligned to current industry roles, tasks, competencies, and professional practice.
* Develop and maintain exam blueprints, assessment specifications, competency models, and content domains in collaboration with SMEs and psychometric professionals.
* Lead item development, review, validation, and performance analysis, ensuring items meet quality, relevance, cognitive\-level, and technical standards.
* Apply strong knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, fairness, standard setting, item analysis, and assessment performance.
* Coordinate SME workshops, validation studies, and assessment reviews and translate findings into actionable assessment improvements.
* Ensure assessment development is well\-documented, evidence\-based, and aligned with certification governance and accreditation requirements.
* Manage multiple assessment\-development programs, including timelines, SMEs, stakeholders, risks, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with Certification Operations, Exam Security, Product, Technology, and other teams to ensure assessments are ready for secure and effective delivery.
* Identify opportunities to improve the quality, scalability, efficiency, and defensibility of certification assessments.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* PhD or master’s degree in psychology, Assessment, Education, Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in professional certification, assessment/examination development, credentialing, or psychometrics.
* Proven experience managing high\-stakes professional certification or assessment programs.
* Strong knowledge of Job Task Analysis (JTA), Role Delineation/Job Practice Analysis, exam blueprinting, item development, content validation, and assessment governance.
* Strong working knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, item analysis, statistical evaluation, and standard setting.
* Experience working with SMEs, psychometricians, item writers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop and validate assessments.
* Strong program management, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Experience in an accredited or standards\-driven certification environment preferred.
* ISO/IEC 17024 knowledge is a strong plus.
* Experience in cybersecurity, IT, technology, or professional certification is an advantage.



  





**About Our Culture:** 




 EC\-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community.
 



  





**Additional Information:** 




 EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.
 



  





 EC\-Council is dedicated to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability that limits your ability to complete any part of the application process and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at ecchr@eccouncil.org and let us know how we can assist.
 



  





 To be eligible for this position, candidates must be able to provide proof that they are either a citizen of the country or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is posted and are currently residing there. EC\-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work.
 



  





 If, as part of the recruitment process, you are required to complete or submit any form of work, project, case study, or assignment, please note that such material will be considered the exclusive property of EC\-Council. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC\-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein.
 



  





 Candidates further waive any intellectual property or moral rights in such submissions, confirm that the work is original and free of third\-party infringement, and acknowledge that it is provided solely for evaluation purposes, with no ownership or other rights retained.
 



  





 Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. This may include information such as your name, contact details, employment history, qualifications, and any other details you provide as part of your application. All data is handled in compliance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.
 



 Please review our policy here: EC\-Council Privacy Policy\- User \& company \| Data Protection. Submission of your application will be considered as your acceptance of the terms stated above.

e4f1a01c.title: Product Delivery Manager - Moveworks
e4f1a01c.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
 The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high\-quality business outcomes.
   

  

 As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
   

  

 The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy \& Lifecycle Management:**
* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.


**Stakeholder Management:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers


**Product backlog and Planning:**
* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long\-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).


**Delivery Management:**
* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go\-live


**Governance and Continuous improvement:**
* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.


**Innovation and Platform enablement:**
* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI\-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self\-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification


**What are we looking for?**
* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
